name: Curled card spiral
description: A full-bleed WebGL canvas on a flat near-black. About ten landscape cards (radius 14, curled like pages, tilted 10 to 25 degrees) trace a spiral in depth: small and blurred at the top right, one sharp centre card 410 by 242 near the middle, the last cards curling down and left; all stay inside a 48px safe margin and fade out before the edge. Wheel, arrow keys or swipe turn the spiral; hover lifts a card. One fixed control only: a pill at the bottom centre that toggles between spiral and grid. Cards carry real pictures. Phone: cards at 60% size, swipe turns, toggle 48 tall.
phone: Cards at 60% size, swipe turns, toggle 48 tall.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch: cards stay inside a 48px safe margin and fade before the edge. The faint 40px grid (hairlines) and the HUD cluster (orb, sound circle, reel) are dropped for one pill control.

name: Turning object over a closing line
description: A black full-screen closing section. A 3D object about 670 by 450 (a model, or a transparent turntable sequence) is centred in the upper half; it turns with scroll and can be dragged. Below it, a 54px bold two-line close, centred, overlapping the object's foot by 40px; its second line is an underlined link or button text. The designed footer follows as its own section; this stop never replaces it. Accent only on the link underline. Phone: object 260 tall, close 34px.
phone: Object 260 tall, close 34px; the designed footer follows.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines: the side lines and the dashed rule are dropped. The 12px legal and credit row is dropped: a one-line footer row would replace the designed footer, so the footer follows as its own section.

name: 3D product onto a spec card
description: A one-screen scene on one flat ground colour (no gradient). A tall filled card is centred, about 250x550 (17vw by 61vh), radius 24, fill one step off the ground, 28px padding: a 20px bold product line, five spec rows (the label at the left and a bold value at the right, 16px, 20px apart, no rules or borders), a two-line 14px note and a 48px filled pill. A 3D product (a WebGL model or a turntable frame sequence) spins in from the top and lands over the card, covering its upper third. One 120px key figure (the product's headline spec) sits beside the card as plain type, no tile. Later frames shift the card off centre and the product lands again.
phone: Card at 70vw wide centred, key figure above it, product landing on its top.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nested boxes, hairlines, tiny uppercase labels, numbering and gradient. Designed out: the 1px border, the barcode strip, the table rules and the gradient ground go; the number tile becomes plain type; the card is one filled box on a flat ground. The idea (a product landing on a spec card) stays.

name: 3D walk with hotspot cards
description: A pinned scene about four screens long, driven by a wheel walk through a modelled 3D space (a pre-rendered camera path scrubbed by scroll is the practical build). At one stop the camera faces a row of three to five statues or objects, each with a 20px round filled marker hovering above it. Clicking a marker dims the scene with a flat 60% ink overlay and opens one centred card 520 by 380 (radius 20, filled in the palette): a 240px picture on the left half, a 28px title and a two-line 16px paragraph on the right, and a round close button. Other markers swap the card. Phone: the camera walks the same path and the card becomes a bottom sheet at 70vh.
phone: Card becomes a bottom sheet at 70vh.
houseRuleCheck: The angled gradient and the scanline overlay are replaced by a flat tint; the card is a filled card, not outlined.

name: Giant name marquee rows
description: A colour-ground section of about 2.5 screens. Top: a 64px title at the left margin (x 80); 96px below, a grid of six picture tiles in two rows of three, each 413 by 200 (radius 16) on 20px gaps. 120px below that, three full-width marquee rows 32px apart: names at 148px in heavy tight type (client, artist or project names), each followed by a 120px round picture thumbnail as the joining device. Rows alternate direction, drift at different speeds, slide up 60px on entry and slow on hover. The rows run across the full width (both edges, so nothing touches one edge only); everything else keeps 80px margins. Phone: names 64px, two rows, tiles in a two-column grid.
phone: Names 64px, two rows, tiles in two columns.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch: the marquee is full-bleed on both edges while grid and title keep margins. The rule under the title is dropped and logos become round picture thumbnails unless real logos exist.

name: Arc-lettered heading
description: A pinned stage, one 1440px stretch of scroll, on a flat ground. A three-word 130px heading in heavy capitals is split into about 12 letters (an aria-label keeps it readable) placed on a wide arc across the width: each letter rotated from -11 to +24 degrees, its y offset following a circle of radius about 1700, fading in from 0.8 scale on a 40ms stagger tied to scroll. A two-line 20px sentence-case paragraph, 420 wide, is centred under the arc and fades in last. No dotted rim, disc or other drawn curve; the letters alone carry the arc. Phone: two words, 72px letters on a tighter arc (radius 700).
phone: Two words, 72px letters on a tighter arc.
houseRuleCheck: The dotted disc rim (a drawn shape) is dropped and the uppercase paragraph is set in sentence case.

name: Arch capsule beside wide photo
description: A section on the page ground. A centred 56px two-line headline, then 72px below two panels 20px apart, both 640 tall within 80px margins: at the left a 380-wide arch (radius 190 190 24 24) filled in the accent tint, holding a 28px two-line caption near the top and a filled pill pinned to its foot; at the right an 880-wide photo (radius 48). On scroll the arch rises 40px and the photo scales from 1.08 to 1 inside its crop. No icon in the arch. Phone: the arch becomes a full-width panel (radius 32 32 24 24, 360 tall) with the photo 4:5 under it.
phone: Arch becomes a full-width panel 360 tall, photo 4:5 under it.
houseRuleCheck: The icon in the arch is dropped (no icon-topped card) and the headline is cut from three lines to two.

name: Asymmetric two-portrait lookbook
description: A panel inset 40px from the page edge with 160px of bottom padding, on a quiet tint. Two columns split 40/60 with a 168px gap: a 480x640 portrait (3:4) at the top left, and a 720x960 portrait on the right that is taller than the screen, so scroll crosses it. One photograph is treated black and white, the other in colour, and the sides flip in each chapter. A five-line 18px paragraph, 300px wide, sits 64px under the small photograph, ink on ground. On entry both photos slide 60px in from the right and fade over 700ms, the second 120ms later. Photos have 12px corners.
phone: Stack: the small portrait first at 70% width and left aligned, the paragraph, then the large portrait at full width; both rise on entry.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The photographs must be designed or generated fashion or product imagery, not archive photographs.

name: Autoscroll camera, story lane
description: A 3D camera path (a WebGL scene) that advances on its own while the section is in view and can be paused or nudged by scroll; about three screens per chapter, three to six chapters. The story text sits in a right-aligned lane about 480px wide, vertically centred, with 64px from the right edge: a 64px uppercase chapter title and a 24px sentence-case line of two or three lines, white on the scene over a flat 25% tint; the letters blur in during the first part of the chapter (10-80%) and out as it ends. Ground is the scene itself; one accent hue lights the path. With reduced motion the scene holds still per chapter and steps by scroll. No pagination letters.
phone: The lane moves to the bottom, centred, 24px gutters, title 32px; the scene crops to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged numbering: the pagination letters that slid out per chapter are dropped. The 64px title is a headline, not a tiny label. The scene is a rendered 3D path, not drawn illustration.

name: Script word behind title and logo row
description: A warm light ground. One giant script-face word, 2 to 6 letters (about 900 by 560), in a soft tint of the accent, sits behind the left half, kept inside the 80px left margin so it is never cropped. In front: a two-line 56px title at the left margin and a three-line 17px paragraph at x 600, 420 wide. 140px lower, one row of partner logos (46 tall, about 170 apart) drifts left with scroll at a steady speed across the full width. Phone: script word 240 tall behind the title, paragraph below, logo row 36 tall. Use real partner logos only; if there are none, swap the row for product photographs.
phone: Script word 240 tall behind the title, paragraph below, logo row 36 tall.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch: the word stays inside the left margin. The script word is decoration behind the title, not an accent word inside the headline.

name: Blend-mode relay list over media
description: A pinned white stage of about three screens. One clip or picture 1200 by 675 (no radius) is centred. Over it and the ground, a list of eight items (project or topic names, 1 to 3 words) in 72px bold tight type in difference blend. The current item stands large at the left margin (x 64); the others are right-aligned at the right margin (x 1376) and step down in size (scale 0.9 to 0.3) along the list. Scroll relays the next item to the left while the centre picture swaps to that item's clip. No rules, counters or labels. Phone: two stacked lines (current and next item) at 44px, picture 4:5 centred, blend kept.
phone: Two stacked lines at 44px, picture 4:5 centred.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch: the items sit 64px inside the screen edges.

name: Blurred backdrop with sharp video tile
description: A blurred backdrop 1360 by 760 (radius 28, 40px margins), the same clip scaled 1.2 and blurred 30px. Centred on it, one sharp square 560 by 560 (radius 24) plays the clip in a single duotone from the palette (ground and accent), with a 56px play glyph and a 96px one-word title in white centred on it. The tile is the picture itself, not a text box: no labels or edge row. Hover grows it to 600; a click opens the clip full screen. Phone: backdrop 4:5, tile 70% of the width, word 56px.
phone: Backdrop 4:5, tile 70% of the width, word 56px.
houseRuleCheck: The row of tiny labels is dropped. The sharp tile must be media, never a text card laid over the photograph.

name: Bottom-aligned headline and open signup
description: About 0.6 screen of a lightly textured light ground (paper grain, no gradient) with about 330px of empty space above, so the content hangs low. A bottom-aligned 7/5 split: at the left a 52px two-line headline; at the right a 17px two-line invitation, a 56 tall email field in a filled tint (radius 28) with the submit as a round arrow button inside it, and a 13px one-line consent note with a round checkbox. 120px below, the next section or footer. Focus brightens the field fill. Phone: headline 34px, field and note below at 20px margins, the empty space above reduced to 160.
phone: Headline 34px, field and note below at 20px margins, 160px empty above.
houseRuleCheck: The outlined pill field becomes a filled field; the 11px consent text is raised to 13px.

name: Bottom sheet over a scene
description: A bottom sheet over a full-screen scene. A round 56px info button sits at the bottom right; clicking it raises a sheet from the bottom edge: at most 1280 wide (24px side margins), 56vh tall, top corners radius 28, filled in the page ground, 48px padding, two columns with 40px between (a 36px title and a 17px paragraph at the left; one picture, a short list or a button at the right). A click on the dim backdrop (flat 40% ink), the Escape key or the close button lowers it. It slides in over 400ms with ease-out. Phone: full-width sheet, 70vh, one column.
phone: Full-width sheet at 70vh, one column.
houseRuleCheck: Fill and content were not recorded, so they are designed here; no gradient or glass behind the sheet.

name: Bubbles drop into a phone screen
description: A pinned stage of about two screens. A phone frame 370 by 764 (radius 48, near-black body, light screen) is centred, with a 56px app bar at the top of its screen. Six to eight round thumbnails (65 to 166px, designed pictures) drop into the screen one after another from above the frame, each with a small bounce, and settle in a loose non-overlapping stack that fills the screen. Behind the frame, in the lower 260px, a faded echo of the headline word sits at 8% ink, 220px tall. A 44px two-line headline and a 17px line sit to the left, vertically centred. Phone: the frame is 240 by 500 with the headline above it.
phone: Frame 240 by 500 with the headline above it.
houseRuleCheck: Keep the device inside the margins; the thumbnails must be designed pictures, never documentary.

name: Descent with title zoom and sheet wipe
description: A pinned scene of about 1.5 screens. A top-down monochrome rendered field fills the screen in one hue (a terrain, a fabric, a field of objects; a made image, not a documentary photograph) and scales from 1 to 1.5 as the camera descends. The headline, 2 to 4 words in off-white, grows from 140px to 216px over the same distance. Then a paper sheet in the next section's ground colour wipes in diagonally from the lower left (a rotated block translating across, with a 6px curled edge) until it covers the screen and becomes the next ground. Phone: headline 72 to 110px, the sheet wipes vertically.
phone: Headline 72 to 110px, the sheet wipes vertically.
houseRuleCheck: The curled edge must not use a gradient or a shadow; the field must be rendered or abstract, not a documentary photograph.

name: Camera fly-through of a panel tunnel
description: A pinned stage of about two screens on flat black. The camera flies forward through a tunnel of three clips and three pictures placed off-centre at different depths (each panel 420 to 640 wide), plus one 3D object. Four or five panels show at once; they bend slightly with scroll speed, drift with the pointer (up to 40px) and fade out as they are passed (depth fade only, not a gradient). No text. Phone: three panels at a time, no pointer drift.
phone: Three panels at a time, no pointer drift.
houseRuleCheck: The scene has no text and no drawn shapes.

name: Camera push through centred ring
description: Pinned, one screen of scroll on a flat dark ground. A ring-shaped object (a lens rim, or segments assembling into concentric rings about 530px across) sits at the centre. The camera pushes into it until the rim swells past the frame edges, then either dissolves to the page ground over 500ms (a fade, never a flash) or settles into a clean centred ring. A small bright core stays at the centre for the next scene. No text. A rendered 3D or shader object in one hue family; the page ground and accent colours carry on to the next section.
phone: The ring at 70vw; same push.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The ring is a rendered or shader object, not a drawn illustration; a white flash is replaced by a fade (photosensitivity).

name: Rail stop with hotspots
description: A wheel-driven 3D camera rail (WebGL) that holds at waypoints facing a bank of screens or a table (an office, a studio). When a waypoint is reached, a small two-line title (a 24px sans line over a 24px serif line, white) fades in at bottom centre straight on the scene over a flat 30% dark tint, with no band and no blur. Hotspot markers (filled 28px dots in the accent with a slow pulse) sit on the screens; 56px filled round previous and next controls sit at mid-height on both sides, 32px in from the edges. A marker opens a centred video overlay (70vw wide, muted autoplay, a filled close button). Ground is the scene; the accent only on markers.
phone: Markers get 44px touch targets; previous and next move to the bottom corners; the overlay is full width.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels. The title is sentence case at 24px; the blurred colour band (it read as glass) is a flat tint; the controls are plain controls, not boxes on a photograph.

name: Camera travels to a second room
description: A closing scene, pinned about two screens. One 3D model holds two rooms side by side (the one shown in the hero and a second, furnished one). Scroll moves the camera along a curve (a Bezier path with a gentle bank) from room A to room B. A centred 56px two-line closing line and one filled pill button fade in as the camera settles in room B. The practical build is a pre-rendered camera-move clip scrubbed by scroll. Phone: the same path in a portrait render, headline 36px.
phone: Portrait render of the same path, headline 36px.
houseRuleCheck: Overlay layout designed here.

name: Card row on a colour band
description: A full-width dark band with 140px of padding above and below. At the top left a 52px title and an 18px grey two-line paragraph (640px at most). 72px below, one row of four filled portrait cards that exactly fill the 1360px container with 24px gaps (about 322px wide): a 3:4 picture inset 8px at the top, then a 20px bold name and a two-line 16px description on the card fill (a lighter dark tint than the band), radius 16. On the title row at the right, two 44px filled arrow buttons step the row one card at a time when there are more than four cards (no drag). Ink is light on the dark band; one accent on the arrows or none. Variant: on a pale band under a centred 28px heading, five cards exactly fill the container (about 248px each), each a 3:4 portrait inset 8px over a centred 18px bold name; no arrows.
phone: Two columns by two rows of cards with 16px gaps; the arrows are hidden.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nested boxes (a card row inside a panel inside a band). The inner black panel and the peeking next panel are dropped, so the cards sit straight on the band; the set counter is dropped (no counters). The idea (a dark band with a title over a row of portrait cards) stays.

name: Card stack fanning into an arc
description: A centred 56px two-line title in one typeface (no glyph above, no second face), 120px above and below. Under it, six tall cards 267 by 467 (radius 20, each a picture or a flat fill with a 24px title), stacked at bottom centre in a tight deck. As the section scrolls the side cards slide outward up to 400px, drop 30px, shrink to 0.76 and rotate up to 23 degrees to form a fan around the upright centre card; all cards stay inside the margins. Hover lifts a card 12px. Phone: five cards 150 by 262, a 14 degree fan, title 34px.
phone: Five cards 150 by 262, a 14 degree fan, title 34px.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged accent-words: the heavy-sans-over-serif title mix and the animated glyph are dropped (one face for the title).

name: Object tumbling between text
description: A near-black flat ground (no vignette) held for about 2640px of scroll. One 3D object about 510 wide (a model or a transparent turntable sequence) sits at the centre and makes a full turn with scroll. At the left, mid-height, a 51px two-line capitals headline about 280 wide (x 120); at the right, a 20px four-line paragraph about 250 wide (x 1070). Both text blocks blur and fade out in the last 15% of the pin while the object settles. Accent only on the object's lit edge. Phone: object 280 tall centred, headline above, paragraph below, both at 24px margins.
phone: Object 280 tall centred, headline above, paragraph below.
houseRuleCheck: The warm vignette in one corner (a gradient) is dropped for a flat ground.

name: Centre-split name cloud
description: Ground light, ink near-black, accent used only for the hovered name. Section about 720px tall with 120px padding top and bottom. A list of 14-17 names (clients, projects, places), one per row on a 48px pitch, set in 44px bold tight sans or condensed serif and split on the vertical centre line: the left column is right-aligned so every name ends at the centre, the right column is left-aligned so every name starts there. Names run 1-3 words so row lengths vary and the whole block reads as a loose lozenge. Swap about a quarter of the names for small logos at the same cap height. No heading, no captions, nothing else in the section. Hover: all other names dim to 35% and the hovered one takes the accent. Scroll: rows rise 24px and fade in, 40ms stagger per row, alternating left and right cells. Phone: one centred column of the same names at 30px on a 40px pitch, logos stay in place.
phone: One centred column, 30px names on a 40px pitch, centred; the lozenge shape is kept by alternating short and long names.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The left column is right-aligned to the centre so the left is not an empty gutter. No rules, labels or boxes.

name: Display CTA with docking pill
description: A dark band about 0.6 of a screen tall (about 540px at 900 tall) that closes a light scene. Ground near-black, ink off-white, accent one bright fill used for the pill. A centred two-line headline at 96px, 9 words or fewer, line pitch 120px; its letters rise 138px into place with a 20ms stagger when the band enters. About 100px below it a soft pill 180x60 sits centred, filled in a tone one step above the ground (no outline). When the pill has scrolled to the top third of the viewport it docks: it flies to a fixed spot and turns into a solid accent pill 160x52 that stays there through every later section and the footer, so the action follows the reader to the end. Dock at top centre only if the navigation leaves its centre slot free; otherwise dock at bottom centre 24px above the edge. Phone: headline 44px, pill full width minus 40px; docked it becomes a 56px bottom bar with 20px side margins.
phone: Headline 44px in 3 lines; the pill is full width; the docked state is a 56px pill fixed at the bottom with 20px side margins.
houseRuleCheck: The outlined pill is rebuilt as a tone-on-tone filled pill so no outlined box appears. The docked pill must never sit over the navigation.

name: Giant name rows on banded fills
description: Ground light, ink near-black, accent used for hover and for the last row. No label, no heading. Six rows stacked full width with no gaps, each 152px tall, each holding one centred name of 1-3 words (a project, a person or a place) in a 110px condensed serif. Separation comes from fills, not lines: rows alternate between the ground and a tone one step darker. The last row is solid accent and holds a centred all-work link set in the same size with a text arrow. Hover: the row wipes to the accent from the bottom in 300ms, the ink flips to the ground colour and the name nudges 12px right; optionally a small picture 180x120 follows the cursor. Scroll: rows slide up 40px and fade in with a 60ms stagger. Phone: names 44px, rows 96px, the cursor picture is dropped and a tap fills the row.
phone: Names 44px on 96px rows, same alternating fills, last row solid accent; tap fills the row.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out hairlines: the 2px rules between rows are replaced by alternating row fills. Removed the small label and the glyphs around the last link.

name: Centred header over UI collage
description: A white or tinted ground with 140px of padding above. A centred header: a 26-44px headline, a two-line 18px muted sub (640px at most) and one filled button, optionally with a text link. 150px lower, a collage of four to six product-UI cards (a dialog, two file cards, a search card with a scripted cursor that clicks) 280-520px wide, radius 16, offset toward one side of the stage and mirrored on the next instance. Card fills differ by one tint step from the ground and from each other so overlaps read without shadows or outlines; overlap by 24px at most. Photographs only as thumbnails inside the UI cards. Ink on card, accent on the button and the cursor.
phone: Three cards stacked with 12px offsets under the header; the cursor script stays.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow and shadow. Designed out: the small icon chip above the headline is dropped, the white cards on a shadow become tint-stepped fills, and cards no longer overlay photographs (no boxes on photographs).

name: Four rounded cut-out tiles under heading
description: Ground warm light, ink near-black, tile fills four pale tints of one hue family (not four hues). Headline centred, 80px caps, one or two lines, placed 200px below the top of the section. Below, four square tiles 299x299 with radius 28, 28px gutters, 80px side margins; each tile is a pale fill holding a cut-out photograph or render at about 87% of the tile, slightly off-centre. Under each tile a centred caption: a 40px caps name (1-2 lines, 44px line pitch) and a 26px price or one-line fact, so the bottoms are ragged. The section ends flat with 160px of air, with no wavy edge. Hover: the cut-out rises 12px and turns 3 degrees while the tile fill deepens one step. Scroll: tiles rise 40px with an 80ms stagger. Phone: 2x2 grid of 165px tiles, name 22px, fact 16px.
phone: 2x2 grid, 165px tiles, 16px gutters, name 22px caps, fact 16px.
houseRuleCheck: The wave edge that would close the section is dropped (drawn shape). Filled tiles are wanted; tints stay within one hue family to avoid colour sprawl.

name: Three surface cards under heading
description: Ground pale grey, cards white, ink near-black, accent only on the arrow circles. Heading centred, 40px, one line, sentence case, no coloured bar and no styled word. A row of three cards 384x455 with 24px gaps inside a 1200px container, white fill, radius 8, no shadow. Card padding 32px: a 28px two-line title at the top, a four-line 17px grey paragraph under it, and at the bottom right a 68px solid accent circle holding a plain arrow. No chip on top and no picture: each card is a short text with one action. Hover: the arrow circle turns 45 degrees and the card fill shifts one tint. Scroll: cards rise 40px with a 100ms stagger. Phone: one column, cards full width minus 40px, 20px gaps, auto height, arrow circle 56px. Dark variant: on a near-black ground the cards fill one step lighter than the ground (radius 20) and the arrow sits in a small filled pill at the foot that takes the accent on hover.
phone: One column, cards full width minus 40px, 20px gaps, 56px arrow circle.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out three conflicts: the chip above the title (eyebrow), the colour bar under one word of the heading (styled accent word) and the rotated caps tag along the edge (tiny uppercase). The arrow circle stays at the bottom, not on top, so the cards are not icon-topped.

name: Headline in a scatter of cut-out objects
description: Ground pale tint, about 1.4 screens tall, ink near-black. A centred 64px two-line headline about 460px wide; 24px below it two download buttons 56px tall side by side (solid dark fill). Around the text and below it a loose field of 9-15 cut-out objects (rendered 3D objects or cut-out photographs, never drawn illustration), each 120-240px, tilted 20-30 degrees, heavier at both sides; the area just under the buttons stays clear for 140px. Every object stays whole and at least 40px inside the screen edge. Scroll: each object drifts at its own rate (parallax 0.05-0.15) and rotates 4 degrees. Hover: the object lifts and straightens. Phone: headline 34px, buttons stacked full width, 6-8 objects in two rows below at 90-130px. Calmer variant: three to five cut-out artworks (180-300px) drifting at 0.3-0.6x and tilting 3-6 degrees around a centred three-line 54px serif headline, one 18px line and a flat ink pill.
phone: Headline 34px, buttons stacked full width, 6-8 objects in two loose rows, 90-130px each.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out two conflicts: the flat illustrated objects become supplied cut-outs or renders (no drawn SVG), and the objects no longer bleed off the screen edges.

name: Headline between vertical bar fields
description: Ground near-black, about 1.15 screens tall, ink off-white. A centred 90px two-line headline about 830px wide. The left and right 500px are fields of vertical bars in the page accent and one tint of it that thin out toward the calm 420px centre: bar width steps down from 24px to 2px while the gaps widen, so the field fades by structure with no gradient and no mask. Built as a shader field (never SVG); the bars drift upward at different slow speeds and bend 20px away from the cursor. Nothing else in the centre. Phone: the bars become two 80px bands at left and right (or one band above and below), headline 44px.
phone: Headline 44px; the bar fields shrink to two 80px bands at the edges.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict once built with solid bars. A dotted vertical spine would be a hairline and is left out; colour is limited to the accent and one tint of it, so there is no sprawl.

name: Card grid then banded title rows
description: Ground near-black, about 2.5 screens, ink off-white, one accent on hover. Centred 90px two-line headline about 900px wide, 270px of air below. A grid of four dark cards in two columns, each 628x418, 24px gap, fill one step lighter than the ground, radius 24, a picture filling the top 60% of the card and a 28px title with one grey line below; no outlines. About 160px lower, three full-width bands 1280x155 with 12px gaps: a 60px one-line title at the left and a grey two-line description starting at mid-width; bands alternate two tones of the ground and the hovered band goes to the accent. Scroll: cards rise 40px staggered; band titles slide in 40px from the left. Phone: cards one column, bands 120px tall with the description under the title.
phone: Cards one column, bands 120px tall, description under the title.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the dotted rules (hairlines) with banded fills, dropped the small coloured squares, and made the card grid four cards so no card sits alone with an empty right half. Bands are not nested in anything.

name: Headline over standing figures
description: Ground cream, one screen tall, about 300px of air after the previous scene. A centred 99px one-line headline at the top. 58px under it a 60px row holding a 340px filled capsule with one 16px line (a rating or a short fact) and a solid pill button, 8px apart. A full-width stage 1440x720 anchored to the bottom holds five tall standing cut-out figures shoulder to shoulder (rendered 3D characters, or cut-out photographs of people or products, never drawn shapes), tops starting around y 270 and varying in height, each in one of two or three tints. Hover: the figure under the cursor rises 24px while its neighbours lean away. Scroll: figures rise from below the band edge one after another with a 100ms stagger. Phone: headline 44px, capsule and button stacked, only three figures at 240px tall.
phone: Headline 44px, capsule above the button, three figures 240px tall anchored to the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Standing figures of drawn flat shapes are rebuilt with rendered or photographed stacks so no drawn shapes appear. Figures keep 40px side margins.

name: Headline over a tilted photo fan
description: Ground warm white, about 2 screens tall, one ink colour. No label above. Headline centred, 72px, three lines, 760px wide, in a single colour; the lines fade up one after another as they enter, the last line last. Below it a fan of 7-9 square photographs on an arc (188-204px, one lead photo 388x304), alternately tilted 8-15 degrees and overlapping by 20px, each with a 24px sentence-case caption (a place or a title) under it. Hover: a photo lifts 16px and straightens. Scroll: the fan spreads from a stack to the arc over about 600px. Phone: 5 photos in a vertical stack with alternating tilt, 220px each, overlap 40px.
phone: Photos stack vertically with alternating tilt, 220px, overlapping 40px; headline 36px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the accent-coloured phrase in the headline (now one colour), the small label, the faint curved shape and the pin glyphs. Photographs must be lifestyle or place pictures, not archive documentary.

name: Headline, rounded video, three cards
description: Ground white, ink near-black, pale tint fills on the cards. Centred 64px two-line headline. 70px lower a video 1360x765 (radius 40, 40px insets), muted loop, with a solid round play button 88px centred. 84px under it three filled cards about 437x260 with 24px gaps (pale tint, radius 24): each a 24px title, a three-line 17px paragraph and a small cut-out picture or looping clip 96px at the bottom right. No icons. Scroll: the video grows from 1120 to 1360 wide as it enters, the cards rise 40px staggered. Phone: video 16:10 with a 64px play button, cards stacked with 16px gaps.
phone: Video 16:10, play button 64px, cards stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the animated icon trio: the unboxed icon-topped columns become three filled cards with a title, text and a small picture.

name: Headline over two tilted choice cards
description: Ground dark, one screen tall with about 190px of air above, ink off-white. A centred 58px one-line serif headline with a 20px one-line sub under it. 40px below, two portrait cards 300x450 stand 26px apart, tilted -4 and +4 degrees: one filled with the accent, one in a tone one step above the ground. Each holds a 32px title, a rendered 3D object or cut-out (about 160px) at the centre, a three-line 16px caption and a solid button 44px tall. Both cards rise 120px in from below as the band enters. Hover: the card straightens and lifts 16px while the other dims to 70%. Clicking a card scrolls to its matching following section. Phone: cards stack with a 24px overlap and plus or minus 2 degrees tilt, 300px wide, headline 34px.
phone: Cards stack vertically with 24px overlap and 2 degree tilt, 300px wide.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Both cards are filled, the object sits inside the card body, nothing is outlined or placed on a photograph.

name: Centred display title sheet
description: A sheet 520-680px tall on the ground (white or a tint): a 70-96px one- to three-line centred headline, 694-840px wide with tight tracking (-0.03em), sits 160px below the sheet top; an optional 20px three-line centred paragraph, 640px wide, 32px under it; then 170-210px of empty ground before the next block. It is a section opener with air: no label, no media, a button only if the page needs one. The words rise 24px in a 40ms stagger as it enters. Ink on ground.
phone: Headline 40px inside 20px gutters, paragraph 17px, 100px of ground below.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged an eyebrow: the 14px grey label above the headline is dropped.

name: Centred line over logo marquee
description: Plain ground, 160-220px tall at 1440 with 80px of air above and below. One centred short line, 24px, of at most eight words. 40px below, one single row of 12-20 logos or wordmarks (36-48px tall, 160px pitch, one colour in ink at 80%, so they read as one set) drifts sideways endlessly at about 40px per second inside the 1360px container, hard-clipped at the container edge rather than the screen edge. Hover pauses it. No boxes, no capsules. An optional 40px filled round pause button sits centred 32px below. Variants: each logo sits in a filled capsule (320x132, one end fully round, the other radius 16, a tint of the ground) and the row runs the full width with capsules fading out by position near both ends; or the row is a wordless 154px band that sticks to the bottom of the viewport while the section above is on screen, then scrolls away.
phone: The same drift at 32px tall logos inside 20px margins.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge touch. The row is clipped at the container margins, so nothing runs into the screen edge. Use real client marks supplied by the user or typeset wordmarks, never invented drawn marks, and keep it one row, never a grid wall.

name: Centred narrow caption-inside tile trio
description: Plain ground with 120px of air above. A centred row of three tiles (310x232 at 4:3, or 310x310 square) with 29px gutters, about 988px wide in all, so narrower than the container. An optional centred one-word 43px headline sits 40px above. Each tile is a photograph (radius 16) under one flat 30% dark tint with a 20px white name 20px in at the bottom left and a plain 24px arrow glyph at the bottom right (no circle). Hover: the picture scales 1.04 and the arrow slides 6px. Ink on ground for the headline.
phone: Tiles stack at full width inside 20px gutters at 4:3 with a 20px gap.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged a gradient. The dark bottom gradient is replaced by one flat tint and the circled arrow becomes a plain glyph.

name: Centred object slides aside for copy
description: Ground black, pinned for about 2 screens. State A: one rendered 3D object (about 885x640, lit inside the render, no CSS glow) at the centre of the screen with nothing else. As scroll passes 40% the object eases to the left and scales to about 40% of the width while a right column fades in from x 800: a 60px headline, a two-line paragraph and three filled mini-cards in a row, each a bold 20px title and a one-line 16px note, no icons. A dark band 120px high closes the bottom. Phone: the object shrinks to the top 42% of the screen, the copy stacks beneath and the mini-cards become a vertical list.
phone: Object at the top 42%, copy stacked beneath, mini-cards as a list.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the icon columns (icon-topped) and the glow (gradient) by using filled mini-cards and a render with its own lighting.

name: Portrait window, thumb strip
description: A dark ground. One 557x720 portrait photograph window is centred (radius 16, no frame line). A two-line 22px sentence-case label sits at the left, vertically centred, 80px from the edge. A strip of 148x192 thumbnails (radius 12, 14px apart) slides in from the right over about 500px of scroll and settles at mid-height to the right of the window, 80px from the right edge, with two thumbnails visible; it holds for about 1440px of scroll while the window crossfades to each thumbnail's picture in turn. It cannot be dragged. Light ink on the dark ground.
phone: The window at 80vw centred, the label above it, a row of three 96px thumbnails below it.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels. The label is 22px sentence case, the thin frame (an outlined box) is dropped, and the strip lands inside the margin instead of bleeding off the screen.

name: Centred title over three filled panels
description: Ground white, 114px top padding, ink near-black. Centred 70px two-line headline about 777px wide. Three filled panels 414x599 (light grey fill, radius 24, 24px gaps). Each panel has 40px padding: a 28px title, a four-line 17px paragraph, a photo 334x207 (radius 8) lower down and a full-width solid button 52px at the bottom. No label on top. Hover: the photo zooms 1.05 inside its crop and the button inverts. Scroll: the panels rise 40px with a 120ms stagger. Phone: panels stacked, full width minus 40px, photo 16:10, 16px gaps.
phone: Panels stacked, photo 16:10, button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Removed the small label at the top of each panel (eyebrow). A photo in a card is allowed; no boxes are placed on a photograph.

name: Centred video with caption row
description: Ground white, ink near-black, section about 780px tall with 160px of air above and below. One muted looping 16:9 video 900x506, no radius, centred and narrower than the container. 20px under it a row of three captions set in a 16px sentence-case sans (not mono, not caps): one aligned to the video left edge, one centred, one aligned to its right edge. Nothing else: no title, no slider. Scroll: the video scales from 0.88 to 1 as it enters and the captions fade in last. Phone: video full width minus 40px, the first two captions stacked left-aligned, the third dropped.
phone: Video full width minus 40px, two captions stacked below.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the mono type and tiny uppercase of the captions with a plain 16px sans.

name: Click to focus on a framed object
description: A full-screen 3D scene (a gallery, a room or a corridor, one flat ground colour) where the camera runs along a scroll-driven path past 5-8 framed objects (pictures, posters, products) on the walls. Clicking or tapping an object takes the camera off the path: over 1s (ease-in-out) it glides to face the object square-on while the field of view narrows from about 50 to 30 degrees so the object fills about 70% of the height; the rest of the room dims to 50%. A solid round close button 48px sits top right, 24px inset; closing or scrolling returns the camera to the nearest point on the path over 800ms. Hover: the object scales 1.03 and the pointer shows a plus. Needs WebGL, with a plain image grid as fallback. Phone: tap to focus, close button at the bottom centre, path driven by swipe.
phone: Tap to focus, close button bottom centre, swipe moves along the path; image grid fallback for low-power devices.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Objects are real pictures or products, not drawn; no boxes sit on photographs.

name: Opening frame with gooey word pills
description: A stage about 1.7 screens tall on the page ground. Top: a stack of two to four word pills, centred, each about 160 tall with one 96px heavy word (3 to 7 letters). Mix full-pill and 28px-radius shapes in two or three palette colours, ink picked for contrast. Each pill grows from 0.5 scale through an SVG gooey filter (blur 12, contrast matrix) and drops into place on a 120ms stagger, then the filter is removed so the final edges are crisp. Below the stack, 80px down, a frame 1280 wide by 760 tall (radius 24, centred) holds one looping clip or a still photo; it starts clipped to the middle 76% and opens to full width across the first 720px of scroll. The pills sit on the ground and never on the picture. Phone: three pills with 56px words, frame 4:5 at 16px margins opening from 80% to full width; swap the gooey filter for a plain scale-in if it janks.
phone: Three pills at 56px words, frame 4:5 opening from 80% to full width, plain scale-in if the filter janks.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged eyebrow, tiny caps, numbering, hairlines: the header label row and its rule are dropped; the pills sit on the ground so no box lies on a photograph. The idea (gooey pill growth plus an opening frame) is kept.

name: Closing headline over live 3D scene
description: The last full-viewport stop over a fixed WebGL scene (a live 3D landscape, or the products gathered into one object as the scene settles into a closing pose). One centred display headline of two to four words, 96-200px with line height about 0.9, sits at mid-screen in white or ink by contrast, optionally with a two-line 18px paragraph and one filled pill button under it. No cards and no link grid. The designed footer follows as its own section; this stop never replaces it. Scroll settles the scene over about one screen; the type fades up 24px over 500ms.
phone: Headline at 15vw (two to three lines), paragraph 16px, button full width inside 20px gutters; scene cropped to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The study's note that the page often has no separate footer does not apply: the footer is a designed section and follows this stop.

name: Colour band with mark between phrases
description: A full-bleed band about 600px tall, ground one tint of the brand colour, ink near-black. On the middle line a 32px sans phrase sits at the left, a 160px brand logomark (or a rendered object) at the centre and a 32px phrase at the right, so one sentence is broken around the mark; each side gets about 400px and the text is aligned toward the mark. A dark solid pill 200x56 is centred about 89% of the way down. Scroll: the phrases slide in 60px from outside and the mark turns 90 degrees. Phone: three centred lines (phrase, mark at 120px, phrase) and a full-width button.
phone: Phrase, mark 120px and phrase stacked and centred; button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mark must be the brand own logomark or a supplied render, never a drawn illustration.

name: Colour flood with rising panel
description: A scroll handover between a hero and the next section. As the reader leaves the hero the whole viewport floods to one flat accent colour (a colour tween over 600px of scroll, no gradient). A panel about 1150px wide with a large radius on its top-right corner only rises in from the left and settles 40px inside the left edge, holding a single 43px sentence of about 11 words at 50px inset (ink on the panel colour). The next content section starts 120px under the panel, and the panel colour equals that section ground so the handover reads as one object. Phone: the panel is full width minus 40px and the sentence is 28px, 8 words.
phone: Panel full width minus 40px, sentence 28px.
houseRuleCheck: A panel touching the left edge is moved 40px inside so nothing runs into one screen edge.

name: Stretched sentence, then columns
description: A panel in a chapter colour about 1216px wide slides in from the right (translate over about 900px of scroll) to rest with a 160px left offset and 64px from the right edge. It holds one black sentence stretched to fill the panel width, two to four lines, each line fitted so short words (three to six letters) span the whole width, type 160-300px, leading 0.9. 96px below, an editorial set of two to four columns of serif lead text, 28-30px, three or four lines each, with 14px sentence-case credits under them. 120px of ground below. Ink is black on the chapter colour; no accent needed.
phone: Panel at full width inside 16px gutters, the sentence fitted to the width in three to five lines, columns stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels and mono. The mono credits are 14px sentence case; no mono type. The panel keeps a margin at the right edge; it never touches the screen edge.

name: Colour band with text left and card row right
description: A full-width band in the accent colour (the section ground itself, edge to edge, not a rounded panel), about 620 tall with 120px above and below. Left: a 52px two-line headline and a three-line 18px paragraph, 350 wide, vertically centred from x 80. Right: three white cards, each 252 by 353 (a square picture over a 100px text block with a 20px title and one 15px line, 16px inner padding, radius 16), 24px apart from x 540 to about 1344, the whole row set 60px below the band top so it hangs low. With more than three cards add two 56px round arrow buttons under the row, right-aligned; the row steps one card at a time and no card is ever cut by the screen edge. Cards lift 8px on hover. Phone: headline and paragraph first, then a horizontal snap row of 260px cards inside the 20px padding, arrows hidden.
phone: Text first, then a snap row of 260px cards inside the padding; arrows hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged nested-boxes (white cards inside a rounded panel): the panel becomes the full-width section ground, so cards sit on a ground, not inside a box. The fourth card cut by the edge is dropped.

name: Colour panel, text left, media right
description: One rounded panel (radius 24, 1392 wide at 24px page margins, about 700 tall) in a single accent colour on the light page ground. Left, vertically centred from x 72 and 380 wide: a two-line bold headline at 56 to 64px, one 18px supporting line and a filled button in the ink colour. Right: a picture or looping clip 840 by 520 (radius 16) inset 90px from the panel top and 56px from its right edge, so it hangs a little below centre. On scroll the media rises 24px and scales from 0.94 to 1. Ink on the panel is the contrast colour of the accent. Phone: panel margin 16, text first, media at full panel width 4:3 beneath with 20px inner padding.
phone: Panel at 16px margin, text first, media 4:3 under it.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged eyebrow: the small label above the headline is removed; nothing else conflicts.

name: Colour tiles gathering on a centre square
description: Ground plain, no grid, pinned for about 1.5 screens. A centre square 360x360 holds only a brand mark at 96px. Four colour tiles (220x220, radius 24, fills from two or three tones of one palette) enter from beyond the four edges of the viewport and land against the four sides of the centre square with a 16px gap, each carrying a short 28px word or a cut-out picture in its corner (no drawn glyphs). Scroll drives the convergence with a slight overshoot; when the tiles arrive the centre square scales 1.06. Phone: tiles 130px around a 240px centre square.
phone: Tiles 130px around a 240px centre square; same convergence.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the 72px grid lines (hairlines), the drawn glyphs and the edge touch: the tiles start outside the viewport and end clear of it.

name: Compact centred header band
description: A short centred band, 220 to 280 tall, with 96px above and below so the cards that follow sit 96px away. Stack: a 32 to 36px two-line headline, 650 wide at most, in the display face at weight 500, then an optional 17px two- or three-line paragraph, 600 wide at most, in the soft ink. No label above and no rule below; separation is air only. Ground is the page ground, ink the page ink. It gives the cards under it a name without competing with hero scale. On scroll the headline rises 12px and fades in once. Phone: headline 26px, paragraph 16px, 24px side padding, 64px vertical padding.
phone: Headline 26px, paragraph 16px, 24px sides, 64px vertical padding.
houseRuleCheck: The optional small label and a closing 1px rule are dropped (eyebrow, hairline). Space was raised from 70 to 96px for the generous-space rule.

name: Pick-three builder filling a disc
description: Ground dark, no outer panel, ink off-white, one accent. Left side, 640px wide: a 100px three-line headline, then four filled product cards 130x260 with 16px gaps, each with a cut-out of the item, a 16px name and a 32px solid round plus button. Right side: a solid disc 580px, vertically centred, tone one step above the ground, with three dim filled slot ellipses (no outlines) that fill with the picked item cut-out with a 300ms pop as items are chosen. Under the disc a wide 56px button stays grey until three items are chosen, then takes the accent. A picked card dims. Phone: disc 240px on top with three slots, cards in a 2x2 grid, button sticky at the bottom, 56px.
phone: Disc on top at 240px, cards 2x2, sticky 56px button.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the dashed inner border, the outer panel (boxes in boxes), the ghost outlines and the numeral chip.

name: Copy left, dark form card right
description: A contact band about one screen tall on a light ground. Left half (x 80 to 640): a 44px two-line heading, one 18px lead line, a filled button and one mail link. Right half: one dark card (ink fill, 520 wide by about 540 tall, radius 20, 36px padding) holding a name field and a company field side by side, an email field, a message field 110 tall and a full-width submit in the accent colour at the foot. Fields are filled (a tint a step lighter than the card, radius 10, 52 tall), with no underlines and no outlines; a focused field brightens its fill and the submit lifts 2px on hover. Copy and card are vertically centred on one line with 120px above and below. Phone: copy first, card full width with fields stacked, submit 56 tall.
phone: Copy first, card full width, fields stacked, submit 56 tall.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines: underline fields become filled fields; the dashed-outline coupon variant is not used.

name: Ticket-style signup card
description: Ground a light paper tone or plain tint, one pinned screen. Left column (x 120, 560px wide): a 64px two-line headline and one 20px line, nothing else. Right column: a filled ticket card 520x360, radius 16, dark fill with light ink, with a semicircle notch cut from both sides at mid-height (CSS mask) like a coupon; inside, a 28px title, one email field (filled, 56px tall, 430px wide) and a 456x64 accent button beneath. Hover: the card tilts 2 degrees. On success the card flips to a one-line thank-you. Phone: stacked, headline 40px, card full width minus 40px.
phone: Headline above, ticket card full width minus 40px, field and button stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the dashed 2px outline and the scissors glyph with a filled notched card; cut the long copy run and logo lockup from the left column.

name: Copy left, layered collage right
description: Ground warm light. Left, from x 150: a 93px three-line title in one face, a two-line 20px paragraph and a 52px solid button; no label above. Right, inside a 60px margin: a layered collage of a 525x692 photo, a second picture (a product render or a printed piece, about 300x400, rotated 6 degrees) overlapping its lower right corner, a cut-out object overlapping the lower left (about 280px) and a smaller tile 180x180. Nothing is clipped by a screen edge. Scroll: each layer moves at its own rate, 1-2px per scroll step in opposite directions, for gentle depth. Hover: the top layer lifts 12px. Phone: title 40px, the collage below as a two-layer overlap of photo and one cut-out, 300px tall.
phone: Title 40px, then a two-layer collage 300px tall below.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the small caps label (eyebrow), the mixed faces in the title and the bleed past the right edge.

name: Corner fan of halving thumbnails
description: A list browser. Ground a flat colour that tweens in 500ms between three tints of the page palette, one assigned to each item (no blurred video, no gradient). A stage anchored to the bottom left, 40px inside the screen, draws squares that halve per list step: the current one 432px in the corner, the previous ones stacked upward (216, 108, 54) and the next ones running right along the bottom (216, 108, 54). Wheel or arrow keys step the list and the squares animate to their new size over 600ms ease-in-out. A 40px title of the current item sits at the top right. The fan shows while the wheel moves and fades 1.5s after it stops. Phone: current square 220px, vertical swipe steps the list.
phone: Current square 220px, swipe vertically, fan 108/54px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the 100px blurred video (glass-like colour field) with a flat colour tween, and the edge anchoring with a 40px inset. No counter is shown.

name: See-through gap, then three-third panel
description: Entered through a see-through gap: after a full-screen visual that stays held (sticky), about 70vh of nothing lets it show again before a panel scrolls up over it. The panel is a full-width band in a warm tint, 620px tall at 1440 with 60px of padding and 30px gutters, split into three equal thirds. Left: a 28px four-line paragraph and, at the bottom, a 48px filled button with square corners. Middle: a 16px sentence-case caption over a cover-fit portrait photograph that fills the rest of the height (radius 12). Right: two 48px display action links, stacked and right-aligned at the bottom, ink with an arrow. All three thirds are filled, none is empty. Hover: a link slides 12px right.
phone: The thirds stack: paragraph and button, the portrait at 4:5, then the two links left aligned; the gap shrinks to 40vh.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Keep the captions in sentence case at 16px or more and the photograph designed, not documentary.

name: Cover image with live type
description: A poster-like cover section (it also closes a run of pictures well): one portrait 4:5 image (about 640x800, centred, 40px from top and bottom) composed like a magazine or poster cover, with 3-4 live HTML text layers on it: a 56px two-line title, a 20px subline and a 24px corner title. The layers fade in while scaling from 0.9 to 1, staggered 120ms. Ink flips to suit the image (light on dark, dark on light). The cover needs its own composition and no mastheads. Phone: image full width minus 40px, title 36px.
phone: Image full width minus 40px, title 36px.
houseRuleCheck: Cut the eight text layers to three or four to keep text low. Text on a photograph is fine; no boxes sit on it.

name: Curtain wipe to 3D object on photo
description: A black ground slides in from the right over the previous scene as the scene begins (curtain wipe, flat edge, no gradient), pinned for about 3 screens. A fixed full-screen canvas spins one tall 3D object at the centre in front of an inset landscape or interior photo about 740x405; the object turns one full turn through the scroll while the photo moves at a slower rate. Left: a 54px two-word title, an 18px one-line blurb and a solid 161x60 pill. Right, in the lower half: one 20px line. Phone: object at 50% of the screen over the photo, text beneath.
phone: Object at 50% of the screen over the photo, title and button beneath, the right line dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the outlined pill and the two tiny labels; the right text is one 20px line. The photo must be atmospheric, not documentary.

name: Cutaway model with hotspots
description: Ground soft neutral or dark. A pinned canvas pulled back on one multi-storey cutaway model (about 860x690, centred) with colour-coded floors and rooms, rendered from a 3D model and not drawn. Every room carries a 36px solid dot hotspot with a slow pulse; hover shows a 16px name tag and click or tap flies the camera into that room over 900ms. At the bottom right three solid square tiles 52px (previous, next, overview) are the only controls; no dots pager and no text on the stage. The overview is the entry state; close-ups follow. Phone: model full width, hotspots 44px for touch, controls at the bottom centre.
phone: Model full width, 44px hotspots, controls at the bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The ring-only hotspot is replaced by a filled dot with a pulse; the dots pager is dropped.

name: Cut-out sequence between text beats
description: A full-width canvas plays a scroll-scrubbed turntable frame sequence (about 90-120 frames) of a cut-out object on a flat light ground. In each of three beats (about 900px of scroll) the object travels diagonally and turns across the frame while a 60px headline of two or three lines (plus a 18px paragraph or one button) appears in a different corner (right, lower left, upper right), 80px from the edges; at the end the object lifts away (translate -120%). Ink on ground, accent on the button.
phone: The object centred at 60vw, the text pinned at the bottom with 20px gutters; the same sequence.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Frames must be rendered or photographed against a clean ground; no drawn illustration.

name: Dark band, sticker left and logotype right
description: Ground dark, exactly one screen tall with 185px padding. The left third holds a 440x350 die-cut sticker image (a cut-out render or photograph with a thick white border, tilted 6 degrees, never a drawn illustration). On the right a 600px column centred on the vertical midline holds a logotype about 56px tall and, 50px below it, a solid button 294x50. Both groups sit on the midline. Hover: the sticker peels (rotates 12 degrees and lifts). Scroll: the sticker slaps in from 1.15 scale to 1. Phone: the sticker 280px on top, logotype and button centred beneath.
phone: Sticker 280px above, logotype and button centred below.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the italic caps line above the logotype; the white sticker must be a supplied image.

name: Dense five-column thumbnail index
description: Ground off-white, ink near-black, 200px top padding, 40px margins. Five columns of portrait thumbnails 240x336 (ratio 0.7, cover fit), 24px gutters and 40px between rows, 20-30 thumbnails over about 3 screens; under each a 14px sentence-case caption (the title only). Hover: the others dim to 40% while the hovered thumbnail scales 1.04 and its caption takes the accent. Scroll: rows rise staggered and the columns sit offset 0, 40, 0, 40, 0 for a gentle wave. Phone: two columns of 165x231 with 12px gutters.
phone: Two columns 165x231, 12px gutters, captions 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the tiny caps captions; the 65 items are cut to 20-30. An index of pictures only: keep the rest of the page text-light and spaced.

name: Headline over diagonal UI windows
description: Ground white, ink near-black, windows in one tint off white. A 125px two-line headline at the top left (80px margin), a 20px two-line paragraph and an arrow link under it. Two product windows on a diagonal: a large one about 566x387 at the upper right, inset 80px from the right edge, and a small one about 330x226 at the lower left, overlapping the headline zone by 40px but never covering text. Each window has a 36px plain title strip, a body showing a real product screen, radius 16, no shadow (a one-step darker ground separates it). Scroll: the two windows drift in opposite directions by 40px. Hover: a window rises 12px. Phone: headline 48px, the large window below at full width minus 40px, the small window overlapping its lower left at 60%.
phone: Headline 48px, the large window full width minus 40px, the small one overlapping at 60%.
houseRuleCheck: Dropped the icon tile, the rotated ribbon and the grey shapes cut by the edge (drawn shapes, edge touch). Window margins stay at least 80px.

name: Headline over unboxed cut-out grid
description: Ground white, ink near-black. A centred 76px condensed caps headline on one line. 90px below it a grid about 1000px wide of 2 rows x 6 cut-out objects (96px image boxes, 160px column pitch, 170px row pitch), each over a 16px sentence-case label. The objects are cut-out pictures or renders, not icons, and sit unboxed: no cards, no dividers. Hover: the object lifts 10px and turns 6 degrees and its label takes the accent. Scroll: objects pop in (scale 0.8 to 1) with a 40ms stagger. Phone: 3 columns x 4 rows, objects 80px.
phone: 3 columns by 4 rows, objects 80px, labels 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Objects must be pictures, not icons. The grid is one compact group, so it stays a group of cut-outs on the ground rather than a floating text list.

name: Display line straddling a scene seam
description: One line of four words in 141px thin all-caps (big, not small) centred over the seam between a dark scene and a light scene. The line has no ground of its own: the upper half of the glyphs sits on the dark ground in light ink and the lower half on the light ground in dark ink (two clipped copies or a difference blend). Nothing else sits with it. Scroll: the two halves shift 20px horizontally in opposite directions, a slight shear. Phone: two lines at 56px, still on the seam.
phone: Two lines 56px, still straddling the seam.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The caps are large, not tiny, and not letter-spaced.

name: Dive through a frame into the next scene
description: A 3D room scene on a fixed ground with one large framed picture at its end. Scrolling or clicking the frame sends the camera through it over about 3s (ease-in); a full-screen straight-edged curtain wipe in the accent colour (about 1.5s) covers the swap; the second scene is a different 3D space with its own explore state (drag or arrow keys to look around) and one 16px hint line that fades after the first input. A solid round back button 48px persists across both scenes. Fallback: a crossfade between two still renders. Phone: tap the frame to dive, swipe to look.
phone: Tap the frame to dive; swipe to look; back button bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No tutorial overlay or corner frame mark is kept; a single hint line replaces them.

name: Document zoom spotlighting one row
description: Ground flat dark. A document image panel about 792x828 (radius 8) slides in from the top left while its scan zooms from 1x to 2x onto one row; two dark bands close in from above and below until a single row about 82px high stays lit and the rest dims to 15%. A solid round close button 48px, a 20px caption and one 28px text beat sit at the left. At the end the panel shrinks to a corner thumbnail 120px, bottom right, 40px inset. No photograph behind the panel: the flat ground replaces the full-bleed picture. Fits an invoice, a contract, a ledger, a recipe card or a spec sheet. Pinned about 3 screens. Phone: panel full width, zoom 1.6x, caption beneath.
phone: Panel at full width, zoom 1.6x, caption beneath, thumbnail bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the box on a photograph (panel over a full-bleed picture) and the nested boxes; the panel is the only box and sits on a flat ground.

name: Twin columns of list-row cards
description: Ground white, ink near-black, pale fills on the rows. Two columns each 620px wide with a 40px gap and no frame or dotted rules. Each column: a centred 44px one-line title, then four filled row cards 620x90 (pale fill, radius 16) 8px apart, each with a 22px label and a short 16px note at the right. A solid button is centred 60px beneath both. It suits a comparison: before and after, for teams and for solo, monthly and yearly. Hover: the row fills with the accent. Scroll: left rows rise from the left, right rows from the right, staggered. Phone: the columns stack, the title left-aligned, rows 72px.
phone: Columns stacked, rows 72px, the button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the dotted frame, the dotted vertical and the dotted rules (hairlines, nested boxes). Rows are filled cards directly on the ground.

name: Drifting heading with list and offer cards
description: Ground one flat colour, no photograph behind. Two columns inside 80px margins. Left (x 80, 500px): a 52px two-line serif heading and a three-line 18px paragraph that drifts up more slowly than the page (speed 0.6), so it stays beside the list for longer. Right (x 660, 700px): a 52px list title, then three item cards 700x220 (soft fill, 246px pitch), each with a 32px two-line title and two lines of text, then two offer cards 700x96 filled in the accent, each with a title and a 44px button. Items stagger in at 100ms. Phone: the heading on top and static, items and offers stacked.
phone: Heading on top, static; items and offers stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the outlined offer rows (filled accent cards instead) and the cards over a painted photograph (flat ground replaces it).

name: Drivable 3D world
description: A full-screen canvas becomes a playable low-poly isometric world on one ground colour. The camera follows a small vehicle (arrow keys or WASD) across 6-14 themed areas, each tied to one piece of content, laid on one terrain; objects react with simple physics; weather and day or night follow the visitor clock. Edge tabs, as solid pills 44px at the screen margin, open a modal per area (a 60px title, three lines, a button). A start screen with one solid start button and a skip-to-list control comes first; a plain list is the fallback for reduced motion. Budget about 150k triangles at 60fps. Phone: tap a spot and the vehicle drives there; a bottom sheet lists the areas.
phone: Tap a destination to drive; a bottom sheet lists the areas.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A heavy build; the whole page becomes the scene, so use it as a one-off.

name: Echo type rows behind cut-outs
description: Pinned full screen on a plain ground. Five full-width rows inside 60px margins repeat the same four-word slogan at about 121px on a 142px pitch, each row in one colour, rows alternating ink and accent (no single word coloured on its own). Rows slide horizontally in alternating directions with scroll (200px each way). Two large overlapping cut-out figures (about 620px tall, photographs or renders) stand in front of the rows, resting on the bottom of the section. Hover: a figure leans toward the cursor. Phone: three rows at 64px, figures 380px.
phone: Three rows at 64px, figures 380px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the edge-pushing 3D letter and the per-word colours (colour sprawl); text stays within margins. Colour alternates per row, never per word, so no word is a styled accent word.

name: Image stack beside active text
description: A light full-width sheet in two halves, about four screens when four items run. Left half: a column of pictures 680 by 460 (radius 24), 20px apart, inset 40px from the screen edge so none touches it; a picture rests at 45% opacity and 0.97 scale and rises to full when it is current. Right half (x 780 to 1360): text items paired one to one with the pictures on a 480 pitch, each a 36px title and a three-line 17px paragraph, vertically centred on its picture; the current item is full ink and the others dim to 35%. No icon chips, numerals or rules. Pictures and text scroll together; current is the pair nearest the viewport centre. A second instance mirrors the sides. Phone: each item becomes a picture (4:3, full width at 16px margins) over its text, no dimming.
phone: Each item is picture over text at full width, no dimming.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch (pictures running to the screen edge): pictures are inset 40px and rounded on every corner. The 48px icon chip is dropped (icon-topped items).

name: Cut-outs closing on title columns
description: Ground one flat colour, pinned for about 1440px of scroll. Two background-free cut-outs about 350x816 stand 60px inside the left and right screen edges, facing each other, and slide inward 62px over the pin. Between them two 284px columns, each a 97px two-line title in one face (no serif and sans mix), a two-line 18px note and a 52px solid round arrow button, wiping in from opposite sides with a 500ms clip reveal. Phone: one cut-out above, the columns stacked, cut-outs 200px.
phone: One cut-out above, columns stacked, cut-out 200px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the mixed serif and sans title (styled accent) and the cut-outs touching the screen edges (60px inset).

name: Edge-split title above wide media
description: A page-ground section with 120px above. Two serif words in capitals, 96px, on one baseline: one flush with the left margin (x 48) and one flush with the right margin, leaving a wide gap between (each word 4 to 9 letters). 100px below, one wide render 1344 by 840 with square corners that scales from 0.88 to 1 as the section enters; under it two short 16px caption lines, one at each margin, in the soft ink. The words stay still and only the media moves. Ink is the strong ink; the media is a studio render, a product image or a made place, never a documentary photograph. Phone: words 44px on two rows (first left, second right), media 4:5 at 16px margins, captions stacked.
phone: Words 44px on two rows, media 4:5 at 16px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines: the caption rule is dropped; the captions stand on air.

name: Media halves with a top caption strip
description: Two media halves framed by a 24px page margin and an 8px gap, each about 690px wide and 100vh minus 48px tall, radius 24: a still photograph on the left and a dim looping video on the right. All text sits in a strip at the top inside the media, 48px down: one 20px serif line at the left and a text link with an arrow at the right; the media is darkened 25% for contrast, with no fill boxes on it. Scroll: both halves scale from 0.92 to 1. Hover: the video un-dims. Phone: two stacked halves 60vh each, the text on the top one.
phone: Two stacked halves 60vh each, text on the top one.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the edge touch with a 24px frame all round; the underlined caps link and three-line paragraph are cut to one line and one link.

name: Video rows, two then three
description: Ground white, ink near-black. Header: one 160px one-line word at the left and an arrow link at the right; no label or tag. Then muted looping videos inside 40px margins with 12px gutters: a row of two (about 674x380), then rows of three (about 445x250), 60px between rows, continuing in threes. Inside each video, 20px from the bottom left, a 16px two-line caption in light ink (video darkened 30%), and type plus duration at the bottom right; no tiny type. Hover: the video brightens and scales 1.03 inside its crop. Phone: one column, 16:9, captions inside.
phone: One column of 16:9 videos with captions inside.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the edge-to-edge gutterless run (40px margins, 12px gutters), the bracket tag, the small label and the count superscript.

name: Endless vertical poster wheel
description: A pinned stage (100vh) held for about seven screens on a near-black ground. About nine poster planes, each 85vh tall and about 1300 wide at 1440 (60px margin around, radius 12), are stacked vertically in an endless loop; wheel, arrow keys or swipe move the stack with inertia and wraps. A text layer inside each poster moves at 1.2x the poster for depth. Fast movement blurs the posters up to 8px and reveals them in strips; at rest they are sharp. A slim project list runs down the left side, 40px from the edge (15px sentence case, current name white, the rest at 40%, each with a 28px round thumbnail). A 56px round filled Continue button sits bottom right and releases the pin, so the wheel capture always has an exit. Phone: posters full width at 16px margins with a swipe wheel, list hidden, Continue button 48px.
phone: Full-width posters at 16px margins on a swipe wheel, list hidden, 48px Continue button.
houseRuleCheck: Caps index titles become sentence case, the hint card is dropped and an exit button is added so the section never traps the scroll. Pointer drag is left out (no drag rails); wheel, keys and swipe move it.

name: Equal three-column captioned grid
description: Ground light, ink near-black. A 48px one-line left-aligned heading at the top margin, no label. Nine equal filled cards in 3 columns of 411px with 24px gutters inside 80px margins; each card a pale fill, radius 20, a picture 387x258 inset 12px (radius 12) on top and a two-line 20px caption below with 20px padding. Hover: the picture scales 1.05 inside its crop and the card fill deepens. Scroll: rows rise 30px one after another. Phone: one column, pictures 16:10.
phone: One column, 16:10 pictures, captions 18px.
houseRuleCheck: Removed the small label above; captions sit in a filled card so text is not left floating. Only one grid of nine per page.

name: Detail panel with metadata and reviews
description: A detail panel for one item (a film, a product, a place) that opens from a list: 640px wide, radius 24, padding 48px, filled in a tint one step off the ground. From the top: a 56px title; a three-row metadata list of plain label and value pairs (label 16px grey on the left, value 20px on the right) with 16px gaps and no rules; a solid 52px explore button; two filled mini review cards, each a one-line 20px quote, a 16px name of who said it and a rating as plain text (4.8 of 5, no stars); a text close button at the bottom. It opens with a 400ms rise and fade while the list behind dims to 40%. Phone: a bottom sheet at 85% height with the same order.
phone: Bottom sheet at 85% height, same order.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the separator line (hairline) and the star graphics (icons); reviews are filled mini-cards, not boxes in boxes because the panel itself is the only outer container. Thin evidence: the sizes are a designed spec (moved out of the description by the critic).

name: Exploded model with part tags
description: Pinned about 4 screens. A shaded 3D object rises upright at the centre (about 450x800), the ground flips from dark to pale and the object turns to a pale clay render; a 40px heading and a one-line blurb sit top left. Parts (rings, gears, plates) float out to both sides on scroll, each tagged with a solid dot in one accent and a 16px sentence-case part name, then vanish one by one as the object closes up again. No meter, no progress card and no counting numbers. Phone: the object at 50% height, one part floating out at a time with its tag.
phone: Object at 50% of the height, one part with its tag at a time.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the progress and meter cards, the mono readouts and the count-up numbers; parts carry a plain name tag instead. A wireframe pass would be hairlines, so the object turns to a clay render instead.

name: Folder tabs over a one-question panel
description: Ground light, ink near-black. A centred one-word title about 98px and one 24px intro line beneath. Five folder tabs, each 59px tall, labelled with a one or two word topic (not numbers) and overlapping the previous by 15px, sit on a filled panel 830px wide (radius 8, square top-left so the first tab joins it). The active tab and the panel share one fill; inactive tabs are one step darker. The panel shows one question (32px) and its answer (18px, 3-4 lines) at a time with a 250ms cross-fade; no outline. Hover: an inactive tab lifts 4px. Phone: tabs wrap to two rows of 48px, panel full width minus 40px.
phone: Tabs wrap to two rows of 48px, panel full width minus 40px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the outlined panel (filled instead) and the numbered tabs (named by topic).

name: Giant word left, open answers right
description: Ground light, ink near-black. One giant word about 144px (one word such as questions) sticks at the left at x 80 for the whole run of the section so the left side is never empty. Right column x 666-1360 holds six filled Q&A cards (pale fill, radius 24, padding 40, 24px gaps), each a 32px two-line question and its 18px answer printed open 24px beneath, never folded, no glyph. Cards rise 40px staggered as they enter; hover deepens the fill. The section is about 2.2 screens tall. Phone: the word 64px on top, not sticky, cards stacked.
phone: Word 64px on top, cards stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the 1px rules (filled cards) and the 9-row length (six). The giant word is sticky so the left is never an empty column.

name: Heading over wide question bands with actions
description: Ground light, ink near-black. A two-line 52px heading inset at x 200. 130px below it five filled bands 1200x244 (pale fill, radius 24, 12px gaps); each holds a three or four line 32px serif question in a 400px column 48px in from the band left and, at x 580 inside the band, a 16px text action of two or three words with an arrow, level with the first line. Bands rise 80px and fade in with a 100ms stagger. Hover: the fill goes to the accent and the arrow slides 8px. Phone: bands stacked with 16px gaps, question 24px, the action beneath it.
phone: Bands stacked, question 24px, action beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the full-width 1px rules (filled bands) so the rows read as cards.

name: Contact card beside heading and accordion
description: Ground dark, a 4/8 split inside a 1280px container. Left rail (x 80, 400px): a sticky filled contact card (a tone one step above the ground, radius 24, padding 32) holding a 140px square portrait (radius 16), a two-line 18px grey note and a solid button; no label above. Right column (from x 494): a 73px three-line heading 650px wide, then six accordion rows as filled bars 56px tall, 8px apart: a one-line 18px question at the left and a 28px solid round plus button at the right that turns 45 degrees when open. One row is open at a time; the answer is 17px, up to 3 lines. Phone: the card on top, heading 40px, rows full width.
phone: Card on top, heading 40px, rows full width.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the dotted rules and the small label; rows are filled bars and the person card is a filled card, so there are no hairlines.

name: Title left, tabbed accordion right
description: Ground light. Left (x 70-560, sticky): a one-word 64px title and a two-line 18px note. Right (x 718, 652px): a row of four category tabs 52px tall (the active one filled dark, the others a pale fill), then five accordion rows 76px tall in a pale fill (radius 16, 8px gaps), each a 20px question and a plus at the right end. Picking a tab swaps the rows with a 250ms cross-fade. Phone: stacked, the tabs wrap two per row. Variant: on a dark ground with no tabs, a 96px title pinned for the run with a solid pill button and two 20px contact lines (a phone number and an email at normal size) under it.
phone: Stacked, tabs wrap two per row.
