houseRuleCheck: Designed out the outlined inactive tabs (pale fills) and the rule under each row; the title grows from 35px to 64px so the left is not thin.

name: Scene floating in black
description: About 1.5 screens on black. A 1180x770 scene (a render, a product shot or a photograph produced on a pure black background, so its edges merge into the ground with no CSS mask or gradient) sits at the top, centred. A 36px two-line title block in sentence case, with no raised label, sits near y 600. Over the first screen of scroll the scene slides down about 300px and fades to 0 while the title stays. Phone: the scene full width, title 26px.
phone: Scene full width, title 26px.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the feathered mask (gradient) by supplying an image whose own background is the ground colour; removed the raised label.

name: Film overlay with words lighting up
description: A click opens a full-screen dark overlay (800ms fade). A film about 720x500 (radius 16) plays at the right (x 760) while a statement of 25-35 words in 44px type, set at 25% opacity in a 620px column at the left, lights up word by word in time with the film and the text block travels upward. Controls are a solid round play and pause button 56px, a mute toggle and a solid round close button at the top right, 24px inset; no scrubber or volume slider. Phone: the film full width 16:9 at the top, the statement beneath at 22px.
phone: Film 16:9 on top, statement 22px beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the progress and volume sliders (drag rails) and cut the long statement to about 30 words.

name: Fixed text over a gliding scenery world
description: A pinned full-screen canvas of a layered landscape in haze: 5-6 scenery layers (trees, a building, hills, a ridge, a bridge) made as rendered or generated images with transparent edges, never drawn SVG, on three depth planes. A stanza of three or four short lines stays fixed at x 150, y 405 in 36px type directly on the scene with no box or fill behind it (ink chosen for contrast). Over about 750px of scroll per stanza the camera glides sideways at 0.3, 0.6 and 1.0 speed per plane; layers fade in and out through a flat translucent haze plane (no gradient). The next stanza replaces the previous with a 300ms cross-fade. Phone: text in the lower third at x 24, 24px.
phone: Text in the lower third, 24px; the same plane speeds.
houseRuleCheck: A text box over the scene becomes plain type with no box (no boxes on photographs), and the scenery layers must be rendered or generated images, not drawn SVG.

name: Flat screen with one centred line
description: One pinned viewport of a single flat ground, a saturated colour or black, optionally turning from one palette colour to another over the scroll. The only content is a short centred display line of 6 to 12 words in 1 or 2 lines at 60-120px, assembling character by character or from flipping glyphs (about 30ms per character). Nothing else is on screen. Ink and ground hold a contrast of 7:1 or more at every moment of a colour turn. It holds for about 1.2 screens.
phone: The line at 40px inside 20px gutters in up to four lines; same assembly.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict.

name: Flythrough with roaming title block
description: Pinned 3D flyover scenes (a WebGL landscape or city with the camera on a path), four or five of 100vh each. Each scene shows a one-word 72-104px title and a two- or three-line 16px paragraph at a different place per scene (centre, lower centre, lower left, right of centre), 64px or more from the edges. The text blurs in over 300ms and out as the camera follows the path. The scene is lit in one hue family; type is white or ink by contrast over a flat 20% tint. No icon, no kicker above the title.
phone: The block always sits at the bottom left with 24px gutters, title 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing, but the small outline diamond icon (an outlined drawn shape) and the kicker fixed at top centre (an eyebrow) would break the bans; both are dropped.

name: Footage shrinks to an orb in a phone
description: Pinned about 2.4 screens. The ground fades to near-black over the pin. Full-frame footage loses its frame, softens and is masked to a circle that shrinks from about 560px to 70px, while a phone mockup (a device render with the product UI on its screen) scales from 1 to 0.5 and drifts to the centre; the orb ends inside the phone screen. A 120px echo headline sits at 20% opacity in the bottom 260px for the whole pin (no blur). Phone: the phone at 60% width, headline 56px.
phone: Phone at 60% width, headline 56px.
houseRuleCheck: Replaced the blurred headline with a low-opacity one (glass-like blur dropped).

name: Four-column shearing drift grid
description: Ground black, 124px above and 325px below, ink off-white. Four columns of muted videos 296x220 with 32px gutters inside 80px margins, two rows about 340px apart. Under each video a 24px bold title at the left and a 16px client and year line at the right. While scrolling the columns drift at different speeds (about -250, 200, -150 and 130px over the section) so the grid shears. A solid two-state toggle pill (grid or list) is fixed at the bottom centre, 24px up. Hover: the video brightens. Phone: two columns, drift plus or minus 60px, the toggle dropped.
phone: Two columns, drift 60px, the toggle dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Fixed margins keep the grid off the screen edges; titles are 24px bold, not tiny caps.

name: Artwork grid with caption on top
description: Ground white, ink near-black. Four columns of cards 322x340 (24px gutters, 40px margins, 24px between rows). Each card is a filled card in a light tone, radius 16, with a 16px bold sentence-case caption at the top left (24px in) and the artwork beneath in a 16px inset frame area (ratio 1.12, radius 8). No bracketed index, no mono, no black border. Hover: the card shrinks to 0.95 while the picture zooms to 1.1 inside its crop. Phone: two columns of 165px cards.
phone: Two columns of 165px cards.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the bracketed mono index (numbering, mono) and the 5px black frame (outlined box) with a filled card around the picture.

name: Framed pairs with names
description: Three to four pinned beats on a white canvas, each about 1.3 screens. Each beat shows two portraits or artworks side by side, 400 by 520 each, 120px apart, centred, each held in a solid mat (a 20px band in a warm off-white fill, not a line). A 28px name sits above each picture and one 16px caption line below. As scroll advances, the next beat's names roll in from below while the previous roll out upward. A 40px opening sentence comes before the first beat and a 40px closing sentence after the last; the final beat ends with a zoom of one picture to full screen (scale about 2.4, 0.8s ease) that becomes the next section's ground. Phone: one picture per beat at 80% width, name above and caption below, the zoom replaced by a fade.
phone: One picture per beat at 80% width, name above, caption below, fade instead of zoom.
houseRuleCheck: Credit lines cut to one caption line (no credit walls); frames are filled mats, not outlined boxes; the pictures must be designed or studio images, never archive photographs. Thin evidence: the sizes are a designed spec (moved out of the description by the critic).

name: Framed slider between header and footer rows
description: One screen on a section ground one tone off the page ground (the ground itself, no inset panel), laid out as a three-row grid (header 1fr, slider auto, footer 1fr, 50px padding top and bottom). Header: one centred 28px statement. Middle: a centred slider of 4-6 cards 360x450 in a row with 20px gaps, the active one at full size and the others at 85%; it advances by clicking the next card, by arrow keys or by swipe, with no drag handle or rail. Footer: a centred solid pill and a one-line 16px note. A 158px round custom cursor reading next follows the pointer over the slider. Phone: no cursor, cards 70% wide, tap to advance.
phone: No cursor, cards 70% wide, tap or swipe to advance.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out the draggable rail: the slider advances by click, key or swipe and carries no handle. Nothing runs to the page edge. The inset background panel is dropped so the cards do not sit inside a box (no boxes in boxes).

name: Name list beside a large swapping frame
description: Dark ground (or one flat palette colour), about one screen tall with 120px of air above and below, in two columns. At one side a filled frame about 520x640 (radius 20) holds a muted looping video or a picture; at the other, from the sixth column, a stacked list of four to eight short names (one or two words each) at 64-88px in display weight with 0.95 leading. The active name is full ink and the others sit at 35% ink. Under the list a 17px paragraph of at most 25 words (three or four lines, 340px wide) changes with the name, then one filled pill button. Hover or tap on a name swaps the frame's media with a 400ms crossfade and swaps the paragraph; the first name is active on load. Variants: the frame grows into a very large picture or a real brand mark filling about 85% of its column; or scroll drives the list instead of hover (pinned for about 1250px, the name crossing mid-screen is active and the frame is a sticky 640x760 card that first shrinks from the full-screen picture into place). Ink near white on dark, one accent on the button fill only.
phone: Frame on top at full width less the margins (4:3); the names follow as a 40px list; a tap swaps the media and opens the paragraph under the tapped name; the button follows.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: a full-width hairline, a small number, a mono tag, a chamfered corner and a hard offset block (it reads as a hard shadow). The four names in one 120px row could not fit the column, so they stack as a list. The active state is ink against dim ink, not an accent word. Names are words, never numbers.

name: Framed parallax photo rows with info column
description: Light ground. Four to six case rows stacked about 120px apart (row pitch 500 to 560px). Each row has a 666x444 frame (radius 16) with its left edge at an 80px margin; its photograph is 25% taller than the frame and drifts about 100px up and down with scroll. On the right a 420px info column is centred on the frame's height: a 24px bold title, an 18px description of two lines, and one stat shown as a 24px figure on a filled chip (tone one step off the ground) with a 14px caption under it. Hover fades a muted looping video over the frame in 300ms, falling back to the photograph when no video exists. The photograph stays on the left in every row so the left side is never empty. Ink dark, accent only on the chip fill.
phone: Frame at full width less 32px (4:3) with the drift cut to 30px; the info stacks under it with the chip left-aligned; hover video skipped.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the index tag (numbering) and the dotted rule under each frame (hairline). The stat chip is a fill, not an outlined box. Photographs must be authored work shots, never archive or documentary pictures.

name: Framed render between halftone silhouettes
description: Pinned scene of about 220vh on a warm ground with flat grain (a noise texture, no fade). One picture (a product render, an object or an interior) starts full-bleed and shrinks to a centred plain picture about 914x570 (radius 12) as scroll advances. Two dark halftone cut-outs, each built from 3px vertical bars whose width follows the luminance of a photographed figure or object, overlap it: one behind the picture at the upper right, one in front at the lower left, each about 420px tall, drifting a few pixels against the scroll. No text at all. The halftone is generated in a canvas from a real cut-out photograph, never drawn by hand. Two tones only: ground and a dark ink. It works as a breather between a statement and a grid. Variant: one full-screen halftone of a landscape or scene photograph in two tones (bars about 6px), a flat light band over its top 35%, held for one screen as a wordless pause between chapters.
phone: Picture at 90% width (4:3); the silhouettes shrink to 40% of the screen width and keep the behind and in-front overlap; the pin is cut to 150vh.
houseRuleCheck: No ban is hit when the silhouettes come from photographed subjects; hand-drawn or traced silhouettes would break the drawn-shape ban. The grain is flat noise, not a gradient.

name: Image pan with text beats
description: Pinned stage of about 2900px of scroll. One tall dark full-bleed image, at least 160% of the screen height, pans upward about 640px and narrows 6% across the pin. Four beats of white text at 28 to 32px, 12 to 20 words each, sit in a 360px column at the left margin at mid-height and replace each other in place by opacity (320ms crossfade, one beat per 600 to 700px of scroll). The text sits straight on the picture with no box; the picture carries a flat 25% black tint (no gradient) so contrast stays at 7:1. The last beat ends with a filled white pill button. Ground is the photograph, ink white, accent only on the button.
phone: Column becomes full width less 24px margins with 24px text at the lower third; the pan is cut to 300px and the pin to about 2000px.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. No scrim box, the tint is a flat overlay on the picture. Four beats are told by the text, never by a counter or progress mark. The picture must be a crafted photograph, not an archive one.

name: Full-bleed intro film with skip
description: A pre-page state that follows a start action: the title group unmounts and one film plays full-bleed with cover fit (a landscape file above 768px wide, a portrait file below). A plain text skip control sits centred 100px above the bottom (80px on phone), 15px sentence case in white straight on the film with no box. When the film ends, or on skip, the page routes to the hero. Keep the film under about ten seconds, remember a skip in session storage so the film plays once per visit, and skip it automatically under reduced motion. Ground is the film, ink white, no accent.
phone: Portrait film file, skip 80px above the bottom, same behaviour; the film starts muted.
houseRuleCheck: The skip control is 15px sentence case, not a tiny uppercase label. The hero that follows must still fill the first screen alone. The film must be skippable by keyboard.

name: Photo close overlapped by footer sheet
description: The last scene before the footer. A dark full-bleed photograph about 1440x1010 with 24px rounded top corners scales from 1.2 to 1 as it enters. Centred near the top: a heading of up to four one-word lines at 112 to 128px bold, line height 0.9, about 450px wide; 32px under it a 19px paragraph of two or three lines in a 330px column; 32px under that a 182x42 filled pill button. The footer sheet (the designed footer on the ground colour, 24px rounded top corners) rises over the photograph's lower 190px so the picture reads as the page's final stage, with no gap between. Heading and paragraph white on a flat 30% dark grade, no gradient.
phone: Photo fills 100svh, heading 72px in the same one-word lines, paragraph 17px, and the footer sheet overlaps the lower 140px.
houseRuleCheck: No box on the photograph: the paragraph sits directly on the picture. The footer under it must be a designed section (links, a sign-up, one line of text), never a giant name or a credit wall.

name: Full-bleed picture shrinks into collage
description: Pinned scene of about 200vh that closes a full-bleed chapter. The full-bleed picture scales from 1 to 0.6 and gains a 24px radius while the light ground reappears around it at the sides. Three to five new pictures (portrait and landscape, 180 to 320px wide, radius 12) float in from the sides and from below at different speeds and settle around it in a loose collage with 40 to 80px gaps. Flat tone tiles, 8% darker than the ground, stand behind two of the pictures for depth. The scene ends as normal scroll returns on the finished collage. Ground light, ink dark, no accent needed.
phone: The picture shrinks to 0.8; the collage is three pictures stacked on a diagonal; the pin is cut to 150vh.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the chapter rail dot (a progress mark) and the outlined ghost frames (outlined boxes); the tone tiles are fills.

name: Tableau with notched exit
description: A pinned full-bleed painted or rendered image (a designed, painterly or 3D picture, not an archive photograph) with a centred caption 64px from the bottom: two or three 18px sentence-case lines about 396px wide in white over a flat 25% tint, rising in and out. On exit the image shrinks to 0.85, is clipped to a notched folder-tab silhouette (a clip-path with corner cuts and a centre notch about 60px deep, filled with the image, no outline), tilts back 6 degrees and lifts away over the page ground, while the next image rises as the same notched shape and flattens to full-bleed. Four or five images, one screen of scroll each.
phone: The same stage without the tilt; caption 16px at the bottom inside 20px gutters.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels, mono and numbering. Designed out: the small mono index with its square bullet is dropped and the caption is sentence case at 18px; the notched folder-tab outline becomes a plain clip-path with no stroke.

name: Full-bleed video, caption bottom-left
description: One full-bleed video block, about 125vh tall inside a 100vh frame so the clip drifts 12% as the page scrolls. At the bottom left, 48px from the left edge and 48px above the bottom, sit a 48px white two-line headline and, 20px under it, a 16px three-line paragraph 340px wide. At the bottom right, a filled white pill (dark ink text) with an arrow. Text sits straight on the footage under a flat 30% black tint, no gradient. The video is muted and looping with a poster picture for slow connections. Ground is the footage, ink white, accent only if the pill takes it. Variant: an art-directed still photograph (1440x720) in place of the video, scaling from 1.06 to 1 as it crosses the viewport.
phone: Video fills 100svh in a portrait crop; headline 36px, paragraph 16px, and the pill moves under the paragraph at full width less 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The outlined ghost pill becomes a filled pill, the 13px paragraph is raised to 16px, and the legibility comes from a flat tint, not a scrim gradient.

name: Colour card with stretched title
description: One screen of one strong flat colour (the page's single accent, or an ink block) with 120px of air above. A two-word title fills the whole container width (about 1344px) and about 500px of height, so the letters are tall and narrow: set it in a condensed or ultra-condensed display face and fit the size to the width with a measure script, scaling vertically by at most 1.4 and only if the face is drawn to take it. Ink on colour, nothing else on the screen. A masked media block (a video or picture, radius 24, about 70% of the width) follows and slides up over the bottom of the colour screen.
phone: The two words stack on two lines fitted to the width, still filling about 60% of the screen height; the media block follows at full width less 32px.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. One flat colour, no outline or gradient. A stretched title means a real condensed face, never a squashed normal one.

name: Cut-out layered over background photo
description: A layered break, one screen tall (900 at 1440), on a dark ground. A background photograph fills the screen at 110% height and drifts at 0.25 of scroll speed. Over it, a cut-out image of one object or person (about 620 tall, transparent edges, a photograph, not a drawn graphic) sits centre-right and drifts at 0.5 so the layers separate. At the lower left, about 20 words in white 20px, 460 wide, with one filled pill link under them. The photo carries a flat 30% tint for legibility. Phone: cut-out centred at 70% width over the photo, copy under the object on the dark ground.
phone: Cut-out centred at 70% width, copy below it on the dark ground.
houseRuleCheck: Low-evidence pattern; the geometry here is a design choice. No drawn graphic: the layered item is a cut-out photograph.

name: Photo shrinks to window over marquee
description: Pinned for about 720px of scroll. A full-screen portrait (or product) photograph shrinks to a centred window about 400x240 (radius 12) while the ground turns from light to dark ink. Behind the window a phrase of three to five words at 110px runs sideways as a 30s linear marquee wider than the screen, in the ground tone on ink once the ground has turned. The window stays sharp in front. After the pin, page content continues on the dark ground.
phone: The photograph shrinks to a window 70% wide by 120px tall; the marquee phrase is 64px; the pin is cut to 500px.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the self-drawing signature stroke (a drawn shape). A marquee crossing both edges is allowed; the phrase is short, not a sentence.

name: Full-screen single product slide
description: A full-screen overlay opened from a product row: one slide per variant (three to five), each filling the screen with the variant's colour as a flat ground. One product photograph sits centred at about 60% of the screen height, with an 85px title and a 17px sub line below or beside it in a darker tone of the variant colour. Arrow keys, two filled round buttons at the lower corners (previous and next, 56px) or a swipe change the slide with a 450ms push. Scrolling more than 10px or pressing escape closes the overlay and returns to the previous scene. No drag handle, no rail, no counter.
phone: Slides fill the screen height with the product at 50% and a 48px title; swipe horizontally; the two round buttons stay.
houseRuleCheck: Drag device removed: no draggable track, no pagination dots, no counter. Variant colours are the product's real colourways, kept to five or fewer, and the page around the overlay keeps its single accent.

name: Wide lead picture then three-up cards
description: A light band. A 32px heading at the left margin (x 80) with a 56px round down-arrow button at the right, 56px above one picture 1280 by 853 (ratio 1.5, radius 20) with a 16px caption line under it. 96px below, rows of three cards 413 wide on 20px gutters: each a filled card (radius 16) with a 4:3 picture over a 20px title and one 15px line. Cards rise 24px and fade in per row; two rows follow the lead. Ground is the page ground, card fill a tint of it, ink strong. Phone: lead picture 4:3 at 16px margins, cards in one column at full width, arrow hidden.
phone: Lead picture 4:3, cards in one column, arrow hidden.
houseRuleCheck: The small label and chip above the lead are replaced by a plain heading. No boxes sit on photographs, and the large open picture keeps the section from being only boxes.

name: Canvas chapters, fixed bottom caption
description: Full-screen 3D canvas chapters, about 3000px of scroll each and three or four in all: the camera travels through changing abstract scenes (ribbons, strands, blocks, ridges) that belong to one WebGL scene in one hue family. A caption block holds one fixed slot at bottom centre, 64px up from the bottom and 560px wide: a 44px headline, a two-line 18px paragraph and one filled button, all white over a flat 25% tint. The text swaps with a 300ms rise at each chapter change. No frame, no chapter markers, no rules, no progress, no readouts.
phone: The same bottom slot, headline 28px, button at full width; scene cropped to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines, progress bar, tiny uppercase labels and mono. Designed out: the HUD frame with chapter markers (a progress device), the rules and the mono readouts go. The idea (a caption locked to one slot over changing scenes) stays.

name: Looping full-screen video slides
description: Pinned stage, 100vh, with six to eight full-screen video slides in an endless loop. Each slide is footage in cover fit under a flat 25% tint with one centred white title of 64 to 96px (one to four words). One wheel burst, key press or vertical swipe steps one slide: the new clip fades in over 200ms while the old fades out over 300ms, and the slides wrap around. A filled white pill at the bottom centre (a verb) scrolls on to the next section so the loop never traps the visitor. No progress bar, no counter, no credits.
phone: A vertical swipe steps a slide; titles 44px; clips cropped to portrait.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the progress chrome, the index counter (numbering), the credit line and the hairlines at the edges. Needs the exit pill so wheel hijack cannot trap scroll.

name: Gate to scroll prompt with skip
description: After a click gate (needed because browsers block sound until a click) the title scene gives way to a prompt. Centred, 120px above the bottom: one 20px sentence-case line of at most six words and a 48px round filled button with a down arrow. A plain text skip action sits at the lower right and a sound on or off text control at the lower left, each 48px from the edges, 15px or larger. The story is then driven by the wheel or touch while the document height stays one screen; skip jumps to the end state. The prompt fades out after the first wheel input and never returns. No film plays here. Ground is the title scene, ink white or near black by scene, accent only on the round button.
phone: Same layout, the line reads as a swipe prompt; skip stays at the lower right, 24px from the edges.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. Skip and sound are sentence-case text at 15px or more, not tiny uppercase labels. Geometry here is designed, not measured. The story behind it must stay reachable by plain scroll or keys.

name: Giant headline beside inset portrait
description: The ground changes from one flat colour to a second flat tone along a straight hard edge as the section enters. At the left margin a two-line left-aligned headline of 160 to 200px (words of six letters or fewer), and 40px under it a 20px paragraph of two lines, 440px wide. At the right a 560x780 portrait photograph (radius 20) sits 64px from the right edge and 64px from the section top; the headline may overlap the portrait's left edge by up to 60px with the portrait behind it. The portrait rises 40px with scroll. Ink dark on light, accent only on one filled button if present.
phone: Headline 72 to 88px on top, the portrait at full width less 48px under it, the paragraph last.
houseRuleCheck: Edge contact fixed: the portrait stays 64px inside the right edge. The wavy ground edge (a drawn shape) and the small badge (an eyebrow) are dropped. The headline is plain type with no accent word.

name: Giant headline marquee row
description: About one screen on a flat ground. A thin-weight uppercase headline of four words at 140px is repeated three times in one row and slides sideways in a 20s linear loop, clipped symmetrically by both screen edges. 120px under it, at the left margin, a 28px sub line; at the right margin, a filled pill button. The row pauses on hover; under reduced motion it stops with the first copy centred. Ink dark, accent on the pill only. Variant: a high-contrast serif phrase at about 182px in a condensed cut (never a squashed normal face) runs as the only band at mid-height, with a share stack of a 16px line and three 44px filled round buttons in the bottom-left corner, 48px in.
phone: Headline 64px with a 28s loop; the sub and the button stack at the left margin under it.
houseRuleCheck: The edge flag is a marquee clipped by both edges, a continuing row, not a box stuck to one edge; the sub and the button keep 48px margins. The small captions around the row are dropped (less text).

name: Giant headline then sideways mixed-width card rail
description: Pale ground, pinned for about 1400px of scroll. A one-line headline of a few words at 130 to 142px across the container. 120px below it a row of three to five filled cards, 24px gaps, all about 520px tall: 392px-wide portrait picture cards with white text directly on the photograph, and one wide 783px split card (picture on one half, text on the other, two text tabs that swap its content). The first card starts at the left margin (48px); vertical scroll moves the row sideways, so cards pass behind the screen edges and the next one enters from the right, and the last card comes to rest 48px from the right edge.
phone: The pin is removed and the cards stack vertically at full width less 48px; the split card shows its tabs as two filled chips.
houseRuleCheck: The card cut by the right edge now ends with a 48px right margin. The sideways move is scroll-driven, with no drag handle, rail or progress bar. Cards are fills; no box sits on a photograph.

name: Giant stencil word over portrait
description: A panel inset 24px from the page edge on a light tint scrolls up over the previous scene. One giant uppercase word, 240px, in a heavy stencil or cut-letter display face, ink on ground, sits centred 120px below the panel top; a 22px two-line sentence-case subline is centred 28px under it; then a 672x896 portrait photograph (radius 12) is centred 72px below the subline. A 16px sentence-case caption sits beside the upper third of the photo at its right. A variant adds two smaller photos (240x320) in the outer columns at different heights. On entry the letters rise in a 60ms stagger and the portrait drifts at 0.9x scroll.
phone: The word fits the width (about 22vw, up to two lines), the portrait at 4:5 in full width under it, the caption below it.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow, numbering, tiny uppercase labels and mono. Designed out: the two bracketed mono labels are dropped and the caption is sentence case at 16px. The giant word is a section title, not a footer name.

name: Giant tonal word over tone card row
description: Dark ground. A two-word headline centred at 140px. 60px below it, one solid word about 400px tall spans the container width, filled in a tone one step off the ground (ink at about 12%), so it reads as a tonal backdrop of type. 75px lower, four filled cards, 330x560 each (radius 12, 12px gaps), centred; each card is a different tone of the page's one accent hue (four steps from light to deep) and holds a centred 36px title and a tilted product cut-out photograph. The cards rise 80px on entry and the row overflows the section bottom by about 180px, where the next section's ground slides over it.
phone: The tonal word is 140px tall; the four cards form a 2x2 grid about 165x260 each; the overflow is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Four unrelated colours (colour sprawl) become four tones of one hue. The small flourish above the headline is dropped (drawn shape). A stroke-only word would read as hairline outlines, so the giant word is a solid tonal fill.

name: Cursor-tilt cut-out between name and tag
description: A flat colour ground with a straight top edge. A one-word title at about 200px, centred. 200px below, a 56px two-line name at the left margin, a 56px role tag at the right margin (48px inside the edge), and between them a cut-out portrait about 480px tall that tilts up to 8 degrees toward the cursor with spring easing. Under it a 30px biography of two or three lines (at most 30 words) with a 120px first-line indent. The cut-out slides up 40px on scroll. Ink dark or white on the colour, no second accent.
phone: Title 88px; the name, the cut-out and the tag stack centred; no tilt, or a gentle device-tilt only after permission.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the notched top edge (a drawn shape) and the small label. The title is plain type. The cut-out needs a clean extraction, not a rough mask.

name: Giant title rows with pointer video preview
description: Five centred rows, each about 960x230 on a 260px pitch, on a flat ground with no fill. Each row has a 112px one-line title (line height 0.9, at most three words), under it a 17px description of up to two lines (at most 18 words) and a text link with an arrow. Hovering a row fades in a phone-shaped video (227x504, radius 31) that follows the pointer with spring easing (about 250ms lag) offset 24px from the cursor; leaving fades it out in 200ms. The rows themselves neither dim nor move; only the video responds.
phone: Rows left-aligned with 56px titles; tapping a row expands its video inline under the description (9:16, 60% width).
houseRuleCheck: Bare text rows with no fill are acceptable as a list, but keep titles to three words. The preview is a video, not a picture inside the headline.

name: Giant word then bare image scatter
description: White ground, about three screens tall. At the left margin one 250px one-word title. At x 940 a 24px paragraph of four lines (at most 28 words, 340px wide) ending in a text link with an arrow, underlined on hover. Then four bare portrait images (4:5, no frame, no caption) step down the page in loose columns at alternating x positions (about 80px, 860px, 380px and 960px; widths 320 to 440px) with about 160px of vertical air between them, each rising 40px on entry. The section ends on a second text link.
phone: Title 96px, paragraph under it, then the images at about 70% width alternating 15% to the left and right, 56px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label (eyebrow) and the ring bullet on the link (a drawn mark). The images must be authored editorial photographs, never archive or documentary pictures.

name: Globe with projected labels
description: Dark ground, about 2700px of pinned scroll. A WebGL globe fills the frame with its horizon near the top of the screen and turns slowly with scroll. A three-line 48px sentence-case statement (at most 14 words, about 820px wide) rises through the middle. Eight place labels in 17px sentence case, each on a small filled accent pill with a dot, are pinned to 3D points on the globe: they slide across the screen as it turns, fade from 40% to full as they face the camera and hide behind the limb. The scene ends on the dark limb. Ink white, accent on the label pills only.
phone: The globe is 120% of the screen width with four labels; the statement 32px; the pin is cut to 1800px.
houseRuleCheck: Twelve tiny uppercase labels become eight sentence-case labels at 17px, and the six-line uppercase statement becomes three lines. The globe is a WebGL render of data, not a drawn illustration.

name: Ground sheet slides over previous scene
description: A solid ground-colour sheet about two screens tall slides up over the previous scene by about 360px at its first scroll, while the previous scene scales to 0.94 and dims 20% under a flat overlay. The sheet has 32px rounded top corners and carries, top to bottom: a centred statement of 80 to 96px in three lines (at most 10 words), then a trio of pictures (the centre one 440x560, the two sides 320x420 set 60px lower, 24px gaps) and, 64px under them, a centred filled pill button. The pictures rise 30px each on a 120ms stagger. The statement can be rendered in WebGL for a gentle ripple on hover; plain type is fine.
phone: The sheet slides 200px; the statement is 44px; the pictures stack as one centre picture at 70% width with two small ones offset.
houseRuleCheck: The geometry of this scene was not recorded; this is a designed spec. No shadow under the sheet: the overlap reads from the colour change and the dim of the scene below.

name: Grouped lists, labels left, rows right
description: A text-only index on the page ground. Top: an 88px display title at the left margin (x 80); at the right a 17px two-line intro and one filled pill, both top-aligned. 96px below, groups stacked 88px apart. Each group: its name at the left in 28px medium (x 80); in the right half (x 720 to 1360) rows 60 tall with 8px between, each a filled tint bar (radius 12) with a 20px name at the left and an optional short note right-aligned in the soft ink. No counts, no rules, no icons. On hover a row fills with the accent and its name nudges 6px right. Rows reveal on a 40ms stagger. Phone: group name above its rows, rows full width at 56 tall, intro under the title.
phone: Group name above its rows, rows full width at 56 tall.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines: ruled rows become tint-filled rows with 8px gaps. The item counts (counters) are dropped. The left half carries group names, so no row sits empty on the left.

name: Half photo beside centred cut-out text half
description: Two halves at full screen height. The left 47% is a photograph inset 40px from the left, top and bottom edges (radius 20); its image drifts 5% inside the frame on scroll. The right half is one pale flat tone. Centred in it: a cut-out object or product photograph about 320px tall that turns 6 degrees on scroll, a 60px gap, a centred three-line 22px paragraph (at most 30 words, 420px wide), and a filled pill button. The right half's content slides up 30px as it enters. Ink dark on pale, accent only on the button.
phone: The photograph on top at 4:3 with 24px margins; the cut-out and the paragraph centred below.
houseRuleCheck: The dashed sunburst, the dot ornament and the stripes are drawn shapes and hairlines; a photographed cut-out object replaces them. The photograph no longer touches the screen edge.

name: Half-width row list beside a turning object
description: Dark ground. The list sits in the right 46% (x 760 to 1360), one 3D object turns in the left half. List: a 56px heading, then 12 to 16 rows 52 tall, 6px apart, each a filled bar (white at 8%, radius 10) with a name at the left in 17px, a short descriptor in the soft ink in the middle and an arrow at the end. Rows rise 20px on a 40ms stagger as the section enters; hovering a row fills it with the accent and the object takes the same colour. The object (a 3D model or a transparent turntable sequence, about 560 wide) spins with scroll; the stage is pinned for two screens while it makes a full turn and the rows come in. A mirrored instance puts the list at the left. Phone: object 220 tall, pinned small at the top, list full width below.
phone: Object 220 tall pinned small at the top, list full width below.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines and tiny caps: rules become filled rows, tiny caps columns become 15 to 17px sentence case, the bracketed count is dropped. The object sits beside the list so no text lies over it.

name: Header with arrows, captioned card row
description: Plain ground. A header row inside the 40px margins: a 44px title at the left, an optional 18px sub or text link, and two 48px filled round arrow buttons right-aligned on the same row. 48px below, one row of three filled cards, 440px wide with 20px gaps, so the row fills the 1360px container exactly. Each card has a 440x300 picture on top (16px corners) and, on the card fill under it, a 22px title and two or three 16px lines. The arrows page the row one card at a time (translate 460px over 500ms, ease); the row is clipped at the container margins, with no peeking card, no drag and no free scroll; an arrow dims at each end. Ink on card, accent on the arrows or none. Variants: portrait cards (400x560, photo over a 100px caption zone) under a centred 75px heading; or the header as a 300px column at the left with the arrows under it and two portrait cards in a 940px window that ends on the right margin.
phone: Cards stack one per row with 16:10 pictures and 20px gaps; the arrows are hidden.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge touch and drag rail. Designed out: the card peeking at the right screen edge is dropped, the row only steps by the arrows (no pointer drag, no free scroll rail), and the cards carry a fill so the captions are grouped with the pictures.

name: Header row over four portrait tiles
description: White ground. A header row 40 tall at 24px margins: a 24px serif category title at the left, and at the right one 15px sentence-case link with an arrow, underlined on hover only. 16px below, four portrait tiles 339 by 424 (ratio 0.8, radius 8), 12px apart across the full width at 24px margins; tiles carry no captions or controls, the picture is the content. The block repeats per category 72px apart (two or three categories). Hover scales the image to 1.04 inside its crop; the whole tile is a link. Phone: two-column grid of tiles with 12px gutters, header row stacked above.
phone: Two-column tile grid with 12px gutters, header row stacked above.
houseRuleCheck: The tiny caps underlined link becomes a 15px sentence-case link; margins widened from 10 to 24px.

name: Heading, copy, overlapping photo strip
description: Over a quiet ground (one flat colour, or a slow shader field in two flat tones): a two-line 50px headline at the left margin and, top-aligned in the right column, a 22px paragraph of three lines (at most 30 words, 520px wide). 96px below, a strip of three overlapping landscape photographs: the centre one 620x400, the two sides 480x320 tucked 80px under it with their tops offset 8 to 16px; each grows 4% as it passes the middle of the screen. A filled pill button closes the section, centred under the strip.
phone: Headline, then paragraph, stacked; the photographs stack with a 40px overlap, the centre one first.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the row of partner logos and the round social buttons (credit wall and clutter). Photographs must show real subjects, not archive documents.

name: Heading with boxed logo tiles
description: Ground one flat tone. At the top left a two-line 52px heading and, under it, one 18px sentence of up to 20 words (520px wide). 72px below, a grid of eight to twelve square tiles about 160x160 (radius 20, 16px gaps, six per row) in a dark tone one step off the ground, each holding a single-ink logo about 56px tall at 85% opacity that rises to 100% on hover. 160px of empty ground below the grid. Real marks only. Variants: a single row of five wider cells (about 262x88, radius 14) under a 38px title at the left; or the grid sits on a sheet that slides over the previous scene with a centred trapezoid notch (a clip-path, depth easing from 0 to 40px) in its top edge.
phone: Three tiles per row at 100px; heading 36px.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are fills with no outlines. Do not invent logos: with fewer than six real marks, skip the pattern. A grid of boxes is fine as one section, never as the whole page.

name: Headline over drifting portrait strip
description: Plain ground. A centred two-line headline at 96px. 96px below it, one row of about 20 tall portrait tiles (about 320x570, radius 32, 16px gaps) alternating muted video clips and stills, running symmetrically past both screen edges and drifting left at a constant 40px per second; it pauses on hover. Nothing else in the scene. Variant: a giant solid tonal word (about 400px tall, ink at about 12% on the ground) stands above the strip in place of the headline and rises 115px with scroll.
phone: Headline 44px; tiles 200x356; speed 30px per second.
houseRuleCheck: A strip clipped by both edges is a continuing row; no tile stops flush at one edge and there is no drag handle. Tiles are plain, with no tabs. The tiles must be authored pictures, not documentary photographs.

name: Headline over two touching giant pills
description: One screen with 150px of air at the bottom. Near the top a centred two-line call at 96px (about 970px wide). About 60% down, two touching shapes of about 640x170, centred as a pair with 80px margins: one a rounded rectangle (radius 32), one a full pill, in two different flat colours (the accent and an ink or paper tone). Each holds one verb at 96px and no icon. Each is a link; hover swaps the two fills with a 250ms colour change.
phone: The pills stack, each at full width less 48px by 120px tall and touching vertically; the words are 56px.
houseRuleCheck: Large flat fills acting as buttons are fine; two colours only, no outline, no shadow.

name: Image-left card two-by-three grid
description: White ground. A two-line 32px headline at the left margin. 160px below, a grid of six filled cards in two columns and three rows (each about 596 wide and 250 to 270 tall, 24px gaps, radius 20, a fill 3% off the ground). Each card has a 186px-wide picture flush left inside it (cover, radius 20) and, to its right, a 20px semibold title, a 16px grey paragraph of two or three lines (at most 18 words) and an underlined link with an arrow at the bottom. The cards rise 24px on a 80ms stagger.
phone: One column; each card at full width less 32px with a 96px picture at the left, or a 16:9 picture on top when the text needs room.
houseRuleCheck: Filled cards are wanted. No icon on top of a card, no outline; the grid is one section, never the whole page.

name: In-scene photo mode
description: Inside a live 3D scene (a WebGL canvas about 70% of the screen width, 24px margin, radius 20) a camera button at the lower right switches to photo mode. A filled controls panel to the right of the canvas (radius 20, 24px padding) fades in with four sliders (brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature), each with a 15px sentence-case label and a 240px track; they grade the canvas live. A round 64px shutter button at the bottom centre of the canvas freezes a snapshot, and a preview card in the panel offers save and share as filled pills. Leaving photo mode restores the scene.
phone: The controls become a bottom sheet of filled chips, one slider at a time; the shutter stays 64px.
houseRuleCheck: Icon-only sliders become labelled controls, and the controls sit beside the canvas, not boxed over it. A real 3D scene is needed to grade; without one do not deal this.

name: Chapters alternating sides, stepping upward
description: Over a full-screen 3D or rendered sky scene (clouds, dusk), four chapters of about 640px of scroll each. Each is a text block 590-725px wide: a 24px sentence-case name, a 40px two- or three-line uppercase statement and one plain text link, all white over a flat 25% tint. The chapters alternate between the left and right halves (80px from the edge) and each steps about 73px higher than the last, so the eye zigzags upward; each fades and rises 24px as it enters. No index, no rotated square, no numerals. The accent only on the link.
