houseRuleCheck: The study flagged numbering and tiny uppercase labels. The 79px rotated-square index with its number is dropped, and the name is 24px sentence case.

name: Heading and text columns over a scene
description: A dark atmospheric scene (a slow clip, a still or a WebGL backdrop in flat dark ink, no gradient) fills about 1.1 screens. A 50px two-line heading sits at the left (x 80); the whole second line is dimmed to 45%. 72px lower, three text columns: a 445-wide paragraph at x 80 and one or two 260-wide columns at x 672 and x 1000 (17px, four lines each), each opening with a 20px bold lead-in in place of any label. No index mark and no rule; the columns rise 16px and fade in on a 100ms stagger. Phone: heading 34px, columns stacked at 24px margins with 32px between.
phone: Heading 34px, columns stacked at 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged numbering and hairlines: the rotated-square index and the 1px line are dropped. The second line dims as a whole line, not as one accent word.

name: Black panel with edge-crossing photo frames
description: On a pale ground, a black panel inset 36px from the sides (about 1368x560, radius 12) clips everything inside it. Centred in it: a three-line white uppercase title at 90px (short words) and one filled pill button under it. Three portrait photographs (4:5, radius 12, each 260 to 300px wide) move through the panel: one crosses the top edge at the left, one crosses the bottom edge at the right, and one crosses the top edge at the far right, so the title and button stay on clear black. They are cropped by the panel's edges and drift vertically about 80px at different speeds with scroll.
phone: Panel at full width less 32px and 480px tall; two photographs only, one crossing each edge; title 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px outline on the photo frames is dropped (outlined boxes). The photographs are clipped by the panel and carry no box. A 90px uppercase title is large type, not a tiny label.

name: Inset dark banner with one small row
description: A black panel inset 24px from the sides (about 1392x450, radius 16) on the page ground. One centred horizontal row sits at its vertical middle: a 22px phrase in white, a second 22px phrase in white at 60% (each at most six words) and a filled white pill with dark text and an arrow chip. The rest of the panel stays empty by design. The row fades up 16px when the panel is 60% in view.
phone: The panel is full width less 32px and 320px tall; the row stacks as phrase, phrase, then the pill at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The outlined pill becomes a filled pill, the 14px text is raised to 22px, and the second phrase is muted instead of accent-coloured so it is not a styled accent word. Two short phrases at most: a call, not a paragraph.

name: Inset full-screen photo with bottom caption
description: A pinned full-screen studio photograph inset 32px at the sides and the bottom and 24px below the top of the viewport (radius 24), held for about one and a half screens. A cut-out object photograph (the page's subject, 360px wide) enters from a lower corner and settles in the lower third. Caption at the bottom centre: a 36px uppercase title about 100px above the bottom and, under it, a 20px underlined link, white on the photograph under a flat 25% dark grade.
phone: Inset 16px; the title 26px; the cut-out 160px; the pin is cut to 120vh.
houseRuleCheck: The 5px inset is widened to 32px so nothing touches the edge. The motif band and the 3D letter shape are dropped (drawn shapes). The caption sits straight on the photograph, no box.

name: Inset band: heading, image, copy
description: A dark band inset 20px from the sides (about 1400x448, radius 20). Three zones across it: at the left, 120px in, a two-line white heading at 40px; in the middle third a cut-out product or render about 360px tall, cropped by the band's top or bottom edge and moving 20px against the scroll; at the right a 17px paragraph of three or four lines (at most 30 words, 340px wide) with a filled pill button under it. Ink white on the dark ground, accent on the button only.
phone: Heading, image and paragraph stack inside the band (full width less 24px), the image cropped by the band's bottom edge.
houseRuleCheck: The flat illustration (a drawn picture) is replaced by a photograph or render; the coloured rule (hairline) and the translucent chip (glass) are dropped.

name: Inset rounded video with caption
description: One video about 1408x792 with 16px side margins (radius 16), muted and autoplaying. At the bottom left, 32px in, a four-word 24px white caption sits straight on the footage under a flat 25% black tint (no gradient, no line). As scroll continues the clip dims to 40% brightness, a second caption of up to five words fades in at the centre at 36px, and the frame scales down to 0.92 as the next section rises over it. Variant: a 30px three-line statement in the top-left corner and an 18px three-line paragraph in the bottom-left corner, 40px in, with the video parallaxing 8% inside the panel.
phone: The frame is full width less 32px in a 4:5 crop; the caption 20px.
houseRuleCheck: The 1px line above the caption (hairline) and the dark gradient behind it (gradient) are dropped; a flat tint carries the legibility.

name: Inset shader panel with centred line
description: A framed WebGL panel about 1368x760 (radius 16) set 24px from the edges, running a slow shader of three hard-edged flat colour fields (posterised bands, no smooth blends) whose borders drift 20 to 40px per second. Centred 40px below the panel top, a 28px two-word line in white; at the panel's vertical middle, one white uppercase line of at most four words at 96px. Nothing crosses the panel edge.
phone: The panel is full width less 24px by 70svh; the lines are 28px and 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The smooth three-colour gradient is replaced by hard-edged posterised fields; any smooth blend in the shader would break the gradient ban. Keep to the page palette plus at most one accent. Drifting discs and thin slivers are left out (drawn shapes, hairlines).

name: Inside-ring 3D photo gallery
description: A full-screen WebGL canvas with the camera at the centre of a ring of about 12 bent photograph planes (each about 2.4 by 3 metres in scene space, ring radius 5 metres) at three alternating heights. The camera looks slightly down, so three or four planes show: left low and large, centre high, right cropped by the screen edge as it turns. The wheel or a swipe spins the ring with damped velocity (friction about 0.92) and eases to the nearest plane when idle; hovering a plane scales it 1.05. A one-line 18px sentence-case caption for the plane in focus sits at the bottom centre and a filled pill reading back sits at the top left.
phone: The same canvas; a swipe spins the ring; four planes visible; caption 16px.
houseRuleCheck: The dial-style menu with small uppercase labels is dropped. A plane cropped by the screen edge is how a 3D ring reads, not a box stuck to one edge. Images must be authored photographs, not archive documents.

name: Giant headline over tilted photo row
description: Cream ground. A centred two-line headline at 200px in one flat accent colour (no outline), 140px from the top; under it a 24px two-line paragraph (at most 22 words, 580px wide) and a large filled pill (220x64). 120px below, a row of five photo tiles, each 290x380 (radius 16) and rotated between -5 and +5 degrees, overlapping by 20px and centred, the first and last bleeding about 30% past the screen edges on both sides. Tiles straighten to 0 degrees on hover in 300ms. The row drifts 40px against the scroll.
phone: Headline 80px; tiles 180x240 with three visible and centred.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the tilted badge at the top (an eyebrow label) and the white outline on the headline. The tilt sits on photographs only.

name: Blend-window heading over portrait columns
description: A pale ground slides up with a hard straight edge. A centred three-line uppercase heading at 150px (line height 0.85, at most 1000px wide) acts as a window: its letters show a moving field behind them (a slow shader of two or three flat colour patches), through background clipping or a blend mode. 200px below, three portrait columns spread across the container with 48px margins, each a photograph about 448x480 over a 32px name strip in 16px sentence case on a filled tone, drifting at different scroll speeds (0.9, 1.0 and 1.1). A text link with an arrow sits at the left under the heading.
phone: Heading 64px on three lines; the portraits become a single column of three at 80% width with the speed split reduced.
houseRuleCheck: The window shows a flat-colour moving field, not a photograph, to stay clear of a picture inside a headline; any smooth blend would be a gradient. The small label and the bracketed link are dropped.

name: Click-start camera dolly with guide frame
description: A pinned 3D canvas, or a pre-rendered film of the same move: a start click locks the wheel and runs an 8s camera dolly through opening doors into a hall. A tutorial follows: a small second canvas at the bottom left holds a guide figure (about 160x220) and beside it sits a 470x252 filled card (radius 16, accent fill, no glow) with an 18px two-line message and a 16px sentence-case name line. A text skip control sits at the bottom right. After the tutorial the wheel is released.
phone: The guide is 120px and the card is full width less 48px at the bottom; the camera path is unchanged.
houseRuleCheck: The glowing chamfered frame (a glow is a shadow at rest) becomes a flat filled card. It needs real 3D assets or a rendered film; without them do not deal this. A skip is mandatory.

name: Giant paragraph over tile and link column
description: Light ground. A statement paragraph of three lines at 64px in a condensed serif across the container (at most 18 words), plain with no inline marks. 56px under it, at the left margin, a 440px black tile (radius 16) holding a cut-out figure or product photograph that rises 30px on scroll, with a two-line 18px caption under the tile (its second line indented 24px). At x 560 a 640px column holds a 24px paragraph of two or three lines (at most 24 words) and two stacked filled link rows (62px tall, radius 16, a tone one step off the ground), each with a 20px title and an arrow at the right.
phone: The paragraph 36px; the tile at full width; the column stacked under it with the link rows at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px rule, the ruled link rows and the inline glyph tags are dropped (hairlines and drawn marks). The tile and the column start at the left so no row is empty at the left. Link rows are fills, not outlined boxes, and no box is nested inside the tile.

name: Giant title, tilted photo pair, copy and lists
description: Off-white ground. A two-line 175px two-word title at the left margin (48px in). Under it, the left half (about 640px wide) holds two overlapping portraits (about 520x700 and 480x660), the second rotated about 5 degrees and overlapping the first by 80px. The right half, from x 780, has a 22px four-line paragraph (at most 32 words, 540px wide) and two columns of 16px underlined text links, four or five items each, 24px apart. The photographs rise 40px on a stagger.
phone: Title 80px; the photographs stacked with the same overlap; the paragraph; then one column of links.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label; the 10px link lists are raised to 16px and cut from seven and fourteen items to five each (clutter); the title margin is raised from 8px to 48px.

name: Left statement over reactive relief canvas
description: A full-screen WebGL ground of pale embossed relief lit from the upper left, built as hard-edged facets in two or three flat tones (no smooth shading blend). A four-line 52px statement 552px wide at x 135, just below centre, rises into place on the first scroll; a filled pill button sits 32px under it. The relief fractures into tiles that tilt away with scroll and part around the cursor within a 200px radius, easing back in 600ms.
phone: The statement is 32px in the lower third; the relief tiles are about 120px and tilt with scroll only, no cursor.
houseRuleCheck: The embossed lighting is built from flat facet tones, not a smooth gradient and not a drop shadow. The 14px hint line is dropped.

name: Lone description after pinned stage
description: About 120px of top padding, then one left-aligned paragraph in grid columns 1 to 5 (about 480px wide) at 20px with 1.5 line height, four or five lines (at most 40 words). Nothing else: the section ends at the text with 200px of ground below. It is a quiet breath after a heavy pinned scene and fades up 16px on entry. Ink dark or white by ground, no accent.
phone: Full width less 48px at 18px.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. The 16px paragraph is raised to 20px. It is a pause and must follow a loud scene; never deal it on its own.

name: Narrow centred column with margin photos
description: A centred column 460px wide with 24px gaps: a three-line heavy uppercase headline at 100px (short words), a 26px paragraph of three or four lines (at most 24 words, left aligned) and a filled pill. Two photographs, 220x306 (radius 12), sit absolutely in the side margins at x 64 and x 1156 and rise from 160px below on entry with a 150ms stagger, so one trails lower; the column drifts up 120px on entry. Flat ground.
phone: The column at full width less 48px; the photographs, 140x200, overlap the top corners of the headline, one left and one right, above the column.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small bracketed label and the one-line note. The side photographs move from 20px to 64px from the edges. No box on a photograph.

name: Offset title, side copy, cascading photos
description: About two screens on one flat ground. A one-word title at 96px at x 96 and, at x 954, a side block with an 18px paragraph of three lines (420px wide, at most 24 words) and a filled pill. Below, photographs cascade down and to the right: 640x560 near the left margin (x 48), 360x214 in the middle, two smaller ones (about 220x280 and 260x180) and a tall portrait (300x460) at the far right, 48px from the edge, each rising 40px on a stagger. Then three statement rows 160px apart, each a filled card (radius 16, a tone one step off the ground): a 20px label at x 90, an 18px text at x 490 and a 56px year range at the right.
phone: Title 64px, paragraph, then the photographs as a staircase alternating 12% offsets; the statement rows stack with the year above the text.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the small label over the paragraph; the outlined pill becomes filled; the rows are fills, not ruled. The year range is a date, not a counter.

name: Offset title over stepped text columns
description: About 2.2 screens on a warm ground. A two-line 140px serif title at x 736. At the left, from x 48, a tall portrait photograph or cut-out about 300x520 fills the left quarter. Two 320px text columns sit at x 376 and x 736, the second 40px lower so they step down from each other; each has a 48px serif title, a 20px gap and a 17px paragraph of five lines (at most 36 words). Media follow below at the full container width.
phone: The photograph first, then the title, then the two columns stacked with the 40px step as a left indent alternating 0 and 24px.
houseRuleCheck: Left out: the empty left quarter (a row empty at the left; a photograph fills it), the 48px rule (hairline), the byline, the halftone fragment and the small-caps paragraph; paragraphs are regular sentence-case 17px.

name: Photo band over left headline
description: A tall stage on a flat-grain ground. A full-bleed photograph band, 1440x400, runs across the top, clipped by both edges and drifting 5% against the scroll. 96px below it, a left-aligned two or three-line headline at 80px at the left margin and, in the right column from x 740, a 20px paragraph of four lines (at most 34 words, 560px wide) with a text link under it. Ink dark, accent on the link only.
phone: The band is full width by 240px tall; the headline 44px; the paragraph stacked under it.
houseRuleCheck: Clear. The grain is flat noise. A band clipped by both edges is a full-bleed band, not a box stopped flush at one edge.

name: Rounded panel rising over hero
description: A cream panel with 44px top corners slides up over the hero as the page scrolls; its top edge settles about 90px below the top of the screen. 100px under that edge, a three-line 28px paragraph (at most 24 words, 534px wide) at x 108 and, 28px under it, a 192x62 filled pill button. The hero's cut-out figure photograph continues at the lower right, in front of the panel, about 520px wide and cut by the bottom of the screen. Ground cream, ink dark, accent on the button only.
phone: The panel's top edge at 60px; the paragraph 22px; the figure 260px at the bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: The hero still fills the first screen alone on load; the panel appears only on scroll. No shadow under the panel: the overlap reads from the colour change.

name: Heading left, twin text columns right
description: Flat ground with 96px of air at the top. A three-line 40px heading at the left margin (48px in, about 300px wide). To the right, two filled cards about 332px wide at x 700 and x 1060 (28px gap, radius 16, a tone one step off the ground, 24px padding), each holding a 22px semibold lead line and a 17px paragraph of three lines (at most 24 words). 240px of empty ground below. Ink dark, no accent.
phone: The heading, then the two cards stacked at full width less 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The 1px rule is dropped (hairline). The 13.5px eight-line paragraphs are cut to 17px three-line paragraphs (less text) and set on filled cards for grouping.

name: Heavy display statement paragraph
description: A statement section that is one paragraph and nothing else, about 400px tall at 1440 (160px padding above and below) on the plain page ground. One paragraph of 18 to 28 words set at 48px/1.12 semibold, left aligned at the 64px margin, about 1100px wide, four lines at most; there is no separate headline, label or date. Ink roles: the whole paragraph starts dim (ink at 28% on the ground) and each word lifts to full ink in reading order as the block crosses the viewport (about 120ms per word, finished when the block centre passes 40% of the screen height); every word gets the same treatment, none is coloured or styled alone. Use it as a breath between two heavier sections: say plainly who the page is for or what it believes. Phone: 28px/1.15, full width inside 20px margins, six lines at most, same word-by-word lift driven by scroll. Variants (one per page at most): 44-78px across the full container; the first line indented 140-280px; the fill per character instead of per word; a sticky stage that holds the paragraph until the last word fills (about 250svh); the paragraph set low in a sheet that slides over the previous scene with its upper 420px left empty; or static with no reveal.
phone: 28px type over six lines at most, 20px side margins, the word-by-word lift is tied to scroll position.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for the top hairline and for text weight. The rule is dropped (space separates the block), the paragraph is cut from about 70 to 18-28 words, and the small raised label and date are dropped. The idea (one heavy display paragraph, no headline and body split) is intact.

name: Text tile beside a live map tile
description: Two filled tiles side by side, 12px apart, the pair spanning the 1312px container and 480px tall at 1440, radius 32. Left tile about 500px wide, filled in the accent tone with contrasting ink: a 36px/1.1 two-line heading at the top left with 32px padding, one 16px two-line sentence under it, and two small filled status chips (for example open today, next free slot) at the bottom in the page-ground tone. Right tile about 780px: a live interactive vector map in a muted palette-matched style, centred on the real place, a pair of 40px round zoom buttons at the lower right and one filled marker chip on the pin. The map only takes scroll after a click so the page never gets stuck. Entrance: both tiles rise 24px and fade, 90ms apart. Phone: stack the tiles with a 12px gap, text tile first at auto height, map tile 360px tall with a tap-to-activate layer. Variant: a square map card (side about 820px, deep ink fill, radius 24) across seven columns with 18px accent dot pins that open a small filled name card on hover or tap, and a 3-5 word headline plus one 17px line in the other five columns; or the same card opened as a modal from a pill button over a flat 60% ink backdrop.
phone: Tiles stack: text tile first, map tile 360px tall with tap to activate, 12px gap.
houseRuleCheck: The outline tag pill is dropped (no outlined boxes, no eyebrow); the status chips are filled. The map must be a real map embed in the page palette, not a drawn illustration. Two filled tiles are one section, not a page of boxes.

name: Tilted sheet rising over the video
description: A cover-up that carries the page out of a full-screen video scene. A flat sheet in the lightest ground tone, rotated 2 degrees so its top edge rises left to right, slides up over the video as you scroll and levels to 0 degrees as it fills the screen (about 80vh of scroll, ease-out); the video behind stays unfiltered. On the sheet: a 160px/0.95 heading of one to three words with tight tracking (-0.04em), sitting fully inside the 64px margin; under it a 24px one-line sub and two small underlined text links with arrows, all in near-black ink. The sheet is 360px tall at first and grows with its content. Phone: heading 64px, tilt 1.5 degrees, the two links stack under the sub.
phone: Heading 64px, tilt eased to 1.5 degrees, links stack under the sub.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for edge-touch: a heading starting 12px outside the left edge would cut its first letter. Designed out: the heading sits on the 64px margin and reads whole; the tilted cover-up stays. The bracketed count is dropped (no counters).

name: Title over a darkening photo with copy and links
description: The hero photo carries on as a pinned stage for about one extra screen of scroll. The photo stays full bleed while a flat dark tint rises from 0 to 45% black (a solid overlay, no gradient). Over it two title lines at 200px/0.9 in light ink, one or two words each, cross the upper half sliding 120px left against the scroll. Lower left at the 64px margin: a 22px three-line paragraph (22 words at most, 440px wide) and one underlined link. Lower right from x about 940: a list of four links in 28px and a 16px contact column beside it. Hover: link underline draws left to right in 250ms. Phone: photo stays, title 72px over two lines at the top, paragraph and links stack at the bottom, contact lines last.
phone: Title 72px in two lines at the top, paragraph, links and contact lines stack at the bottom over the tinted photo.
houseRuleCheck: The paragraph is cut from five lines to three and the tint is flat. No box sits on the photo; links and contact lines are plain text. The photo must be art-directed, not documentary.

name: Table rows that invert, with a cursor image
description: A project or catalogue index as full-width filled rows. Above the list a 48px heading at the left and one filled button at the right margin. Then 8 to 10 rows, each 80px tall, 8px apart, radius 16, filled one tone off the ground, spanning the 1312px container: the title in 22px medium (about five columns), the client or category in 16px (three columns), two short 14px tags (two columns) and a 40px round arrow chip at the right end. On hover (fine pointers only) the row fill swaps to ink, the text to the ground tone and the chip to accent, in 200ms, and a 300x380 image follows the cursor with a 0.15 lerp, scaling 0.9 to 1 and tilting up to 4 degrees with velocity; it hides when the pointer leaves the list. Rows enter with a 16px rise, 40ms apart. Phone: no cursor image; each row is a filled card with a 72px square thumbnail at the left, an 18px title and one tag line; tap opens the page.
phone: Rows become filled cards with a 72px thumbnail and one tag line; the cursor image is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines: the 1px row rules and the id column (numbering) are dropped, rows are filled bars separated by 8px of space. The script label is dropped.

name: Iris opening over a cursor-reactive portrait
description: A black stage, 100vh, with no copy until the word. A circular clip centred at 50% x, 40% y opens from 0 to about 25% of the viewport diagonal over 2.1s (cubic ease-out), then breathes between 24% and 26% on a 4s sine. Inside the iris a portrait fills the viewport, built from three stacked cut-out layers of one photographed or rendered subject (back, head, features); the layers follow the pointer by 6, 14 and 28px and the eyes track it inside a 10px radius. Over the lower third a 5 to 9 letter word at 88px oblique caps in light ink rolls in letter by letter (60ms stagger, rising 40px out of a mask); two plain 18px choice links sit in the bottom corners at the 64px margins. Phone: iris 40% of the height, pointer replaced by a slow idle sway of 8px, word 44px, links stacked at the bottom centre.
phone: Iris covers 40% of the height, idle sway instead of pointer tracking, word 44px, links stack at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: the oblique caps word is a display word at 88px, not a tiny label. The portrait must be photographed or rendered cut-outs, never a drawn SVG face.

name: Text columns, then centred giant title
description: A panel with 160px side padding on the ground colour. At the top two or three text columns, each 420px wide with a 120px gap: a 22px bold sentence-case lead line over a paragraph of only three or four 18px lines. 160px below, a centred block: a 100px heavy uppercase title in three short lines (about 380px wide) with a 16px sentence-case caption under it. A small filled chip (ink on accent, 14px text with a two-word prompt) follows the pointer over the title block and fades out when the pointer leaves; it does not exist on touch devices. Ink on ground, accent only on the chip.
phone: The columns stack with 32px between them; the title sets at 22vw inside 20px gutters; no chip.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow, mono and tiny uppercase labels. Designed out: the small mono bracketed labels become 22px bold lead lines, the mono caption becomes sentence case, and the 400px bar scrubber is dropped (it read as a progress bar). The pointer-following label stays as a small chip.

name: Photo left, copy and two buttons right
description: A calm half-and-half row on the lightest ground with 140px padding above and below. Left: a 585x390 square-cornered photo whose top 60px tucks up over the previous section's bottom edge (negative margin) so the two sections interlock; inner parallax of 6%. Right, 510px wide, starting 100px after the photo and centred on its height: a 46px/1.1 heading in plain ink, a two-line 18px paragraph (24 words at most), 32px of space, then two buttons side by side 12px apart, 56px tall, in the same pill shape with two fills (one ink, one surface tone). Phone: photo first at full width minus 40px (4:3) with its overlap, copy under it, buttons full width and stacked.
phone: Photo on top with its overlap kept, copy below, the two buttons full width and stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for the heading underbar (an accent device) and the hairline above the badges: both are dropped, the heading is plain and 32px of space replaces the rule. The two black store badges become two designed filled buttons.

name: Colour-echo title around a rolling object
description: A pinned scene about 400vh long. The ground starts in one palette tone and swaps to a second at 55% of the pin (a flat swap with a 400ms crossfade, no gradient). The same two-word title, about 200px/0.9 bold and centred, is stacked four times at different depths, two copies behind a 3D object and two in front, each copy in a different palette tone (ink, accent, a mid tint, a deep tint; no new hues) and offset 0, 14, 28 and 42px down so they read as an echo. A rendered 3D object (a model in three.js or a rendered turntable) rolls through between the layers, turning a full 360 degrees while travelling from lower left to upper right across the pin. Four short claims of up to five words, 22px sentence case, fade in around the object at the corners of a 900x500 area at 20, 40, 60 and 80% of the pin. Phone: title 84px in two lines with three echo copies, object 60% of the width, claims show one at a time at the bottom.
phone: Title 84px in two lines, three echoes, object at 60% width, claims appear one at a time at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Title copies are limited to palette tones (no colour sprawl); the claims are 22px sentence case, not small caps labels. The object is a render or 3D model, not a drawn illustration.

name: Layered photo close with a product rise
description: A pinned closing scene about 250vh long. Three stacked photo layers (sky, middle ground and foreground crops of one art-directed scene), blurred 0, 6 and 12px with the farthest softest, move at 0.2, 0.5 and 0.9 of scroll speed. Centred over them: a 96px/1 two-line headline in light ink that slides down 80px against the scroll, a 20px three-line paragraph (30 words at most), a 22px price line and two 56px pills side by side, one filled ink and one filled surface tone. After about 1350px of scroll a cut-out product image (520px tall) rises from below the fold to the centre, and the footer then slides over the stage. No rulers, counters or progress marks. Phone: headline 48px, layers at half amplitude, pills stacked full width, product rises to 320px.
phone: Layers at half amplitude, headline 48px, pills stacked full width, product rises to 320px.
houseRuleCheck: The 550px frame ruler with counters on the left edge is dropped (counters, scroll-progress mark). Text sits on blurred photo layers with no box on them; the photo must be art-directed, not documentary.

name: Colour lead tile and a photo tile row
description: A row of five equal portrait tiles, the first a colour tile that carries the heading. Inside the 1312px container, five tiles of 248x330 with 16px gaps and radius 28; every tile sits inside the margins, none is cut by an edge and nothing drags. Tile one: accent fill, a 32px/1.1 two-line heading at the bottom left with 20px padding, contrasting ink. Tiles two to five: portrait photos with a plain 15px caption in ink, 16px below each (no chips on the photos). Hover on a photo: the image zooms 1.06 inside its mask over 500ms and the caption shifts 4px. Entrance: tiles rise 24px in sequence, 80ms apart. Phone: a two-column grid, the lead tile spanning both columns at 200px tall, the four photos below in two rows.
phone: Two-column grid with the lead tile spanning both columns, photos in two rows below.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for edge-touch and drag-rail: the fifth tile cut by the frame edge and the draggable strip are designed out; all five tiles fit inside the margins and nothing drags. Caption chips on the photos move under them (no boxes on photographs); the black pill band above and the tile glyphs are dropped.

name: Lightbox video over its own blurred poster
description: A modal player opened from an inline thumbnail (a 16:9 poster with radius 24 and a 72px filled play button at its centre). On click a fixed full-screen overlay fades in over 300ms: the video's own poster image is scaled to cover the screen and blurred with a 20px image filter under a flat 50% dark tint; the video sits centred and contained, at most 1100x620 at 1440, radius 20, autoplaying, with its controls; a 48px filled accent close circle with a plain cross sits 32px from the top-right corner. Esc, a click outside and the close circle all close it; the overlay fades out in 200ms and focus returns to the thumbnail. Phone: the video runs 100vw wide, the poster blur fills behind it, the close circle is 44px.
phone: Video 100vw wide over the blurred poster, 44px close circle top right.
houseRuleCheck: The blur is an image filter on the poster itself, not a glass or backdrop-filter panel; the tint is flat. No box sits on a photograph.

name: Contact overlay with wiping field bars
description: A full-screen contact overlay (100vw x 100vh, ground tone) opened from a button, closed by a 48px round button 32px from the top right. At 1440: the left five columns hold a two-line 96px/0.95 heading and a 20px two-line description; the right six columns hold a segmented tab row of three options (48px tall, a filled ink indicator pill that slides between options in 350ms) and four or five fields as filled bars 64px tall, radius 16, surface tone, 12px apart, with a 16px label inside and a 160px message field, then a full-width 64px submit button. Entrance: heading lines slide up inside masks (1s ease-out, 0.1s stagger); each field fill wipes in from scaleX 0 to 1 (1.2s, 0.15s stagger, origin left); the description rises 40%; field contents fade 0.15s apart. The submit's two-layer label rolls up on hover (label and duplicate slide 100% in 400ms). Phone: heading 48px, one column, fields 56px, tab labels shortened to stay on one row.
phone: One column, heading 48px, fields 56px, tab labels shortened to one row.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines: the drawn rule lines become filled bars that wipe in with the same timing, the tab underline becomes a sliding filled pill, and underline inputs are not used.

name: Centred four-column link group
description: A quiet directory about 280px tall with 120px of space around it. One filled surface panel (radius 28, 56px padding) about 1010px wide and centred holds four equal columns on a 232px pitch: each a 20px medium heading over four 15px links in muted ink on a 40px pitch, left aligned in its column. No rules, no icons. Hover: a link goes to full ink and slides 4px right in 200ms. Use it as the last beat before the footer or as a sitemap beat, never as the footer itself. Phone: the panel spans 100vw minus 40px and the columns fall into two by two with 28px between rows. Variant: the four columns stand open on the ground (no panel) on a 320px pitch from the left margin, and the first column may hold a short sentence and a button instead of a list.
phone: Panel at 100vw minus 40px, columns in a two by two grid.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The links sit on one filled panel so the group reads as one unit (loose text floating without a container is avoided).

name: Echoed headline over 3D signposts
description: A closing destination scene, 1300px tall at 1440 (900px on phone), on a flat accent ground; the top edge is straight with a 64px corner radius, not a drawn wave. Centred: a two-line caps headline at 120px/0.9 bold across about 934px, echoed in three or more rows down the stack, the first row in full ink and each echo a lighter tint of it (55%, 30%, 15%), same face and size, no outlines. Above the headline one large extruded 3D letter (a model or pre-rendered sprite) floats and turns slowly. At the bottom one centred pole carries two 3D signboards pointing opposite ways, each 360x110 with a 28px destination label, built from rendered geometry. Hover: a board swings 8 degrees towards the pointer; a click follows its link. Phone: headline 64px with three echoes, the pole shorter, labels 22px.
phone: Headline 64px with three echoes, shorter pole, 22px board labels.
houseRuleCheck: The wavy top edge becomes a straight edge with a large radius (no drawn shape); echoes are ink tints, not outlines; the signboards must be rendered 3D geometry, never a drawn illustration.

name: Four image link columns
description: Four equal image-led link columns across the 1312px container with 16px gaps, so each column is 319px wide. Per column from the top: an 18px serif title on a 28px line; 12px below it a portrait image 319x394 (ratio 0.81, radius 16); 12px under that a 14px caption of one or two lines in muted ink. No buttons or arrows: the whole column is the link. Hover: the image zooms 1.05 inside its mask in 500ms and the title ink goes to the accent. Entrance: columns rise 24px, 80ms apart. Phone: two columns by two rows with 4:5 images and one-line captions.
phone: Two by two grid, 4:5 images, one-line captions.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: captions are 14px sentence case, titles sit above the image rather than on it. The image keeps each column together; no outlines or rules.

name: Full-viewport bento tile menu
description: A full-screen menu overlay (100vw x 100vh) built from eight interlocking colour tiles on a 10px grid: four unequal columns at 1440 of about 268, 477, 377 and 268px, 10px margins and gutters, tile heights of 385 or 485px in alternating pairs, radius 12. Each tile holds a 34px label 24px in from the top left (the destination name) and nothing else, no glyphs. Fills come from the page palette only, in three tones (accent, ink, surface) with label ink chosen for contrast, so no tile matches a neighbour. Opening: tiles scale from 0.92 and fade in, 40ms apart from the top left. Hover: the tile fill swaps to the next tone and its label slides 6px. Phone: two columns, tiles 150 to 220px tall, labels 22px, overlay scrolls vertically.
phone: Two columns, tiles 150 to 220px tall, labels 22px, the overlay scrolls.
houseRuleCheck: The drawn glyph in each tile is dropped (no drawn shapes); fills are limited to three palette tones (no colour sprawl). It is a menu overlay, not a page made of boxes. The small decorative square in the notch is left out (a drawn shape).

name: Giant word, figure rail and topic cards
description: A topic hub. Top: a one-word 100px/0.9 headline at the 64px margin, no counts. Below, a 3 / 9 split on the 12-column grid. The left rail (columns 1 to 3, about 320px) holds one 320x300 photo (radius 20, no frame) and a 16px two-line sentence, and stays sticky while the right side scrolls. The right side (columns 4 to 12) holds four filled topic cards 12px apart, each 200px tall, radius 24, surface fill, 28px padding: in its left half a 26px title, a one-line 17px description and one filled 44px pill button; in its right half three link rows 38px tall with an arrow at the right end, plain text with no rules or bullets. Hover: the card fill steps to an accent tint and the arrows move 4px. Phone: the rail photo becomes a 16:9 image under the headline and the topic cards stack, link rows under the description.
phone: Rail photo becomes a 16:9 image under the headline, topic cards stack.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines: the rule above each row and the outline pill are replaced by filled cards and a filled button. The superscript count and slash labels are dropped (numbering, eyebrow); the framed figure is a plain photo. The left rail is never empty.

name: Giant word under rising notched cards
description: A pinned closing scene about 200vh long on the lightest ground. One giant near-black display word, an invitation or a verb and never the brand name or an email, 1220x219 at 1440 and centred across x 116 to 1336, rises 80px into place. Three interlocking cards 8px apart rise from below the fold and settle over only the lower 30% of the word so it stays readable: a 412x385 picture card, a 183x360 strip card (portrait photo) and a 330x155 close-up card, each notched by a 24px clip-path step where neighbours meet and each with a plain 16px caption under it. A two-line 28px question sits low left at the margin. After the stage the page scrolls into the footer. Phone: word 72px over two lines, cards as an overlapped 2-up pair, question below.
phone: Word 72px in two lines, cards overlap as a 2-up pair, question underneath.
houseRuleCheck: The cards may cover only the lower third of the word (no picture inside a headline). The word must not be the brand name or an email (no giant name before the footer). Labels sit under the cards, not on the photos.

name: Heading left, picture link cards right
description: A dark ground (the ink tone) with 168px padding above and below. Left, from the 64px margin and about 340px wide: a 60px/1.05 two-line heading in light ink and an 18px two-line paragraph in muted light ink, no ornament. Right, from x 550: four link cards 20px apart, each 190x260 with radius 24; the upper 60% is a cover photo and the lower 40% a surface-tone strip holding an 18px label at the left and a 28px round arrow chip at the right. The whole card is the link. Hover: the card lifts 8px in 250ms and the photo zooms 1.06. Phone: heading on top, the cards in a two by two grid at 200px tall.
phone: Heading on top, cards in a two by two grid at 200px tall.
houseRuleCheck: The drawn icon in each card top is replaced by a photo (no icon-topped cards, no drawn shapes); the ornament is dropped and the labels rise from 12px to 18px.

name: Single link bar as the whole section
description: One filled bar is the whole section: 1312px wide inside the margins, 80px tall, radius 40, accent or surface fill, with 200px of space above and below. Inside, a 26px medium verb phrase in sentence case at the left and a 48px round ink arrow chip at the right. Hover: a flat ink wipe floods the bar from the left in 350ms, the text turns light and the arrow turns 45 degrees. It is the quiet hand-off to the next page or the footer, with nothing else around it. Phone: bar 64px tall, text 20px. Variant: a centred 32px heading of two to four words flanked by two arrows that slide 12px outward and back on a loop and speed up on hover.
phone: Bar 64px tall with 20px text and the same hover wipe on tap.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for a hairline and for sitting only in the right half (left half empty). Designed out: a full-width filled bar replaces the ruled row and the 17px uppercase text becomes 26px sentence case. The idea, one link as the whole section, is intact.

name: Perspective pill chapter picker
description: A full-height chooser laid over a rendered 3D scene or looped render, tinted with a flat 35% dark overlay. A 24px centred heading sits about 11% from the top. At 16% above the bottom a row of five pills, each 310x60 and radius 30 in dark ink, holds a 17px title over a 13px subtitle with the duration at the right and a small arrow chip at the far end; the row sits in a 500px perspective box so the outer pills turn about 18 degrees inward and shrink to 0.85. Locked pills are dimmed to 40% with a not-allowed cursor; the hovered pill scales 1.05 and lifts 6px. On selection the pills scale to 0 in 300ms with a 40ms stagger and the scene moves to that chapter. Phone: pills stack vertically at 56px, full width minus 32px, no perspective.
phone: Pills stack vertically at 56px, no perspective, one tap picks a chapter.
houseRuleCheck: No icons in the pills. They sit over a rendered scene under a flat tint, as controls, and must never be laid over a photograph (no boxes on photographs).

name: Pill grows into a side panel menu
description: A menu that grows out of its own button. Closed: an 87x48 filled pill 30px from the top and right with the word Menu in 15px. Open: the pill grows in place, width to 465px over 900ms and height to 840px over 1000ms on a spring ease (damping about 0.4), radius 24 to 16, staying 30px from the top and right, into a full-height ink panel. Inside: four or five links in 80px/1 light type, 15px apart, centred vertically; on hover a link slides 40px right and a 12px accent dot grows at its left; a 48px close circle at the panel's top right; below the links a row of plain-text social links and 14px footer links at the bottom. Links stagger in 60ms apart once the panel is 70% grown. Phone: the panel opens to 100vw minus 24px by 100vh minus 24px, links 48px, close circle 44px.
phone: Panel opens to nearly full screen with 12px inset, links 48px, close circle 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The row of social icon circles is replaced by plain-text links; the panel is solid ink, not glass; no sentence sits in the navigation.

name: Thumbnail trigger with a dropdown panel
description: A menu trigger and its panel. Closed: a 300x92 filled card at the top right, 32px from the edges, radius 20, holding a row of three 56px photo thumbnails with a 14px sentence-case word Menu under them. Open on click: a 341px-wide panel in the lightest tone slides down from under the trigger with an 8px gap, radius 20 and 28px padding, about 420px tall: three links in 33px/0.95 type with a 22px indent (hover moves them 8px), then a row of three plain 13px legal links, a row of plain-text social links, and a contact block with one filled 48px email button. It closes on outside click, Esc or the trigger. Phone: the trigger shrinks to a 48px pill reading Menu and the panel spans 100vw minus 24px.
phone: Trigger becomes a 48px Menu pill, the panel spans 100vw minus 24px.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for a tiny tracked uppercase strip: it becomes a 14px sentence-case label. Social icons become text links, legal text rises to 13px, and the ticket notch is dropped for a plain radius.

name: Index list over a living full-screen scene
description: A CMS-fed index laid over a living full-screen scene. A fixed 100vh backdrop (a WebGL sphere panorama or a stack of four to six wide environment images) cross-fades to the matching environment when a list row is hovered or reaches the middle of the viewport (700ms), with light weather particles (slow snow, drifting cloud or rain streaks on a canvas layer, under 120 particles). Over it a left-aligned list of six to eight rows at 56px/1.1 medium in light ink on a flat 30% dark tint, 24px apart, starting at the 64px margin, each with an 18px one-line meta at the right end; the active row is full ink and the rest 45%. Each row opens its own detail page. Phone: the backdrop becomes static images that cross-fade as rows pass the centre, rows 36px, particles off.
phone: Static cross-fading images instead of the live scene, 36px rows, particles off.
houseRuleCheck: List text only, no boxes on the scene. Environments are rendered or art-directed, never documentary photographs. Rows start at the left margin, so no row is empty on the left.

name: Live calculator beside a notched result panel
description: A quote or planning tool. In the 1312px container two halves of 630px with a 52px gap, 720px tall. Left half: a 38px/1.1 headline, one 16px sentence, six inputs as filled bars (56px tall, radius 14, surface tone, a 16px label above a 20px value inside): two rows of two, then two full width; below them a slider with a 4px surface-tone track, a 24px filled ink handle and 14px end values. Right half: one flat dark ink panel 630x720, radius 28, with a trapezoid notch cut by clip-path into its top edge (80px wide, 24px deep, at 60%) and a 24px step in its left edge; inside, one 96px headline figure under an 18px label and two secondary 36px figures, all counting to their new value over 400ms on every input change, plus a 16px note. Phone: inputs in one column (two-up when short), the result panel below, and a sticky bottom summary bar showing the main figure while editing.
phone: One column of inputs, result panel below, sticky bottom summary bar with the main figure.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for nested boxes and hairlines. Underline inputs and the soft radial glow are removed: fields are filled bars on the plain ground (no box inside a box) and the result panel is one flat dark card; the notch is a clip-path step, not a drawn shape.

name: Logo grid flanked by cut-out figures
description: One screen on a lightly textured light ground (a subtle paper-noise image, no gradient) with 120px padding. A centred 56px/1.05 headline and a two-line 18px blurb 640px wide. 48px below, a centred 3x2 grid of six greyscale logos in 195x131 cells at a 195px pitch (about 600px wide), flat grey ink, no rules or boxes. To the left and right of the grid two seated cut-out figures, each about 280px tall, face inwards and point at the grid; they are rendered or studio-shot cut-outs on transparent backgrounds. Figures float 8px on a 5s sine; logos fade up 80ms apart and go from grey to full colour on hover. Phone: headline, blurb, a 3x2 grid, and the two figures at 120px overlapping the top corners of the grid.
phone: 3x2 grid, figures shrink to 120px and sit on the grid's top corners.
houseRuleCheck: Six logos only (a wall of twelve reads as a credit wall). Figures must be rendered or studio cut-outs, never drawn SVG and never documentary photographs.

name: Logo grows into a media frame
description: A pinned intro-to-work transition (about 120vh of pin) on a black ground. At rest the brand mark sits in the nav bar. On scroll it detaches, travels to the centre and grows into a 1203x485 landscape frame (radius 16) filled with artwork or a looping video, the mark acting as the mask while it grows; the frame then drifts up 60px and scales from 1 to 1.2. Two chunks of a short title (120px/0.9, light ink, about two words each) slide across the frame in opposite directions, roughly 200px each way, one over its top half and one over its bottom half. Phone: the frame is 100vw minus 32px at 4:5, the title chunks are 56px and cross 80px each way.
phone: Frame 100vw minus 32px at 4:5, title chunks 56px crossing 80px each way.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: the nav mark is the brand's own mark, not a picture in a headline, and the title crosses the frame with no box behind it.

name: Character holding a content board
description: A flat stage one screen tall in a muted palette ground. A 3D or studio cut-out character about 500x600 stands centred with both hands holding a dark ink board 920x231 (radius 14) in front of its body; the hands are a second cut-out layer drawn over the board's side edges so the board reads as held. On the board: a 36px short title and one row of three short value lines (16px, for example a figure and its unit), no logo wall. At the bottom a pale bar 1266x83 (radius 24) holds three or four 44px filled white pills with 16px labels (filters or links). The character bobs 6px on a 3s sine while the board counter-tilts 1 degree; on hover the board tilts 3 degrees. Phone: character 280x340, board 100vw minus 32px by 160px, the pills wrap into two rows inside the bar.
phone: Character 280x340, board full width at 160px, pills wrap into two rows.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for a credit wall (two rows of four logos on the board): the board now carries one title and three short values. The character must be a render or studio cut-out, not a drawn illustration.

name: Mask-opening video with column text
description: A pinned video opening, about 450vh tall with the pin lasting about 2700px. The ground is white at first. A video (or an art-directed picture) sits inside a rounded mask (560x315 at the start, centred, radius 28) that grows with scroll to a full-bleed 100vw x 100vh with radius 0 while the video plays. Over the opened video, on a three-column grid (columns at 64, 520 and 976px), two serif paragraphs at 26px about 448px wide and about 20 words each in light ink: one in column one near the lower left and one in column three near the upper right, fading in at 70% and 85% of the pin. Phone: the mask grows to 100vw x 100svh and the two paragraphs show one after the other at the bottom in 20px. Variants: a 1312x600 rounded tile rising from just below the fold that widens to 100vw x 100vh while its radius goes from 24 to 0, with one 28px line at the end; or a photograph growing from 0.82 scale under an 88px band in the page ground that holds one centred two-word pill (never above the navigation).
phone: Mask grows to full screen, paragraphs show one after the other at the bottom in 20px.
houseRuleCheck: Text sits straight on the video with no box (a flat 25% tint if contrast needs it); paragraphs are held to about 20 words each.

name: Circular mask sweeps out to uncover a world
description: A click-started reveal into an interactive 3D (or large-image) world. Start: a dark full-screen ground with a small island (a lit model or image about 320px wide) at the centre, held in a circular mask about 360px across (the mask edge is the picture's own crop, no stroke ring) with a 28px action button below it. On click the mask first pulls in 6% (300ms), then the mask radius sweeps out past every screen edge in 2s with a back-in ease and uncovers the full world behind it; the button scales out and the camera pulls back 20%. After the reveal, three 48px tab pills slide in from the right and settle 24px inside the right edge. Phone: same sweep from a 200px mask, tabs slide up from the bottom and rest in a row 16px above it.
phone: 200px mask, tabs rise from the bottom into a row 16px above it.
houseRuleCheck: The glowing ring edge is dropped and the mask edge itself is the circle (no stroke ring, no glow); the tabs stop 24px inside the right edge so nothing runs into one edge.

name: Media shrinks into a notched side panel
description: A pinned scene about 220vh long. A full-screen artwork shrinks into a notched panel that settles at the right, about 414x721 at 1440, 64px from the right edge and centred on the height. The panel outline is a clip-path with a 60x24 folder-tab step at the top, a 24px step on the left edge and one 32px chamfered corner; it is a solid image with no stroke or frame lines. At the left a heading band: two lines of 47px/1 heavy caps, the first indented 64px, and three notched thumbnails (120x160) drifting up 80px at different rates beside it. The ground flips from dark to the light tone during the shrink (a flat swap in 300ms) and the nav ink flips with it. Phone: the panel settles at 100vw minus 48px by 420px under the heading, thumbnails cut to one.
phone: Panel settles at 100vw minus 48px by 420px under the heading, one thumbnail.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines, numbering, tiny uppercase labels and mono type: the frame lines, the small index and the caption labels are dropped; the heading band is heavy caps at 47px, not a tiny label.

name: Model stop with solid panel
description: A pinned section of three to five stops, about 700px of scroll each, over a 3D model or a pre-rendered walkaround that fills the right 60% of the screen (a WebGL canvas, or a short set of rendered stills crossfaded). The camera glides to a different part of the model at each stop. At the left sits a filled card, about 400x480, radius 24, 32px padding, 40px from the left and the bottom, its fill one step off the page ground (no blur, no outline): a 38px title, a four-line 18px paragraph, three short fact rows (a bold lead word and one short phrase, 20px apart, no icons, no lines) and a full-width 52px filled button. At each stop the card fill, the button and the key light of the model retint to one tint from the brand family, and the text swaps with a 300ms rise. Ink on card, accent on the button.
phone: Canvas on top at 60vh and pinned; the card under it at full width inside 20px gutters swaps per stop.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged glass, hairlines and tiny labels. Designed out: the glass panel is a solid filled card, the 1px divider lines and icons go, and the small label goes. The card sits beside the model on the ground, never on a photograph. The idea (stops that retint one fixed info card) stays.

name: Three-rail chip marquee, alternating
description: A centred two-line 52px/1.1 heading of up to eight words, then 48px below it three full-width rails, each 96px tall and 16px apart, of filled white pill chips (80px tall, radius 40: a 32px round logo or image at the left and a 16px name, 20px between chips). The rails run off both screen edges and move with scroll: rail one drifts left, rail two right, rail three left, at about 0.4 of scroll speed with a slow 20s idle drift. The chips sit on the plain ground. 200px of padding below. Use it for integrations, places, ingredients or skills, 24 distinct chips, never for a client logo wall. Phone: rails 72px tall, chips with 14px names, speed halved.
phone: Rails 72px tall, 14px names, scroll speed halved.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for edge-touch: the rails form a deliberate full-bleed band that is cut equally at both edges (nothing sits against one edge) and move by scroll, not by drag (no drag rail). Chips must be integrations, places or topics, not credits.

name: Narrow column over a tile grid
description: One narrow column on a pale ground with 160px padding above and below, 340px wide, always centred. From the top: a 54px/1.05 two-line heading, a two-line 17px paragraph (20 words), 28px of space, then a 3x3 grid of nine 98px square tiles with radius 18 and 22px gaps (about 120px pitch, 334px wide). Each tile is a filled tone (surface, accent tint or ink) holding a real partner logo, a crop of a photograph or one 36px letter; no drawn icons. On scroll the tiles flip one by one (rotateY 90 to 0, 60ms stagger). Phone: the same column at 100vw minus 40px with the tiles at 92px.
phone: Column at 100vw minus 40px, nine tiles at 92px.
houseRuleCheck: The three-dot ornament is dropped; tile contents are logos, photo crops or a letter, never drawn icons. The column is always centred, so the open space falls evenly on both sides and no row is empty on the left.

name: Asymmetric photo bento
description: A beige panel (the page's second ground tone) with 48px top corners that lifts over the previous section, 170px top padding and 120px bottom. Inside a 1222px container: two 601px columns with a 20px gutter. Left: one tall 601x863 photo (radius 20) with a 30px/1.1 two-line caption under it. Right: one 601x515 photo with a 24px caption under it, then 20px lower two 291x249 photos side by side 20px apart. Each photo's topic tags (two or three words, 14px) sit in one plain line under its caption, not on the photo. Hover: the photo zooms 1.04 inside its mask and the caption underlines. Entrance: a staggered 24px rise. Phone: a single column, the tall photo at 4:5, the two small photos side by side at 4:3.
phone: Single column, tall photo at 4:5, the two small photos side by side at 4:3.
houseRuleCheck: The small white tag pills on the photographs are moved under the captions as plain text (no boxes on photographs). Photos must be art-directed, not documentary.

name: Giant title over a card pair
description: A feature pair under a giant one-word title on an off-white ground, 160px padding above and 120px below. A 170px/0.9 one-word title at the 64px margin; 72px below its baseline a 16px underlined link aligned to the right margin. Then two cards of 650x440 inside the 1312px container, 12px apart, radius 24: one a photo, one a solid accent fill carrying one 40px line of type; under each card (16px down) a 28px sentence-case caption. Static, no carousel. Hover: the card radius goes 24 to 32 and the caption moves 6px. Phone: title 72px, cards stacked at 4:3, captions 20px.
phone: Title 72px, cards stacked at 4:3, captions 20px.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for edge-touch: the cards ran edge to edge from x 8, now they sit inside the margins. The small label and the count on the link are dropped, and captions are sentence case, not uppercase.

name: Giant word, filter chips and a filtered list
description: A filterable archive. A 100px/0.9 light one-word headline at the margin, no superscript count. Below it a 3 / 9 split. Left rail (320px): a group of five filter chips (40px tall pills, radius 20, surface tone; the active chip fills ink) that filter the list at once, and under them one 320x300 picture (radius 20). Right side: a list of eight to ten filled rows, 64px tall, 8px apart, radius 14, surface tone, each with a 15px date at the left, a 22px name with an ellipsis, a type tag as a small filled pill near the right and a plus chip at the right end that opens the entry. Filtering fades rows out in 200ms and shifts the layout in 250ms. Phone: the chips wrap on one row above the list, rows 56px, the picture dropped.
phone: Chips wrap above the list, rows 56px, picture dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines and text weight: ruled rows become filled rows, about twenty rows are cut to eight to ten, folder-tree checkbox filters become chips and the superscript count is dropped. The rail holds a picture so no row is empty on the left.

name: Plain headline over a mixed bento
description: A centred bento of mixed content on a black or ink ground, 200px padding. A centred one-line 80px/1 headline in light ink and an 18px one-line sub. 60px below, a 940px bento with 8px gaps and radius 20: row one has a 360x280 list tile (three short items), a 280x280 muted looping video tile and a 282x280 photo tile; row two has a 650x140 stat tile (one 56px figure with a caption) and one 282x140 filled link tile (an action with an arrow). Tiles are filled with surface tones (ink plus two steps) and one accent tile. Hover: a tile lifts 6px (transform only, no shadow). Entrance: tiles rise 20px, 60ms apart. Phone: one column in the order list, video, photo, stat, link, tiles full width minus 32px at 160 to 240px tall.
phone: One column in the order list, video, photo, stat, link; tiles 160 to 240px tall.

name: Overlapping mixed-media pinboard
description: About two screens tall on white with 200px padding. Upper cluster on three 379px columns with 106px gutters: a tall 374x639 photo in the middle column; a 380x213 muted looping video overlapping its left edge by 78px, 120px below its top; a 174x247 photo overlapping its right edge by 78px, 60px below its top. They move at different rates (photo 1.0, video 1.15, small photo 0.85) so they slide over one another. 120px lower a second pair with aligned tops: a 379x254 photo at the left and a 379x379 video at the right, the pair centred as a group; 60px under them a centred 24px two-line paragraph (22 words at most) and an underlined link. Overlaps are plain stacking, with no boxes or labels on the media. Phone: one column of media with 24px overlaps and alternating left-right offsets, videos as posters if autoplay is blocked.
phone: One column with 24px overlaps and alternating offsets; poster stills when autoplay is blocked.

name: Polygon title tile with masked photos
description: A navy or dark ink ground with 160px padding. At x 260 a 392x356 accent tile cut to a pentagon (clip-path with a 14% apex) holds a 32px/1.1 two-line title; to its right a 20px bold paragraph of two lines (15 words) 408px wide and a pill button. Below, two 392x330 photos at x 260 and x 782, each cut to the same roof-shaped pentagon, with a 20px caption and a small underlined link under each; a centred underlined link closes the section. Hover: the photo zooms 1.05 inside its clip and the apex deepens from 14% to 18% in 300ms. One polygon angle is used for every shape. Phone: tile at full width, paragraph under it, the two roof photos stacked at 4:3 with the apex at 10%.
phone: Tile full width, paragraph below, roof photos stacked at 4:3.
houseRuleCheck: The shapes are clip-path masks on real tiles and photos, not drawn SVG art; use one angle only; a polygon button becomes a pill.

name: Three article cards with a centred link
description: Three filled cards in a 1216px container on a cream ground, 24px apart, each 389px wide and about 520px tall, white fill, radius 16. Each holds a 16:9 picture (389x219, rounded on its top corners), 24px padding, a 22px two-line title, a two-line 16px grey paragraph and a 16px underlined link pinned to the bottom (margin-top auto) so the three links share a baseline. About 100px below, one centred text link to see all. Hover: the picture zooms 1.04 and the card lifts 6px with no shadow. Phone: the cards stack with 16:10 pictures and the centred link stays last.
phone: Cards stack with 16:10 pictures; the centred link follows.
houseRuleCheck: The small bold tag above each title is dropped (an eyebrow-style label). Otherwise clear: filled cards with no outline or shadow at rest.

name: Three story columns with dated lists
description: A news section on the dark ground with 200px top padding. Three equal columns in the 1312px container, 24px apart (421px each), each a filled panel one tone lighter than the ground (radius 24, 24px padding) so every story reads as a group: a 421x260 lead photo (radius 16), a 40px/1.05 two-line serif heading, a list of three dated posts (a 14px date in muted ink above an 18px title, 16px between items) and an underlined text link. Hover: the heading ink goes to the accent and the photo zooms 1.04. Phone: columns stack and each list shrinks to two items.
phone: Columns stack, each list shows two items.
houseRuleCheck: The idea was open columns, but loose text without a container weakens the hierarchy, so each column is a filled panel (no outline, no shadow) holding photo, heading and list together. The photo sits inside the panel and nothing sits on the photo.

name: Object panel left, accordion rows right
description: A product detail row, about 710px tall at 1440 (100vh minus 190px), on the dark ground. Left: a 462px-wide full-height panel in a surface tone one step lighter than the ground (filled, radius 28, no border) holding a centred square sleeve or pack shot about 320px wide, with a disc or second part behind it that spins and flips (rotateY on an 8s loop, slowing on hover). Right, from x 622 and 560px wide: five accordion rows, each a filled bar 64px tall (radius 16, surface tone, 8px gap) with an 18px title at the left and a 20px plus at the right that turns 45 degrees when open; an open row grows to show two lines of 16px/28px body text; one row open at a time. Phone: the panel on top at 100vw minus 32px by 360px, the rows below at full width.
phone: Panel on top at 100vw minus 32px by 360px, accordion rows full width below.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines and outlined box rows: the inset 1px panel border and the ruled rows become filled surfaces, and the plus signs are plain text marks.

name: Collage object zooms to full bleed, then a text beat
description: Pinned for about 1440px. A floating collage of seven to nine art-directed pictures (160 to 380px, each drifting +/-12px) sits on the light ground; one featured artwork (about 380x450, near the centre) grows with scroll into a cover picture larger than the screen, scaling from 1 to about 4.5 until it covers the others, while the ground flips dark (a flat swap) and the picture settles from 1.2 to 1. Then a 30px five-line serif text beat (14 to 22 words, 333px wide) rises into place at the left and holds. Phone: five collage pictures, the featured one grows to 100vw x 100svh, the text beat 22px at the bottom left.
phone: Five collage pictures, the featured one grows to full screen, text beat 22px at the bottom left.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict if the pictures are art-directed and not documentary; the text beat is held to 14 to 22 words.

name: Photo stepping over a text panel's edge
description: A text panel with a photo that steps out over its edge. A surface-tone panel inset 64px from the left edge, 656 wide and 760 tall, radius 24, 120px padding: a 44px/1.1 plain heading, a three-line 17px paragraph and a 52px filled round plus button. A 762x600 photo (radius 16) stands over the panel's right edge, overlapping it by 140px, and drifts at 0.9x scroll so it slides slowly against the panel. Phone: the panel at full width, the photo overlapping its bottom by 40px.
phone: Panel full width, photo overlaps its bottom by 40px.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for the heading underbar (an accent device) and a tiny uppercase label: both dropped. The panel is inset from the screen edge. The critic also dropped the offset accent block behind the photo: a solid block offset 24px down and right reads as a hard shadow (no shadows at rest).

name: Frame rising past offset caption
description: Ground is a flat canvas tint with ink type; one accent at most, used for a single text link. One block per project or story. A 16:9 media frame, about 696x392 at 1440, square or 12px corners, sits on a 12-column grid at a different x in every block (left in one, centred in the next, right in a third) and always keeps 40px or more from the side edges. A short caption in 36px display type, five to seven short lines (ten to twelve words in all) and 340px wide, sits beside the frame or 120-150px under it at a different x, so the pair never lines up twice. Scroll: the frame travels faster than the caption and the ground (about 1.25x, translate only), passes the caption and leaves through the top, so the two cross. 160-200px of free space between blocks. A lone portrait frame may pass without a caption. As a wordless interlude (about 140vh), one 459x612 portrait frame passes through the right third at 1.25x with a 2 degree tilt easing to 0, and a second, smaller one through the left third 60% of a screen later.
phone: Stack: frame at full width inside 20px gutters, caption under it at 26px; keep a small speed difference (frame 1.1x) or none; one block per screen.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Keep the frame 40px from the edges (no edge touch) and use designed or generated imagery, not archive photographs.

name: Logo cells with the heading in the left third
description: A partner or customer section with the grid in the right eight columns. Left, columns 1 to 4 (about 420px): a 44px/1.1 two-line heading and a one-line 17px sentence, top aligned. Right, columns 5 to 12 (about 860px): two rows of three logo cells, each 270x200 (radius 20, surface tone, 12px gaps), the logo centred in greyscale up to 120px wide, and a 14px sentence-case caption (the customer's use or place) at the bottom of the cell. Six logos at most. Hover: the logo turns full colour and the cell fill steps to the accent tint. Phone: heading on top, the cells in a two by three grid of 160x120, captions hidden.
phone: Heading on top, cells in a two by three grid of 160x120, captions hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for hairlines, tiny uppercase labels and an empty left third: dotted rules become filled cells, tiny caps become 14px sentence case, and the heading fills the left third. Six cells instead of eight keep it a logo set, not a credit wall.

name: Orbit camera around a character with a HUD
description: A pinned scene about 1440px long with no copy. A rendered 3D character (a model in three.js, or a pre-rendered turntable of about 90 frames scrubbed by scroll) starts as a face close-up while the camera orbits around the head to the character's back; the character fills the lower 60% of the frame while the ground darkens from a mid tone to near-black in flat steps, not a gradient. A persistent HUD frames the stage: the brand mark top left, a menu pill top right, and a bottom row holding a filled pill at the left, a 44px round button, a centred pair of 14px sentence-case key hints and one link at the right. About 60 soft dust motes drift slowly. Phone: the orbit covers 70% of the range and the HUD is reduced to the mark, the menu pill and one bottom pill.
phone: Orbit covers 70% of the range, HUD cut to the mark, menu pill and one bottom pill.
houseRuleCheck: The row of dashes (it reads as a progress rail) is dropped and the HUD stays a few controls, not a chrome frame. The character must be rendered, not a drawn SVG.

name: Copy panel beside a live canvas panel
description: Two filled panels side by side, 825px tall at 1440 in the 1312px container, 22px apart, radius 32. Left, 517px wide, accent-tint fill: a 36px/1.1 headline, a two-line 17px paragraph, a two-column list of four plain 16px benefits (text only, 20px row gap) and a filled ink 52px arrow pill at the bottom. Right, 713px wide, the ink ground: a live canvas (WebGL or 2D) showing a rendered scene that reacts to the pointer, for example an image-plane corridor with textured panels in palette tones and pointer parallax of +/-6 degrees. Entrance: panels rise 24px, 80ms apart; the canvas camera starts drifting when 40% in view. Phone: the panels stack, copy first, canvas panel 420px tall, pointer replaced by a slow auto drift.
phone: Panels stack, copy first, canvas panel 420px tall with slow auto drift.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for outlined panels, a tag pill and hairlines: the panels are filled, the tag pill is dropped, and the line-drawn corridor is replaced by a rendered corridor of image planes (no drawn lines or shapes).

name: Oversized photo scales over the previous scene
description: A handover between two scenes. An art-directed photo larger than the viewport (about 1480x1110 at 1440x900, bleeding off both sides equally) scrolls up over the previous scene for about 720px of scroll while scaling from 1 to 1.1; the previous scene stays pinned behind it and dims by a flat 30% tint. At the end of the pass the next section's 88px/1 heading lands directly under the photo's bottom edge with 96px of space. Phone: the photo is 100vw x 70svh, scale 1 to 1.06, heading 44px.
phone: Photo 100vw x 70svh, scale 1 to 1.06, heading 44px.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: the photo bleeds off both sides equally and must be art-directed, not documentary.

name: Pack shot left, buy box right
description: A purchase block on a white ground with 140px padding. Left (x 64 to 700): a 468x396 cut-out pack shot centred on a flat surface-tone panel 620x600, radius 28, with no floor shadow. Right (x 760 to 1376): a 14px rating line in text (a score and review count), a 32px title, two lines of 17px text, a quantity toggle (a filled 48px segmented pill, minus, 1, plus), two full-width option rows 64px tall (radius 16, 8px apart; the chosen one filled ink with light text, the other surface tone) and a 62px checkout bar across the column with its label at the left and the price at its right end. Hover: option rows lighten and the checkout arrow moves 6px. Phone: the pack panel on top at 100vw minus 32px by 320px, then the buy box in one column.
phone: Pack panel on top at 100vw minus 32px by 320px, buy box in one column below.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for the outlined chosen option: selection is shown by fill (ink versus surface). The floor shadow under the pack is dropped (no shadows at rest) and the rating is text, not emoji stars.

name: Page shreds under a sweeping bar
description: A pinned scene about 250vh long on a dark ink ground. A full-width 3D metal bar (a rendered bar 120px tall, 100vw wide) sweeps down the screen over about 60vh of scroll; as it passes, the previous section (captured as a texture or as a stack of slices of its own image) falls apart below it into 24 to 32 twisted vertical strips in black and white that tumble and drift down 80 to 200px with 20 to 60 degree rotations, then clear. The screen then holds a centred two-line 80px/1 headline in plain white (no glow) and one 18px line. Phone: 16 strips, bar 80px, headline 44px.
phone: 16 strips, bar 80px, headline 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The glowing four-line headline becomes a plain white two-line headline (no glow, no shadow).

name: Bar-pattern mask wipe
description: A pinned image swap about 840px of scroll long with no copy. A mask of rounded bars (26px wide, 150 to 225px tall, 65px pitch, three staggered rows) sweeps left to right across the screen; each bar is a window onto picture B and widens until B covers the screen (900ms ease-in-out), replacing picture A. Then the field changes to the light tone and picture B shrinks into a notched slab (a clip-path step, about 420x600) at the centre. No reticle, no brackets. Phone: bars 18px wide and 100 to 150px tall, slab 280x400.
phone: Bars 18px wide, 100 to 150px tall, slab 280x400.
houseRuleCheck: The bracket shapes and the growing rail reticle (an outlined box, drawn shapes) are dropped; only the rounded-bar mask and the slab remain.

name: Photo with copy, handing over to a card panel
description: A two-part scene. Part one: a wide sky or landscape photo (100vw x 100vh, art-directed) slides in from the right (translateX 100% to 0 over 80vh of scroll) with a 60px/1.05 two-line white headline centred at the top and one 18px white paragraph (24 words at most) in a 395px column at the lower left. Part two: it hands over to a pale surface panel with 120px padding: a 640x650 photo card (radius 24) at the right, 64px from the right edge, and at the left from the 64px margin, vertically centred on the photo, a 44px two-line heading over a stack of three short text items (a 24px title over one 16px line each). Phone: the photo is 100svh with headline and paragraph, the panel photo 100vw minus 32px by 360px, columns stacked.
phone: Photo 100svh with headline and paragraph, panel photo 100vw minus 32px by 360px, columns stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Was flagged for accent words: the headline is plain white throughout, no styled word. The icon label and the column icons are dropped and the two paragraphs are cut to one. The text sits at the left of the photo card so the panel's left half is never empty.

name: Photo pair with split captions below
description: Two near-square photos in columns 1 to 6 and 7 to 12 of the 1312px container, a 24px gutter, each about 644x640 with square corners and a 6% inner parallax. Under each photo, 16px down, a two-column caption: a 30px/1.1 two-line title starting at the photo's left edge and a 14px one- or two-line paragraph starting at its midline. Entrance: the photos rise 24px, 80ms apart. Hover: the photo zooms 1.03 inside its frame. Phone: the photos stack at 4:5, and each caption becomes a stacked title over its paragraph.
phone: Photos stack at 4:5, captions stack title over paragraph.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: the captions sit under the photos, never on them, and the photos must be art-directed, not documentary.

name: Photo-text-photo triptych
description: Three equal tiles in one row, about 400x600 each, radius 32, 24px gaps, centred in a 1296px container (72px side margins) with 140px of air above and below. Left and right tiles are full-bleed pictures, product, lifestyle or rendered, studio-lit, never archive-style. The centre tile is a solid colour card (accent or a deep tint of the ground, ink on it at 7:1 contrast or better): a 34px semi-bold two-line heading at its top-left with 40px padding, and low at the bottom a 16px two-line paragraph and one small filled button, so the empty middle of the tile carries the weight. Nothing sits on the photographs. On entering view the tiles rise 40px and fade in with a 90ms stagger while each photo settles from scale 1.08 to 1; on hover a photo eases to 1.04 over 500ms. Phone: the tiles stack full width minus 20px gutters in the same photo, text, photo order, each 4:5, 16px apart.
phone: Stack the three tiles at full width minus 20px gutters in order photo, text, photo; 4:5 each, 16px gaps; keep the staggered rise.
houseRuleCheck: The tag pill was an eyebrow label and is dropped; the text tile opens with its heading. Nothing is laid on the photographs. Cards are filled, no outlines, no shadow.

name: Photo trio, split captions under
description: Three cards on a 12-column grid, four columns each, about 416 wide with 24px gutters inside 72px margins. Each card is one fill (a soft tint of the ground, radius 20): a 416x252 landscape picture flush at the top, then a caption plate with 20px padding that holds a 20px semi-bold title in a left column about 140px wide and a 15px three-line paragraph in muted ink in a right column about 220px wide. The caption sits inside the card fill, never floating loose. Pictures are revealed by a colour block (accent, full picture size) that wipes across them left to right in 700ms with a 120ms stagger as each card enters; on hover the picture scales to 1.03 and the title column slides 4px. Phone: one column of cards, the caption plate stacks the title above the text, picture 16:10.
phone: One column of cards, 16px apart; the title stacks above the paragraph inside the plate; the wipe reveal stays.
