houseRuleCheck: Captions are never loose text here: they live in a filled plate so the hierarchy is carried by the card. No outline, no shadow.

name: Mini-game picks next content
description: A warm off-white ground about 1.4 screens tall. A 48px semi-bold lead line sits top-left over a 240px display headline of one or two words only. The lower third is a flat floor holding a small physics sandbox: one ball (a solid 56px accent circle) and four open bins, each a 260x150 filled card (radius 20, palette tints) carrying a 22px topic word. Press and hold anywhere to charge the throw (the ball swells slightly while held, no meter), release to throw; the bin the ball settles in lifts 12px and its topic opens as two or three filled cards sliding up below it. A 16px sentence-case hint and a plain Skip text button sit under the floor. Keyboard route: arrow keys pick a bin and Enter drops the ball. Needs a 2D physics engine on canvas, paused when off screen. Phone: bins in a 2x2 at about 150x100, headline 32vw, press-and-hold works anywhere on the stage.
phone: Bins 2x2 at about 150x100 under the headline (32vw); press-and-hold anywhere throws; the Skip button stays 48px tall.
houseRuleCheck: A hint is a 16px sentence-case line, never a tiny uppercase label. Game objects are plain filled cards and one ball, nothing drawn as decoration. Always give a skip and a keyboard route.

name: Physics stat heap
description: A pinned white panel. A 125px two-line headline top-left, a two-line 20px paragraph and a plain underlined text link under it. From mid-height down, a physics heap of 12 to 16 filled stat chips falls and piles up across the centre and right: pills, rounded squares and circles, 120 to 220px, each holding a 44px bold number and a 16px unit word, in the accent, a deep tint and a light tint only. Chips spawn from above the panel with a 60ms stagger when the panel pins, settle in about 2.5 seconds, and the pointer acts as a soft pusher. Reduced motion: the heap is drawn already settled. Needs a 2D physics engine on canvas. Phone: headline 56px, paragraph, then a heap of 8 to 10 smaller chips filling the lower 55% of the screen.
phone: Headline 56px, one-line paragraph, then 8 to 10 smaller chips fall into the lower 55%; no device tilt.
houseRuleCheck: The mono label and the eyebrow are dropped. The heap uses only filled chips (pills, rounded squares, circles) that each carry a stat, no hexagons or decorative shapes. Colours stay inside accent plus two tints, no colour sprawl.

name: 3D act with narrated slides
description: A full-screen WebGL act: a lit 3D object at the centre with four to six flat billboards floating around it. Then a slider layer plays six to eight portrait, 4:3 and 16:9 stills and short clips (about 40 seconds), each with a 22px white subtitle line over a flat 35% tint, optionally synced to a voice track (muted by default, with a 48px filled unmute button), and ends on an end card: a 56px headline and one filled button that returns to the start. A two-line 44px act title holds at the upper left, 64px from the edges. Depth-mask transitions join the acts.
phone: The object static and cropped on top at 40vh; slides at full width; subtitle at the bottom, 20px.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged numbering. The small roman-numeral chapter index and the lines around the object (hairlines) are dropped. Needs real produced media; footage must be designed or generated, not documentary clips.

name: Walking figure, side caption
description: A pinned canvas about three screens long on a flat colour. One animated figure walks in place left or right of centre; it is a 3D model or a looping transparent-background clip, 520 tall, never a drawn or cartoon illustration, and takes the accent colour. In the opposite third (x 960 to 1340) a caption: a 40px two-line headline and a three-line 18px paragraph, 320 wide. Its lines enter tilted on the Y axis (12 degrees, blur 4px), scrubbed by scroll, hold, then rise 20px and fade. The next scene mirrors the sides and swaps the figure's colour. No numeral and no label. Phone: figure 260 tall at the top, caption below, mirrored sides dropped.
phone: Figure 260 tall at the top, caption below, no mirroring.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged eyebrow, numbering and tiny caps: the small numeral and label are dropped. The figure must be rendered or filmed, never a drawn SVG.

name: Card deck flying off
description: A dark ground pinned for about three scenes (900px of scroll each) with a 22px serif heading fixed at top centre. One large colour card, about 785x432, radius 28 and 48px padding, sits at the centre: a 58px two-line title, a two-line 18px paragraph, a filled button, and at its right a 220x330 portrait clip (radius 16). On scroll each card scales to 1.15, tilts 8 degrees and flies off the top while the next rises into the same slot from below (700ms ease in-out). The three card colours are tints from one palette family (not three hues). No drifting icons, no index.
phone: Card at 88vw by 70svh, the clip on top at 16:9, the text below; the fly-off stays.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged emoji and numbering. Designed out: the eight drifting chrome 3D icons and the card index are dropped, and the card colours come from one family so there is no sprawl.

name: Pinned centred statement, character reveal
description: A pinned stage of about 1200px of scroll: a 56-60px two- to three-line centred statement of 12 to 20 words (750-1020px wide) in ink on the ground. Its characters climb from 20% to full opacity in order as you scroll, and the statement may fade out after so a second one follows on the same stage. No label above. Reduced motion shows the full text at once. Variant: on a warm near-black ground, three to five lines of 48px serif capitals whose lines tone from 35% to full in turn, with one centred filled pill link 56px below.
phone: Statement at 30px inside 20px gutters; the reveal goes word by word; pinned for 900px.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The optional 11px grey label is dropped (eyebrow, tiny label).

name: Colour panels wiping in sideways
description: Pinned for about 4 screens of scroll. Four full-viewport panels wipe in from the right one after another (about 700px of scroll each). A constant 96px one-word title stays at the left (its colour flips with each panel through a blend or per-panel ink), and a row of the four panel names in 18px sits at the bottom, the active one in full ink and the others at 35%. Panel colours stay inside the palette (the accent, a deep ink, a light tint of the accent, a warm neutral), never one new hue per panel. Each panel carries a 32px subtitle, three short bullet lines (not two long columns), one filled pill button, and at the right a trio of overlapping pictures (about 300px each) that scale from 0.8 to 1 as the panel lands. Phone: no pin; panels become full-height sheets stacked sticky over each other, title 56px at the top, picture trio at 60% width.
phone: Drop the pin; four sticky sheets slide over each other at 100svh, title 56px, trio of overlapping pictures at 60% width.
houseRuleCheck: Numbered index becomes a row of names; the tiny caps label is dropped; the outlined pill becomes a filled pill; five rainbow panels shrink to four panels inside one palette to avoid colour sprawl.

name: Pinned depth arc of portrait cards
description: Pinned for about 2 screens on a coloured ground. A header band uses space only: a 47px two-line heading on the left and a 16px two-line paragraph at the right, 72px margins, no rules, no index. Below it, 11 portrait picture cards (radius 18, optionally with cut corners) sit on a 3D arc under a perspective of about 1400px: the centre pair (about 250x313) meet on the axis and each neighbour steps back 140px in depth, shrinks to 0.85 and turns 35 degrees. Scroll slides the outer cards out in depth and the whole arc turns edge-on into the next scene; the centre card's title appears under it in 20px. Phone: still pinned, with a centre card 62vw wide and neighbours peeking 14vw, 7 cards, scroll sliding the arc sideways.
phone: Stay pinned; centre card 62vw wide, neighbours peek 14vw each side, 7 cards, scroll drives the arc sideways.
houseRuleCheck: The ruled header band, index number, caps label and triangle markers are gone; the band is two text blocks on open space. Cards are plain pictures with nothing laid on them.

name: Full-bleed photos wiping up
description: A pinned stage of about five scenes, one screen of scroll each. Every scene is a full-bleed photograph under one flat 40% dark tint with a text block left of centre (about x 370 at 1440, never touching the left edge): a 48-56px two- or three-line headline in white and one 52px filled button. The next photograph wipes up from the bottom over the last (clip-path inset from 100% to 0 over about 700ms, ease in-out) while the headline lines rise in an 80ms stagger. No tag pills, hairline, index or small card on the photographs. Ground (behind the stage) and accent only show in the button. Variant: three photos wipe up in a dark pinned frame with a 32px headline over the lower left and a slow marquee of six client wordmarks (muted ink, inside the margins) along the bottom.
phone: Text block pinned at the bottom with 24px gutters, headline 34px, button at full width; the wipe stays.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow, hairlines, numbering and tiny uppercase labels. Designed out: the tag pill, hairline, two-digit index and label, and the small card on the photograph (a box on a photograph) are dropped; one headline and one button remain.

name: Pinned giant name stack with small image swap
description: A white stage pinned for about 1460px of scroll. A stack of about 12 names in 92px semi-bold type on the left starting at y 380: the active name in near-black ink, the others at 18% ink. Right of centre, a 216x216 square picture of the active item (radius 12) crossfades in 300ms. Every 120px of scroll moves the list up one line and swaps the picture. No labels at all; at most one 16px sentence-case line may sit by the picture. Hover on the active name nudges it 8px right. Phone: names 44px, the picture shrinks to 110px and floats beside the active line. On fine pointers hover can drive it instead of scroll on a black ground: the pointed name stays bright, the others drop to 30%, and a 218x273 picture window glides vertically to the hovered line (950ms ease-out).
phone: Names 44px, left aligned; a 110px square picture rides beside the active line; the list moves one line per 90px of scroll.
houseRuleCheck: No small caps labels are used. The list is left aligned from the page margin, so no row is empty on the left.

name: Pinned giant word sequence
description: A pinned stage of four to six screens. One giant word (150-200px, condensed or bold capitals, ink) sits centred and is replaced in turn by the next as the scroll advances; its letters rise on a 3D drum (rotateX) or run through a text shader, 500ms in and 400ms out. Behind it a full-screen field: a flat colour that retints per word from one palette family, or a slow shader noise in the same hues. An optional 20px sentence-case line sits 40px under the word. No monogram, no icons.
phone: The word fits the width (22vw at most, two lines), the field and drum stay.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. Overlapping translucent discs and small line icons would be drawn shapes and icons, so the scene is a flat colour field or a shader.

name: Pinned growing window over alternating grounds
description: One pinned scene per project, 1500-2500px of scroll each, on a solid ground that alternates between two palette colours. A framed video window starts small (about 520x300) near the bottom, rises and widens to about 1270px, then grows to full-bleed as a closing state while the next ground colour rises from below. A 120px uppercase serif title of one to three words is centred over the middle of the window, white, its letters rising through a mask in a 40ms stagger; a 16px caption sits under it. The window keeps 40px of margin until the final growth.
phone: Window at 90vw rising, title at 15vw; same alternating grounds.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged numbering. The small index at the left is removed. Video must be designed or generated footage, not documentary clips.

name: Pinned horizontal collage track
description: A pinned stage over about 3600px of scroll, framed by 24px of ground colour on every side. Inside it a rounded window (radius 28, overflow clipped) holds a 4600px track that moves about 3100px to the left. On it about 13 pictures of mixed sizes (240x240 to 640x590) sit at staggered heights, each drifting 20 to 40px faster than the track; five of them carry a 16px sentence-case caption set under the picture. Two short 24px text blocks sit between pictures. The collage is clipped by the window, so nothing runs into the screen edge. Phone: no pin; a two-column offset collage with a light vertical parallax, 3 captions.
phone: Drop the pin; a two-column staggered collage with a slight vertical parallax, 3 captions, 20px gutters.
houseRuleCheck: The track bled off both screen edges; it now moves inside a clipped, inset rounded window. The 8px caps captions become 16px sentence-case captions. Imagery must be made or product imagery, not archive photographs.

name: Pinned landing card pile
description: A 900px stage pinned for about 1450px of scroll on a light ground. Four filled cards of about 460x494 (radius 24, each a different tint taken from the palette, no outlines, no icons) fly in one by one, alternately from the left and the right, rotated about 6 degrees, and land at the centre 80px lower than the one before, so the older cards show only their top strip with its 20px title (the strip is the card's own top edge, not a separate box). The last card shows a 28px centred two-line statement. Cut-out product objects (transparent photographs of real items) drift upward around the pile at 1.4x scroll speed. Phone: cards 80vw by 320 tall with a 56px step, 4 degrees of rotation, two cut-outs.
phone: Cards 80vw by 320, stacked 56px apart, rotated 4 degrees, two cut-outs only; same fly-in order.
houseRuleCheck: Outlined cards and the line icons are gone; cards are solid fills and the tab is just the card's visible top strip, so there are no boxes in boxes and no icon-topped cards.

name: Pinned offset card strip with heading below
description: Pinned for about one screen on a pale ground. A row of filled cards sits near the top, starting at x 72: each card 420 wide (radius 20) with a 420x236 picture flush at the top and a caption plate under it holding a 20px title and two lines of grey 15px text. Three cards sit fully inside the 72px margins at rest (3 x 420 + 2 x 18 = 1296); scroll moves the row sideways about 600px inside a clipped window so the first card leaves and a fourth arrives, the text travelling with its card. Below the row, a 65px two-line heading sits at the left and a 20px title with two lines of text at the far right. Phone: no pin; the heading comes first and the cards stack vertically.
phone: No pin or sideways row: heading first, then the cards in one column with a 16px gap.
houseRuleCheck: The third card is no longer cut by the screen edge: the row lives in a clipped window with 72px margins and shows whole cards at rest. Phone uses stacking, not a drag rail.

name: Pinned pan of colour panels
description: A pinned stage with 24px of ground colour on every side pans a strip of five full-height panels to the left (about 2560px over 3400px of scroll). Each panel is a rounded card (radius 28) about 880 wide on its own fill, alternating between three palette roles (accent tint, deep ink tint, warm neutral). Inside: a 16:9 picture flush at the top that scales from 0.2 to 1 as the panel lands, a 16px detail row (client and year in plain text), a centred one-word 96px name whose letters stagger in 30ms apart, and a 60px round filled arrow button at the bottom right. The next panel peeks 80px at the right inside the stage margin. Phone: no pin; sticky full-height cards stack over each other, picture 4:3, name 56px.
phone: No pin; five sticky cards at 88svh slide over each other, picture 4:3, name 56px, arrow button 56px.
houseRuleCheck: Edge-to-edge panels now sit inside a 24px stage margin and the peek stays inside it; tiny caps details become a 16px sentence-case row; one pastel per panel becomes three alternating palette roles, so no colour sprawl.

name: Pan to headline and still mosaic
description: A two-panel pinned track that pans left by one viewport (scrubbed, ease-in-out) over about 1 screen of scroll. Panel 1 is a full-bleed picture or product scene with one short line. Panel 2 has a 120px three-line headline at the left (plain type, no pictures inside it), a 20px two-line paragraph and one dark filled button under it, all in a 560px column from x 72. At the right, inside 72px margins, a mosaic of 16 stills in a 4 by 4 grid (about 170px square, 12px gaps, radius 12) whose tiles pop in one at a time (scale 0.8 to 1, 40ms stagger) after the pan lands. Stills can be crops of 8 pictures. Phone: no pan; panel 1 then panel 2, headline 48px, mosaic 3 columns by 5 rows.
phone: No pan: panel 1 then panel 2 stacked; headline 48px, mosaic 3 columns by 5 rows with 8px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The inline image tiles inside the headline are dropped (no picture inside a headline); the mosaic no longer runs to the screen edge; the eyebrow and caps labels are removed.

name: Pinned photo with blend-mode giant word
description: A pinned full-bleed picture taller than the viewport (1440x1080) that drifts up about 200px while pinned. A 36px two-line statement sits at x 720 near the top and a 160px two-word headline sits at the bottom left, 84px above the screen edge and 72px in from the left. Both are set in near-white with a difference blend, so their colour shifts as they cross light and dark parts of the picture. The next scene then slides over the pinned picture. Pick a picture with strong light and dark zones, studio or rendered, never an archive photograph. Phone: statement 20px at the top, headline 22vw in two lines at the bottom, picture at 100svh.
phone: Statement 20px at the top, headline 22vw on two lines bottom-left, picture 100svh, same drift at half amount.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: no box on the picture, no gradient (the difference blend is a blend mode on type, not a fill). Check that the type stays legible over mid-grey zones; keep the picture high contrast.

name: Pinned centre stage recoloured per feature
description: A pinned section where each of four or five features owns about 900px of scroll. One centred stage, 640-700px across, cropped to a circle or a very round rectangle (radius 48), holds a looping product demo or render in that feature's tint. The page ground retints for each feature (one flat colour each, all from one family of tints of the brand hue) and the stage content swaps with a 400ms crossfade while the stage itself never moves. At the lower left a filled card (fill one step off the ground, radius 20, 32px padding, about 420px wide) scrolls past with a 52px title, a two-line 18px blurb and one text link, so the words read as one group. Ink on ground; the accent only on the link. Everything stays 40px or more from the edges.
phone: The stage shrinks to 78vw and stays pinned in the upper half; the card sits under it at full width and swaps per feature. If the pin is unreliable, stack stage and card per feature.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels, mono, hairlines and a progress bar. Designed out: the eight arcs that filled clockwise were a progress ring, so the ring is gone and the stage is a plain circular crop; the 1px divider, the meta lines and the small labels are dropped. The idea (one stage reused and recoloured per feature) stays.

name: Pinned service index driving big counter and planes
description: An inset panel (radius 12, 10px from the screen edges, fine grain texture) pinned for about 4300px with one step per item. Left: about 8 service names in 17px, the active one marked by a long arrow glyph and set in full ink, the others at 40%. Centre: a two-line 155px figure (a number plus a noun, for example a count and what it counts) that changes with the item. Right: a short 18px two-line paragraph and one filled button. On each step a tilted mockup plane (a rendered product screen, perspective about 1200px, rotateY around 20 degrees) tilts in over the figure and out again. The figure is a stat, never a 01, 02 counter. Phone: only the active service line is shown, figure 96px, plane below, paragraph hidden.
phone: Show only the active service name, a 96px figure, the plane beneath it; the list collapses; steps at 70vh each.
houseRuleCheck: The small label above the paragraph is dropped. The big figure is a real stat per item and never an ordinal counter. The inset panel sits 10px from the edges, never touching.

name: Sideways track of stacked tiles
description: A pinned 900px stage with 24px of ground on all sides. Two full-width ribbons (56px tall, filled in the accent and a deep ink, each repeating a short word in 20px type) sit at the top and bottom and drift in opposite directions. Between them a five-column track pans sideways inside a clipped window: columns about 340 wide with 22px gaps, radius 28. Each column stacks a picture over a fill tile or the reverse; the fill tile holds a 24px title and two short 16px lines separated by space only (no rules). The first column is one tall picture tile. Tile fills come from three palette roles only. Phone: no pin; the columns become a two-column staggered grid, one ribbon on top.
phone: No pin; two-column staggered tile grid, one ribbon above it, tiles 16px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Ruled rows become spaced lines; the illustration tile becomes a picture tile; one colour per tile becomes three palette roles; the track runs inside a clipped, inset window so nothing touches the screen edge; tiles are stacks, not boxes in boxes.

name: Media panel with word roller
description: A pinned stage on a mid-grey or tinted ground, three steps of about 1500px of scroll each. At one side a 543x641 media panel, radius 24, 120px in from the page edge; on the other a two-line statement in 80-96px display type, ink on ground. Line one is fixed; line two is a word roller that slides 117px per step through three words, set in the same face, size and colour as line one (no highlight box, no numerals, no rules). Under it a 28-30px three-line paragraph whose letters darken from muted to ink in a stagger of about 12ms per letter as each step settles. The media cross-blurs (12px to 0 over 500ms) at every step. The next instance mirrors the sides.
phone: Media panel on top at 70vw, statement and paragraph below at 18px; steps stay pinned.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged numbering, hairlines and accent words. Designed out: the 97px numeral and the 1px rules go, the highlight box on line one goes, and the rolling word is styled exactly like its line (only its motion differs), so it is not a styled accent word.

name: Canvas shrinks to portrait triptych
description: A cream ground. A full-screen shader canvas (or a looping video) shrinks over about 720px of scroll to a centred portrait window of 331x630 (radius 16). Left column, 120px from the edge: a 48px one-word title and, lower, a 48px two-line headline. At the right, lower, a four-line 18px text, 120px from the edge. About 800px of scroll per scene, three scenes, with the lines swapping. Ink on cream, accent only inside the shader.
phone: The window at 70vw centred, the title above, the text under it, swapped per scene.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow and numbering. Designed out: the small glyph and label at the left and the 169px number at the top right are dropped, and the headline shrinks from 63px four-line to a 48px two-line.

name: Pinned video with giant left headline
description: A dark video pinned at about 0.9 of the screen height, inset 24px from the screen edges (radius 20). A 120px uppercase white headline of three short left-aligned lines at x 72 (line pitch 96px) sits at mid-height. A 30px two-line white sub sits bottom-left and a 300x60 white pill button (dark text, round arrow chip at its right end) sits bottom-right, both 56px from the video's edges. On entering view the headline lines rise out of masks one by one (120ms stagger). Phone: headline 18vw on three lines, sub 18px, the pill spans the width at 56px tall at the bottom.
phone: Headline 18vw on three lines, sub 18px, button full width at 56px tall near the bottom, video inset 12px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: the pill is a filled button, not a card; no box sits on the footage beyond that. Keep it one scene below the hero, not the hero itself.

name: Pinned video panels under a fixed title
description: A sticky 100vh layer with about 900px of scroll per clip, three or four clips. A full-bleed muted looping video changes with each panel (a 500ms crossfade, no wipe). One 120px bold title of one to three words, left or right aligned and 48px in from the edge, stays fixed over the video in white over a flat 30% tint, with nothing under it. On the last panel the video scrolls away while the title holds, then releases. No growing window and no alternating grounds.
phone: The title at 18vw, up to two lines, pinned at the bottom; video cropped vertical.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines. The 1px full-width coloured rule under the title is dropped. Video must be designed or generated, not documentary.

name: Polygon video to letterbox band
description: Pinned for about 900px. A showreel video starts as a small five-point polygon clip (about 220px) at the lower right, grows toward the centre as you scroll, and then opens into a 1296x352 letterbox band near the top as the clip eases into a rectangle with radius 16. A 16px note and a normal pill button at the left scroll away; a 20px caption sits under the band. The polygon is a mask on real footage, used once. Phone: the clip grows from a 120px polygon to the screen width minus 32px by 220px tall band.
phone: Polygon grows from 120px to a full-width (minus 32px) 220px band; note and button stay above it.
houseRuleCheck: The polygon button is replaced by a normal pill. The polygon is a crop of footage, not a drawn decorative shape, and appears once; no other shapes on the page.

name: Answer card row, then results
description: A pinned interactive scene. Four tall answer cards stand in a centred row (241x362 each, 40px apart, radius 24 with optionally cut corners), each filled in a palette tint with a 28px answer word and one 15px line. Choosing one (click, tap or arrow keys plus Enter) lifts it 12px and dims the others to 40%, then the row swaps for a results view: a flat bar graph in the accent (no gridlines, no axes beyond direct value labels) and a row of three 306px result cards with a 22px title, one line and a filled button. Selected state is shown by fill and lift, never by an outline. Phone: answers 2x2 at 160x210, results stacked, the graph shrinks to three bars.
phone: Answers in a 2x2 at 160x210, results as stacked cards, graph reduced to three bars.
houseRuleCheck: No outlines for selection, no gridlines (hairlines); the graph is flat filled bars. Cards are single filled cards, not nested.

name: Full-screen scene with phase pill and next button
description: Each step fills the whole viewport with a rendered 3D scene or a looping render. A 212x44 white pill at the top right holds the phase name (16px, no number chip) and a menu glyph, with a small plain text link beside it. A 300x60 white pill at the bottom right invites the next phase (label plus round arrow chip). A 100 to 120px two-line phase title may sit at the left at mid-height in white. Scenes swap by crossfade over 700ms when the next button is pressed or when scrolling passes a threshold. No list and no spine. Phone: title 44px at the bottom left, the next pill spans the width at 56px, the phase pill 40px tall.
phone: Title 44px bottom-left, next pill full width at 56px, phase pill 40px tall at the top right.
houseRuleCheck: The numbered chip in the phase pill is dropped; the pill shows the phase name only. Pills are buttons, not cards on a photograph.

name: Full-width title over stacking step rows
description: A deep ink ground. A two-word condensed uppercase title set as live text sized to fill the 1296px container (about 140px tall). Below it three step rows are sticky filled cards, each 1296x386 (radius 24) in a slightly different tint of the same ink so they read as layers, not as different colours. Each row holds a 32px semi-bold title and a 340px-wide 18px paragraph at the left (x 112 from the card edge), and a 600x346 video loop (radius 16) at the right. Each new row slides up over the one before while the earlier row sinks 24px and darkens 15% under it. There are no rules and no step numbers. Phone: rows full width, sticky 12px offsets, the video on top at 16:9 and the text under it.
phone: Rows at full width, sticky with 12px offsets; video 16:9 on top, title and paragraph underneath.
houseRuleCheck: Top rules and the step tag with its number are gone; each row is one filled card, so layering comes from the fill and the overlap, not lines.

name: Steps on a rotating disc
description: A pinned stage, one step per 1440px of scroll, on a flat colour. Each step is centred: a 280 by 200 picture (radius 24), then a 140px one-word step name in heavy sans, then a two-line 20px paragraph 360 wide. The sets sit on the rim of a huge invisible disc (a wrapper of about 8000px, rotated 90 degrees per step with its transform-origin far below the screen), so the next set slides in from the right while the current one tilts out to the left. Disc, steps and ground share one hue family and the accent goes on the word. Three or four steps. Phone: no disc; each step is a full-width card (picture on top, word at 56px) that reveals as it scrolls.
phone: No disc; each step is a full-width card revealing on scroll.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged numbering: the 300px stroke numeral becomes a one-word step name and nothing counts the steps. The leaning cartoon figure becomes a picture (no drawn illustration).

name: Centred quote over parallax photo
description: A full-bleed band of 1440x900. A picture 1170px tall, darkened by a flat 35% black layer (no gradient), glides plus and minus 135px with scroll behind a centred white 34px three-line quote set 840px wide at mid-height, with two 16px bold attribution lines (name, role) below. The band follows a plain flat section edge above and below. The quote is one short sentence. Phone: quote 24px in a 80% column, the band 90svh, same glide at half range.
phone: Quote 24px in an 80% column, band 90svh, parallax at half range.
houseRuleCheck: The notched sheets are dropped. The darkening is one flat layer, not a gradient. No card or box sits on the picture; the picture should be rendered or lifestyle, never documentary.

name: Cycling serif quote with corner arrows
description: A warm grey ground. A 966px column starting at x 218 holds a three or four-line 42px serif quote, then a 50px round logo avatar with a two-line credit (name and role, 16px). A large open-quote glyph in the accent sits at the top right, and two 31px filled arrow squares sit at the bottom right. About 5 quotes cycle in place: the old one's lines slide up out of masks, the new one's lines slide in, every 7 seconds, paused on hover, arrows step manually. No counter. Phone: quote 26px in a full-width column, the arrows sit left under the credit.
phone: Quote 26px in a full-width column, arrows at the left below the credit, swipe works too.
houseRuleCheck: The tiny counter line is dropped. The arrows are filled squares, not outlined boxes. Six lines are cut to four to keep the text short.

name: Offset quote band
description: A dark band 300-380px tall with 100px of padding above and 140px below: a 32px white quote of 12 to 20 words in two lines set from x 480 (788px wide at most, an opening mark hanging in the margin to its left), and a 16px muted attribution 24px under it at the same x. It recurs between projects through the page. No media, no controls. Ink is light on the dark ground; the quote mark in the accent.
phone: Quote at 24px from the 20px gutter in four or five lines, the mark above it, the attribution below.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Keep the attribution at 16px, not 13px, and the quote short.

name: Receding perspective cover deck
description: A long pinned scroll under a fixed full-screen ground that takes the front item's colour (always one of three palette-derived grounds, never a free pick). Five or more square cover pictures are stacked in perspective on the centre axis. The front cover is 1280px wide and sits mostly below the fold; each one behind it is 52 to 96px higher and 116 to 152px narrower, fading toward the top. Scroll brings the next cover forward and the ground colour eases over 600ms. A caption row (a 28px title and an arrow glyph) sits 20px above the front cover's lower edge. Phone: covers 90vw wide, the front one half visible, one step per 80svh.
phone: Covers 90vw wide, front cover half in view, one step per 80svh, caption 22px.
houseRuleCheck: Per-item recolouring is limited to three palette-derived grounds so it never sprawls; the label above the title is dropped.

name: Reel frame rising faster than canvas
description: One wide 933x525 frame (16:9, radius 12, no caption, no text) centred horizontally, rises through the fixed canvas faster than the scroll (about 1.5x) and leaves through the top. Inside it, project previews (product screens or looping clips) swap hard every 120px of scroll over about 9 steps. The ground is a flat tone with 160px of space above and below. Phone: the frame is the screen width minus 32px at 4:5, the same swapping and a 1.3x speed.
phone: Frame width minus 32px at 4:5, hard swaps every 100px of scroll, 1.3x speed.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one framed montage, no overlays, no outline, no shadow.

name: Room stations with corner switches
description: A pinned rendered room (pre-rendered stills crossfaded, or WebGL) reached by a baked camera move. A centred overlay: a two-line 105px title whose first line is in a sans and second in a serif (each line whole, no single styled word) and a 52px filled pill button about 70% of the way down. Two plain text switches in the bottom corners, 24px sentence-case names of the other rooms, 48px from the edges, loop through three rooms (the camera moves in 1.2s). No small tag above the title, no counters. White type over a flat 20% tint; the accent on the button.
phone: Title 44px; the two switches at the bottom as two buttons side by side.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow and numbering. The small serif tag above the title and any numerals are dropped; the two faces are assigned per whole line, so it is not a styled accent word.

name: Thumbnail field, stepped heading
description: A white ground with about 32 square thumbnails (55 to 160px, radius 8) scattered across about 1440x1125 with no grid and at least 40px from the screen edges, rising at different speeds (0.6x to 1.6x scroll). Over them, a 128px bold four-word heading in three stair-stepped lines, each indented 160px further right than the one above, with a centred grey filled button with an arrow below it. Thumbnails sit behind the type and never inside the letters. Phone: 14 thumbnails of 48 to 88px, heading 52px in three lines, indent 24px per step.
phone: 14 thumbnails at 48 to 88px, heading 52px on three stepped lines (24px indent per line), button 56px tall.
houseRuleCheck: Heading cut from six to four words; thumbnails keep a 40px margin from the edges and stay behind the text, so no picture is inside the headline.

name: Rotating sphere cluster
description: A pinned WebGL canvas. About 22 spheres of 90 to 170px each carry a still or looping video frame, with a bright rim light and clean reflections, and gather into one cluster about 460x570 that turns slowly at the centre (one rotation in about 30 seconds). The spheres use a satin or ceramic material, never frosted or see-through UI glass. A 120px solid headline sits in the bottom 260px of the screen, behind the cluster so the spheres overlap it slightly, and two small filled pill chips sit fixed in the top corners. Pointer movement tilts the cluster by up to 8 degrees. Phone: 12 spheres, cluster 70vw wide, headline 48px, one chip.
phone: 12 spheres, cluster 70vw wide, headline 48px, one chip; gyro tilt off.
houseRuleCheck: The blurred echo headline becomes a solid headline; the sphere material is satin or ceramic, so it does not read as the banned glass effect. Corner chips are small filled pills.

name: Rotating object sheds plates
description: A pinned viewport-fixed stage with no text and a flat dark ground. A large machined 3D object (about 900px long) stands upright, then tilts and turns over about 3 screens of scroll until it lies horizontal across the centre, while curved armour plates lift off its sides and fly outward in a staggered burst. Without a progress card or any bar: scroll alone drives it. Phone: the object is 80vw long, 6 plates instead of 12, the stage 100svh.
phone: Object 80vw long, 6 plates instead of 12, stage 100svh, same scroll length scaled to 250svh.
houseRuleCheck: The small progress card at the bottom right is dropped (no progress devices). The object needs a real 3D model; no drawn shapes.

name: Rounded colour panel with centred CTA
description: A colour panel (the accent, with ink on it at 7:1 or better) about 1.3 screens tall with 48px rounded bottom corners and 260px of top padding. It holds a centred 140px two-line headline about 780px wide, a centred 28px two-line paragraph about 520px wide 70px below, and a centred filled button 40px under that. A bottom row of three 16px captions spreads across the 1296px container. The next picture panel tucks about 120px under the curved bottom edge. Phone: headline 56px, padding 120px, captions stack in one column (two shown).
phone: Headline 56px, 120px top padding, captions in one column (two shown), the picture panel tucked 60px under.
houseRuleCheck: Paragraph cut from four lines to two. A filled panel with nothing laid on a photograph; no shadow, no gradient.

name: Rounded dark panel rising with tile grid
description: A solid dark panel (radius 43, about 1.1 screens tall) is pulled up so it rises over the previous fixed scene. Inside, with 72px padding: a 141px thin uppercase two-line headline centred (plain type, one style), two 446px text columns of two short lines each, then six project tiles in a row of three columns (two tiles 230x317 and four 173x230, radius 12, gaps 22px). Tiles are pictures with a 16px title appearing on hover. Phone: panel radius 28, headline 48px, the text columns stack, tiles in a 2x3 grid.
phone: Panel radius 28, headline 48px, text columns stacked, tiles in a 2x3 grid, 12px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The struck-through word and the plain word at the two ends of the headline are dropped, so there is no styled word. No outlines or shadows.

name: Rounded video, then clip card row
description: A cream ground. One full-width rounded video (1360x765, radius 16) with a centred one-line 84px white headline across its middle over a flat 25% tint and a 44px filled pause button at the bottom right. 16px under it, a row of three equal filled cards, radius 16: one text card (a 28px sentence at the top left and a 16px line at the bottom left, on the fill) and two video tiles (4:3, with a plain play glyph, no chips). Cards carry a fill and no outline. Ink on cream, one accent on the pause and play.
phone: The video 4:5 with a 40px headline; the three cards stack with 16px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged an outlined box row. The cards have a fill and no outline, and the chips on the video tiles (boxes on a photograph) are dropped.

name: Object travelling a curved path beside headline
description: A tall colour block (the accent or a deep tint), about 2.6 screens tall, pinned for about 1450px of scroll. A solid 216px two-line headline sits at the left from x 72 with a 26px two-line paragraph under it. A real product cut-out (a transparent photograph of an object, or a 3D render) travels along an invisible curved path from the top right across to the left as you scroll, turning about 40 degrees over its travel, passing behind and in front of the paragraph without covering it. At the right, a 360px rounded picture card (radius 24, 72px from the screen edge) holds a lifestyle or rendered picture. Phone: headline 25vw on two lines, the object follows a shorter S curve, the picture card 55vw.
phone: Headline 25vw on two lines, the object follows a shorter S path, picture card 55vw wide.
houseRuleCheck: The visible dashed route, the tilted badge, the sticker and the outlined type are dropped; the path is invisible and the traveller is a real cut-out. The photo card sits 72px from the edge, with no tag on it.

name: Filled title rows with thumbnail chips
description: A light ground. Five full-width filled rows (1296 wide, 96px tall, radius 20, 12px gaps, tint fills) start at the left margin x 72. Each holds a 44px semi-bold one-line title at the left and at the right end a 64px round filled chip containing a small real picture or an arrow glyph. Rows reveal in sequence (60ms stagger, rise 24px). On hover a row fills with the accent, its text inverts and the chip rotates 45 degrees. Phone: rows 72px tall, title 26px, chip 48px.
phone: Rows 72px tall at full width, title 26px, chip 48px; tap fills the row with the accent.
houseRuleCheck: Dotted rules become gaps between filled rows; the line icons become thumbnails or an arrow; the chip row and the empty runway are dropped; rows start at the left margin, so none is empty on the left.

name: Two-by-two filled cell grid
description: A 101px two-word headline at the left margin. Below it a 2x2 grid of four filled cards (two columns of 636px, 24px gutters, 292px high, radius 24) in four tones from the palette (accent, a deep tint, a light tint, a warm neutral). Each card holds a 32px bold lead phrase at the top, a 20px two-line paragraph and a filled pill button at the bottom left. On hover the card fill swaps to the accent, the text inverts and an arrow slides in 8px. Phone: single column of cards at 240px tall, headline 52px.
phone: One column of four cards at 240px tall, 16px gaps, headline 52px.
houseRuleCheck: The rules, slash labels, mono prompt lines, superscript count and outline pills are all dropped; the cells are filled cards and the pill is filled. Colours stay inside four palette roles.

name: Running paragraph of names
description: A light ground. One 53px paragraph across the 1296px container (about 3 lines, 50px leading) made of about 16 client or partner names separated by slashes, all set as text (no logos or pictures in the line). The words start at 20% ink and brighten to full ink one by one as the paragraph passes mid-screen (scrubbed). Nothing else in the section, 160px of space above and below. Phone: type 28px in 6 lines, margin 20px.
phone: Type 28px, about 6 lines, 20px margins, same scrubbed brighten.
houseRuleCheck: The tiny label is dropped and the paragraph sits inside 72px margins, not edge to edge. It is one paragraph, not a credit wall; keep it to about 16 names, and names are text only, since logos set into a display-size line would be pictures inside a headline.

name: Giant title blocks around floating drawing
description: A chapter opener about 3.5 screens tall, pinned for about 2000px, on a chapter colour (one of three tints from the palette). The title is split into heavy stretched word blocks (170-560px type) scattered in a Z or stacked at full width inside the margins. A cut-out object (a photographed or rendered subject with a transparent background) in three depth layers (back, mid, front, moving at 0.6x, 1x and 1.4x) floats between the word blocks in its own depth layer and partly crosses letters, never set inline within a line of type. A 16px caption sits at top centre. It repeats per chapter in a new tint. Ink on the chapter colour.
phone: The words stack at 24vw, the cut-out layered in the middle; the same depth speeds.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The hand-drawn sketch is a drawn illustration (house ban), so it is replaced by a cut-out photograph or render; chapter colours stay in one family.

name: Scattered tiles around centred heading
description: One screen on a plain ground. A centred 60px two-line heading with one short 20px line under it. Four rounded (radius 12) video or picture tiles of about 240x300 are scattered around it: top left, top right, lower left and middle right, each at least 56px from the screen edge and none overlapping the text. Tiles float with a slow vertical drift (plus and minus 12px) and shift 14px opposite to the pointer. Videos loop silently. Phone: four tiles of 120x150 above and below the heading, heading 36px.
phone: Four 120x150 tiles above and below the heading (36px), no pointer shift.
houseRuleCheck: The bracket-corner chip around the heading, the pause chips and the overlap with the first letter are dropped; the right tile no longer runs off the screen edge.

name: Scroll locked until object pulled
description: A flat colour ground. A giant 3D object (a pack, can or box, about 70% of the screen height) fills the middle while two or three product cut-outs pop in around it and a 160px title animates letter by letter above. Scrolling stays locked until the visitor drags a pull-tab on the object or clicks it; then a pour or burst animation plays (about 2 seconds), a scroll hint appears and scrolling resumes. A fallback unlocks scrolling by itself after 6 seconds and for keyboard use (Enter on the tab), so no visitor is trapped. Phone: object 85vw wide, tap the tab or swipe it up, title 22vw.
phone: Object 85vw wide; tap or swipe the tab to open; auto-unlock after 6 seconds; title 22vw.
houseRuleCheck: The sticker is replaced by real product cut-outs; the scroll lock must always time out and have a keyboard route. Place it below the hero, never as the first screen.

name: Scroll-scrubbed full-bleed video
description: A full-bleed video with no text in a section about 4 screens tall. The viewport is pinned and the video playback is scrubbed by scroll position over about 2700px; playback rewinds when scrolling up. Encode all-intra or as a frame sequence for smooth scrubbing. A short pause (200px of no change) at both ends lets the first and last frame breathe. Phone: use a portrait cut of the footage, section 300svh. Variant: the video plays in a centred 988x620 frame (16:10, radius 12) with a 16px mat in a lighter tone of the ground and 226px side margins, no shadow.
phone: Portrait cut of the footage, section 300svh, scrub length 1800px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: one full-bleed video with no text. The footage should be rendered or produced, never documentary.

name: Scene object floods into new ground
description: Pinned for about 1.8 screens. A rendered scene or photograph fills the screen with one small, clear object near the centre (a lamp, a lens, a sun-like disc, a dial; a real object in the picture or a photo masked to a disc, not a drawn shape) taking about 6% of the width. Scroll scales the scene around that object's centre (transform-origin set on it, up to about 18x) until the object's colour fills every edge and becomes the next ground as a flat colour. Then a 56px two-line title and a one-line 18px sentence fade in on that ground and blur out into the next section. The flood colour is the page accent. Phone: same path over 1.4 screens, title 36px.
phone: Same zoom over 1.4 screens, title 36px.
houseRuleCheck: The shape must be a real object in an image (or a photo masked to a disc), never a drawn SVG; the flood colour comes from the page palette only.

name: Cut-corner title card, sliding logo row, rising photo
description: Pinned on a dark ground. A filled accent card with two cut corners (about 520x500) holds a three-word 45px title, with a 18px three-line paragraph at its lower right. Then a row of 8 partner logos (about 40px tall) slides in from the right inside a clipped window with 72px margins. Below, a full-width picture with a flat two-colour duotone treatment rises from the bottom and the next section slides over it. Phone: card 100% wide by 360px, logos in two rows of four, picture 4:5.
phone: Card full width by 360px tall, logos in two rows of four, picture 4:5 rising.
houseRuleCheck: The polygon becomes one filled card with cut corners (a card, not a drawn shape); the logo row shrinks from 13 to 8 so it is not a credit wall and sits inside margins; the duotone is two flat colours, not a gradient.

name: Cut-corner title then drifting matted cards
description: A textured coloured ground (fine grain). A filled card with two cut corners (about 770x280, in a deep tint) holds a three-word 45px title, with a normal pill button and a 18px two-line paragraph offset below it. Then eight project cards (452x318, white fill, radius 16, the picture inset by a 12px mat) drift up in two staggered rows at different speeds (0.8x and 1.3x scroll), up to three on screen; each has a 24px title and a 15px client name inside the card under the picture. An underlined text link ends the scene. Phone: cards 78vw wide, two columns of drift at different speeds with two cards visible.
phone: Cards 78vw wide in two columns drifting at different speeds, two visible at a time.
houseRuleCheck: The polygon title and polygon button become a cut-corner card and a normal pill; text lives inside the filled cards.

name: Two-column sheet lifting off fixed video
description: A full-width cream sheet about 0.6 screen tall with 24px rounded bottom corners, lying over a fixed video. At the left a 56px two-line bold headline at x 260. At the right at x 850 a 18px three-line paragraph (about 400px wide) and a soft grey pill button with a square arrow chip. As the sheet scrolls away it uncovers the next full-screen scene underneath. Phone: the columns stack, headline 36px, the sheet 70svh.
phone: Columns stack; headline 36px, paragraph and button under it, sheet 70svh with 24px bottom radius.
houseRuleCheck: Paragraph raised from 14px to 18px and trimmed to three lines. Clean otherwise: a filled sheet, no outline, no shadow.

name: Shrinking panel, rising cut-out
description: A flat tinted panel (one colour, no gradient), full-bleed at first, shrinks to a 1392px rounded card (24px margins, radius 24, about 1260px tall) and slides up while a centred one-line 84px white headline sits on it. A large cut-out photograph (a hand and arm, a product, a figure) rises from the bottom to fill the panel. Under the panel, a centred 20px three-line caption and a centred video tile (640x360, radius 16). Phone: the panel shrinks to 16px margins, headline 44px on two lines, cut-out 85vw.
phone: Panel shrinks to 16px margins, headline 44px on two lines, cut-out 85vw rising, video tile full width.
houseRuleCheck: The soft gradient is replaced by one flat tint. The cut-out must be a lit, produced photograph, not documentary.

name: Shrunk image column beside title and names
description: A pinned split stage over about 4800px of scroll. The full-bleed picture scene shrinks from the top left to a 480px column inset 32px from the screen edge (radius 20), leaving a column of 480x270 pictures that scrolls up inside it, each picture drifting inside its frame. On the plain ground at the right: a 96px one-word title, a list of four short names in 24px (the active one in full ink, the others at 30%, no rules, no numbers) near the far right, and a 24px two-line paragraph near the bottom. Phone: no pin; the column becomes a full-width carousel-free stack of pictures with the title above.
phone: No pin: title 56px above, then the pictures stacked at full width minus 32px, names listed once under the paragraph.
houseRuleCheck: The picture column is inset by 32px instead of flush to the edge; the ruled numbered index becomes four names with active and idle ink; the tiny caps label and the numbers are gone.

name: Side drawer leaving an edge sliver
description: A white panel (1380x900) slides in over the page and leaves a 60px strip of the page visible at one side; clicking the strip closes it. Its content block sits about 195px from the top on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters: a 30px bold heading with a hanging opening quote mark on the left, and an info column of 18px paragraphs (short) and accent-coloured text links. The slide takes 600ms with an ease-out; the page behind dims by 30% flat. Phone: the panel becomes a sheet rising from the bottom, 92svh tall, with a 24px radius.
phone: A bottom sheet 92svh tall with 24px radius; a tap on the visible strip above closes it.
houseRuleCheck: Info text raised from 14px to 18px; one flat dim, no shadow. The sliver means the panel never runs flush to both edges.

name: Rounded photo scene in sideways strip
description: A pinned horizontal strip that moves about 1.5px per px of scroll. A near-full-viewport picture panel (1392x864, 24px margins, radius 24) slides in from the right after a short statement scene. Over the picture, in white on a flat 30% dark layer: a 60px two-line headline at its lower left, and three benefit columns along its lower right (a 20px bold title and a one-line 16px text each, no icons). The picture is lifestyle or rendered. Phone: no pin; the panel is a 4:5 card of the screen width minus 32px with the headline and three benefits stacked over it.
phone: No pin; a 4:5 card at screen width minus 32px, headline 32px and the three benefits stacked over a flat dark layer.
houseRuleCheck: The accent word styling and the line icons are removed (no icon-topped columns, no styled word in the headline); the dark layer is flat, not a gradient; benefits are plain type, not boxes on the picture.

name: One 3D object per screen with side tags
description: A pinned full-screen canvas, about one screen of scroll per object (4 objects), on a flat soft grey ground with giant flat ghost words (about 28vw, 8% ink) behind. One faceted 3D object (about 320x440) at a time drifts and turns at the centre. At its left a filled pill tag of two lines (a name and a short note, 18px) and at its lower right a three-line 20px data block, both in sentence case. Each object clicks through to a detail view. Phone: object 70vw wide, tag above it, data block below, one object per 100svh.
phone: Object 70vw wide, tag above, data block below, one object per 100svh.
houseRuleCheck: Leader lines (hairlines), mono labels and numbering are removed; the fog gradient becomes a flat grey ground and the blurred ghost rows become flat solid words. The tag is a filled pill beside the object, not a box on a photograph.

name: Single centred mark loader
description: A flat ground in the page ground colour or the accent. One 45px brand mark (the page's own logo glyph or monogram) sits at the exact centre and swaps between two states in 8 stepped frames (for example filled and inverted, or two letterforms of the brand initial) until loading ends. No text and no bar. When ready, the mark scales to 0 and the page appears. Phone: the same, mark 36px.
phone: Same layout with a 36px mark; no change to timing.
houseRuleCheck: The diagonal gradient becomes a flat ground; the pixel-art icon (a drawn illustration) becomes the brand's own mark. Keep the loader under 1.2 seconds.

name: Single centred image column with variable spans
description: A full-page column of images and nothing else, centred on a 24-column grid with 32px outer margins and 14px gutters, 24-40px between images. Each image spans 12, 14, 16 or 24 columns by its aspect: landscapes take 24, portraits 12 to 18 and sit centred, never flush to one side. No captions, borders, radius or text beside the images. The page ground eases between two or three tints of the page palette, one picked to suit each image, as the image crosses mid-screen (a flat colour tween over 600ms, never a gradient) and the ink stays legible on every tint. Seven to ten images; a single 60px centred heading above is allowed. Images simply scroll; optionally the next one rises 24px as it enters. 200px of free space before and after the column.
phone: Every image spans the full width inside 20px gutters with a 20px gap; the colour easing stays.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Pictures must be designed or generated (not archive snapshots), and one image-only column is a single section, not the whole page.

name: Single wide card carousel
description: A grey ground. One big filled card per slide (1296x640, radius 28) inside 72px margins; slides change by arrow buttons (two 48px filled round buttons under the card on the right) and a 7 second auto-advance, with a 500ms crossfade-and-rise. Left half of the card: a 44px serif title, a 18px two-line paragraph, two big stats side by side in plain type (a 56px number and a 16px caption each), and one filled button. Right half is the card's own tinted fill (a split, not a nested panel) holding a fan of three framed phone screens (product UI). Phone: the card is 560px tall at the screen width minus 32px, the fan sits above the text, arrows below.
phone: Card 560px tall at screen width minus 32px, the phone fan on top, text below, arrows under the card.
houseRuleCheck: Nested stat tiles become plain type, the grey side panel becomes one tint of the same card, and the peeking card is gone, so nothing runs into the screen edge and there is no drag rail; slides advance by buttons and timer.

name: Small-wide pair then three-up grid
description: A band on a pale ground. A centred 28px sentence-case heading, one short line, sits 52px above a 12-column grid, 1360px wide with 40px margins and 16px gutters. Row one pairs a small filled card (4 columns, about 440px: a 440x300 picture on top, a 20px title and one 16px line on the card fill, radius 16) with a wide card (8 columns, about 900px: a 900x600 picture), tops aligned; the sides swap on each repeat. Below, rows of three 440px cards, 128px apart vertically. Hover: the picture scales 1.03 and the card fill steps one tint. Ink on card, accent unused or on one link.
phone: One column, the wide card first, 20px between cards.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict if used as one section among others (not a page made only of boxes). The captions sit on the card fill so the text is grouped with the image; the small label and arrow above the grid are replaced by a plain heading.

name: Sparse tall tile with scattered labels
description: A white sheet slides up over the fixed previous scene. Twelve-column grid with 40px margins. One 440x615 dark tile (radius 20) holds a 3D render at column 5. A 20px two-line statement sits at columns 1 to 3 near the top so the left is not empty; a right-aligned 20px word sits left of the tile lower down; a date in 20px sits at mid-height on the right, and at the foot a 325px-wide text link with a thin arrow. Nothing else; 200px of space around it all. Phone: the tile at 70vw, labels stacked above and below.
phone: The tile at 70vw, labels in a single column above and below it, link at the foot.
houseRuleCheck: The 2px rule above the link row is dropped (a plain text link with arrow); a statement is placed in columns 1 to 3 so the left of the grid is not left empty.

name: Split card, photo half and text half
description: One black card (1296x640, radius 24) inside 72px margins. Its left half is a picture flush to the card's edge. Its right half, with 40px padding, has a 56px two-line white title at the top and, at the bottom, an 18px two-line paragraph and one large filled pill button (label plus arrow glyph, about 300x60). No inner tile, no tag, no label. On entering view the picture scales from 1.1 to 1 inside the card and the title lines rise out of masks. Phone: the picture on top at 4:3, the text part under it, the button full width.
phone: Picture on top at 4:3, text part below, button full width at 56px.
houseRuleCheck: The nested dark link tile, the tag and the mono and caps labels are dropped; the link is a normal filled button, so there is no box in a box.

name: Split giant word crossed by a strip
description: A black ground about 1.2 screens tall. One word is split diagonally across the screen: the first half, about 317px tall, sits top-left 56px in from the edges and the second half sits lower-right, cut through by the strip. A 42px full-width strip (a flat accent band repeating a short word in 20px type, no drawn shapes) drifts sideways at mid-height. Two small heading-and-paragraph pairs (24px and 16px, two lines) sit in the opposite corners. Phone: the word halves at 36vw, the strip at 36px, the pairs stacked under the word.
phone: Word halves at 36vw stacked diagonally, the strip at 36px, the two pairs stacked under the word.
houseRuleCheck: The three uppercase tags at the top are dropped; the strip of repeated drawn shapes is replaced by a repeating word. The giant word is plain type with no picture inside it.

name: Split modal: picture and scroll pane
description: A centred modal of 1040x620 (at most the viewport minus 120px each way), radius 28, flat dark fill, opening over a scene with a 250ms scale-and-fade. Two panes with no gap: the left 520px is a cover-fit picture flush to the modal edge; the right 520px scrolls on a slightly lighter dark fill, with a 50px display title (a custom-lettered or characterful face), 20px body text and two filled buttons. A row of 3 text tabs hangs at the top of the right pane. Phone: the modal becomes a full-screen sheet with the picture above (35vh) and the text below.
phone: Full-screen sheet: 35vh picture on top and the text pane scrolling below; tabs under the picture.
houseRuleCheck: The inset 1px frame, the radial gradient fill, the progress bars and the icon tabs are dropped; the modal has flat fills and filled buttons, and the picture is flush so there is no box in a box.

name: Split poster with rising circle
description: One screen split at x 720. Left half: a flat saturated palette colour. A circular photo mask about 640 across rises from below the fold to the centre of that half as the section enters; it is a clip-path circle holding one picture, so the circle is a crop of a real image, never a flat drawn disc. Right half: near-black, a three-line 104px white headline (6 to 9 characters per line) centred, and one 21px bold sentence low down, 560 wide. Each half centres its own content. The next instance mirrors the sides and swaps the colour. Phone: stack the halves, 60vh colour half with a 300px circle, then the dark half with a 48px headline.
phone: Halves stacked, 300px circle in a 60vh colour half, dark half with a 48px headline.
houseRuleCheck: The 32px line grid (hairlines) is dropped; the black disc becomes a photo crop so it is not a drawn shape.

name: Split square tile pair
description: Two near-square tiles side by side across the full width, 24px page margins and 16px between: each about 688 by 680 (radius 24) in a flat fill, one palette colour per tile (a light one and a deep one). Each holds one product render or cut-out centred at about 60% of the tile, a 28px name at the top left (20px inset) and one small filled round arrow bottom right. No header strip, label or swatch dots. Hover scales the object 1.06 with a 3 degree turn and deepens the tile fill. Tiles rise in together. Phone: tiles stack at full width, 16px between.
phone: Tiles stack at full width, 16px between.
houseRuleCheck: The header strip with a label and line, and the swatch dots (colour sprawl) are dropped.

name: Split title closing on growing media
description: A dark band two screens tall with a sticky 100vh stage. At the start two 144px heavy words sit far left (x 60) and far right on one baseline (3 to 7 letters each), with a small clip or photo between them, 360 by 225 (radius 16), centred. While pinned for about 900px the words close in toward the centre from opposite sides while the media grows to about 1200 by 750 (radius 20); at the end the words meet on the media's lower third in white, over a flat 25% tint on it. When the pin releases, a two-line centred 22px paragraph sits under the media. No label above. Phone: words 64px on one row above and below the media; the media grows from 70% to 100% width. Variant: a 256x320 portrait slot opens from a 50% clip inset while the two halves of one 140px condensed uppercase line slide in from outside and overlap it in a difference blend; the slot hard-cuts between five pictures every 600ms of scroll.
phone: Words 64px above and below the media; media grows from 70% to 100% width.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged eyebrow: the small label is dropped. The words are type on a dimmed picture; no box sits on the photograph.

name: Title parts around a centre opening
description: Over a camera flight above a landscape (pre-rendered video or a 3D scene), a two-word 104px thin title builds letter by letter (blur to sharp, 30ms stagger) at the centre. Then the two words part to the left and right as an opening of about 120px forms between them, with the landscape visible through it, holding a short 20px line of text, plain, with no shape drawn around it. A 20px two-line paragraph sits near the bottom; the letters fade as the view lifts. Phone: the title on two lines (52px), parting vertically, the paragraph at the bottom.
phone: Title on two lines at 52px, the words part up and down instead of left and right, paragraph near the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The outline diamond (an outlined drawn shape) is replaced by an empty opening in the type with a plain text line in it; no shapes are drawn.

name: Spread title over staggered portrait cards
description: A coloured ground. One 96px title line is spread across the full 1296px container in three pieces in one style (a word at the left, a word at the centre, a word right-aligned) with a 16px two-line sub under it. Below, three loose columns of portrait cards: the outer two (324x406, radius 16) level at y 274, the smaller middle card (210x236) dropped 216px. Each card is a filled card with the picture flush at the top and the 24px name and a 15px one-line note in the plate under it. 160px of space follows the section. Phone: cards 78vw wide stacked with a 20px stagger to the left and right, title 40px on two lines.
phone: Cards 78vw wide stacked with a 20px left and right stagger, title 40px on two lines.
houseRuleCheck: The italic phrase and the small arrow in the title are dropped (no styled accent words); the cards carry their own filled plates; the next row no longer peeks in, so there is real space after the section.

name: Square video over filled accordion rows
description: Ground = warm palette ground, ink near-black. A top row with the brand word at left and one pill button at right (no rule). Centred beneath, a square looping muted video 543px at 1440 (about 38% of the width), radius 16. 120px lower, an accordion of 4-5 rows: each row is a filled bar (fill = a tone one step off the ground, radius 24, 1056px wide, centred, 12px gap between rows) holding one centred word at 96px in the display face, ink; no rules anywhere. Click or tap lifts the word up and out over 320ms while the bar grows into a centred 830x560 panel (radius 24) where a 24px lead line and one 18px paragraph rise in 60ms apart; one panel open at a time, the others slide down. Hover on a closed row shifts its fill one tone and nudges the word up 6px. Phone: the video is full container width at 1:1, rows stay full-width bars with the word at 13vw, and a panel opens in place pushing the rows below down, 20px padding, 17px paragraph.
phone: Square video full width, rows as full-width bars with 13vw words, panel opens in place.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines. The header rule and the full-width row rules are gone: rows are filled bars separated by gaps, no outlined box.

name: Giant stacked type beside swapping product
description: Pinned for about 300svh on a light palette ground (ink near-black, accent one saturated brand colour). Top band: a three-word caps headline at 140px/0.9, centred, display face. Below, two columns: left (columns 1-6) a stacked block centred in its column: a short name-tag in a flat accent pill (24px text, radius 999, 14px 28px padding), then three caps lines at 80px, 150px and 80px with 0.8 leading, ink; right (columns 7-12) a product cut-out about 465x372 sitting straight on the ground with no frame, and under it a 40px name in the display face and a 26px price, centred. Scroll steps through 3-5 products: the cut-out slides 40px and fades while the next rises in, name and price swap through a 240ms mask, the pill takes the next product's colour from the palette; the headline stays. No buy controls. Phone: stays pinned; headline 10vw, stacked block scaled to 9vw/16vw/9vw above, product at 80% width below with a 28px name and a 20px price.
phone: Same pinned swap with scaled type above and the product full width below.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The wavy outline round the cut-out and the sticker look are dropped (no outlined or drawn shapes); the name-tag is a flat filled pill.

name: Dark panel over a card strip
description: Palette ground, then one inset dark panel (flat deep ink fill, no gradient, no shadow), 1344px wide, radius 24, about 80svh tall, 48px in from the sides. Inside, a top-centred stack: a 56px headline in the display face (4-6 words, light ink), one 18px sub line, a filled accent button and a text link side by side. A product collage (one UI window plus one or two cut-out objects, real images) rises from the panel's bottom edge and is cropped by it, so it bleeds out of the panel at the bottom only. 24px below the panel, a strip of 3-4 filled cards sits straight on the page ground, not inside a second panel: each 660x300, radius 24, fills alternating between two palette tones, a 28px title and a 17px line at the foot. The strip is pinned and translates sideways as the page scrolls, the next card peeking 120px at the right inside the container. No dragging. Phone: the panel is full container width with the collage under the text at 4:3 cropped by the panel; cards stack vertically with 16px gaps, 4:3 each.
phone: Panel full width with collage below the text; cards stacked vertically.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged gradient, shadow, drag-rail and nested boxes. The panel is a flat fill with no shadow; the second panel is removed so the cards sit on the ground (no boxes in boxes); the strip moves with scroll and has no drag rail, arrows or bar.

name: Staggered four-column cut-out cards
description: Dark palette ground, light ink. A two-line 64px headline at left across 5 columns and a one-line 18px paragraph at columns 8-12. Below, a 4-column grid in the 1344 container with 24px gutters and about 8 filled cards 318x330 (radius 24, fill = a tone one or two steps lighter than the ground, alternating through 2-3 palette tones, no outline); columns 2 and 4 are dropped 180px so the grid zigzags. Each card holds a cut-out object (product or render on transparent ground) centred at about 70% of the card, and a filled name chip at the bottom right (radius 16, ground-colour fill, 20px name and the year) that reads as a notch cut into the card. Rows rise 40px in with a 90ms stagger per column on entry; hover tilts the object 4 degrees and lifts it 8px. A centred one-line 40px closing line follows 160px lower. Phone: two columns with a 100px drop kept, cards 4:5, chip text 16px, closing line centred.
phone: Two columns, 100px drop kept, 4:5 cards.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged an outlined box row. Cards are filled tones with no outline; the notched tab is a flat filled chip, not a drawn notch.

name: Stair-step headline into map card
description: Ground = deep palette ground, light ink; the accent is used for the pill only. A three-word headline in a display serif, caps, 144px/0.92, one word per line, laid in descending steps inside the 1344 container: word 1 right-aligned, word 2 left-aligned with a short three-letter word at 48px set beside it, word 3 indented 12% from the left; lines rise out of masks 90ms apart on first view. 120px below, a row split 7/5: left a map card (a real map render, radius 24, 4:3 about 760x570) with three filled accent pins that show a name chip on hover; right a filled address card (palette fill one tone up from the ground, radius 24, 32px padding) with a 20px address in three short lines, one 17px opening-hours line and a filled accent pill button. Phone: headline at 15vw keeping its steps at 0, 18% and 36% indent; the map card 4:3 full width with the address card under it.
phone: Steps kept at 0/18%/36% indent, map card then address card full width.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels, hairlines and edge-touch. The line-art map and the hairline are replaced by a real map render in a rounded card; labels are 17-20px sentence case; every step stays inside the margins; the portrait is dropped.

name: Centred caps stack with corner bios
description: Ground = near-white palette ground, ink near-black. A five-line headline of six words in a heavy grotesque, caps, about 150px/0.9 (136px line pitch), centred, widest line about 900px, 150px of space above and below. At mid-height two small bio blocks sit in the container's left and right margins (48px in), each 17px: a name and two short role lines, the left one left-aligned and the right one right-aligned; they fade in 400ms after the headline. A flat ink pill button (ground-colour text, 52px tall) is centred 48px above the section's end. Headline lines rise out of masks 80ms apart. Phone: headline at 14vw in the same five lines, the two bio blocks sit side by side under it at 15px, the pill goes full width at the end.
phone: Five-line headline at 14vw, bios side by side under it, full-width pill.

name: Centred display over a row of colour chips
