Left half: a tall picture 639x1040 at 1440 (ratio 0.61), radius 24, inside the 48px margin, with parallax inside its frame (the picture is 115% and travels about 8% over the scroll). Right half: a centred four-line 32px statement of about 22 words in the display face, ink, at the vertical middle of the column; nothing above it. 120px of padding. The statement fades up 24px on entry. Phone: the picture at 4:5 full width on top, the statement under it centred at 24px.
phone: 4:5 picture on top, centred 24px statement under it.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The 12px caption is dropped, the 20px margin becomes 48px and the 4px radius follows the house card radius.

name: Two-line display over exit row
description: A page-ground section with 48px side margins and 160px above. A two-line display statement at 112px (6 to 9 words), set from x 48 and spanning 60 to 94% of the width, in the strong ink with tight tracking. 48px below it, one exit row on the 12-column grid: a three-line 18px paragraph at column 5 (about 400 wide) and a filled pill link at columns 8 to 9. No rule between statement and row; the gap is the separation. The lines rise 24px from zero opacity once. Phone: statement 40px, paragraph and pill stacked below at 24px margins.
phone: Statement 40px, paragraph and pill stacked at 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged hairlines: the full-width rule under the statement is dropped. The 14px paragraph is raised to 18px and the 162 by 22 bar becomes a filled pill.

name: Wide statement over a text-and-clip card
description: Ground = palette ground. A two-line 42px statement left-aligned in the 1344px container, ink. 126px below, a centred filled card 932x270 (fill = palette tone one step off the ground, radius 24) split in half: one side a centred three-line 17px paragraph with 32px padding, the other a 440x250 landscape clip (radius 16, muted autoplay loop) with a round filled accent play chip 56px centred on it that opens the clip large in a modal. The card rises 40px on entry. Phone: statement 26px; the card full width with the clip on top at 16:9 and the paragraph under it.
phone: Clip on top at 16:9, paragraph under it.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The 14px paragraph becomes 17px and the 35px margins become 48px.

name: Colour card with value rows and a rising cut-out
description: Ground = palette ground. One dark colour card 1344x700 (fill = deep palette tone, radius 32) centred. Inside: a two-line 38px headline at top left; three stat rows below, each with an 18px sentence-case label at the left and a 96px value in the display face right-aligned (figure plus unit), rows 120px apart with no lines between. A cut-out figure about 330px (a person or object on transparent ground) climbs from below over the card's bottom edge to overlap it by 80px while the values count up from 0 over 1.2s, once, eased. Phone: the card full container width, headline 26px, rows stacked label over value (value 56px), the cut-out at the bottom right at 40% width overlapping the edge by 40px.
phone: Rows stacked label over value, 56px values, cut-out bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The 1408px card becomes 1344px for the margins and the 12px labels become 18px sentence case.

name: Four numerals over a landscape
description: Ground = deep palette ground, light ink; 240px of padding above. Four equal columns in the 1344 container on a 336px pitch: each a 144px light serif numeral centred (figure plus unit) over a two-line 17px sentence-case caption; the numerals count up on entry. 120px lower, a processed picture (halftone or duotone treatment of a landscape or a place tied to the subject, not a documentary photograph) fills the rest of the section as an inset band 1344px wide and 560px tall, radius 24, with a 6% parallax inside the frame. Phone: two columns of two numerals at 72px with 16px captions, the picture at 4:3 under them.
phone: Two columns of numerals at 72px, 4:3 picture under them.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge-touch. The picture no longer bleeds off both sides: it sits inside the margins with a radius; the 10px caps captions become 17px sentence case.

name: Giant stat rows with copy at right
description: Ground = a flat deep palette tone (no gradient). Four rows 365px apart, each with a two-line stat at 175px/0.85 in the display face (the number on line one, the noun on line two), light ink, from the 48px left margin; at the top right (about x 1035, 330px wide) one 18px paragraph of about 12 words aligned to the top of the row. No lines between rows. Letters rise 60px and fade in on a 20ms stagger per character as each row enters, and the numbers count up. Phone: stat 22vw, the paragraph under it at 17px, rows 220px apart.
phone: Stat 22vw, paragraph under it, rows 220px apart.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The gradient canvas and the lines between rows of the study's reading are dropped.

name: Two-pane price board
description: Ground = palette ground. One row about 520px tall of two filled panes with a 12px gap and no rules. Left pane (5 columns): fill = a palette tone, radius 24, 40px padding, a two-line 33px title at the top and a filled ink button at the bottom. Right pane (7 columns): fill = one tone lighter or darker, radius 24, a top row (name at left, type at right, 18px), a centred 128px bold price with a small 24px unit, and along the bottom a row of four label-over-value pairs (label 16px muted, value 22px). The price ticks to its value once on entry. Phone: panes stack with the left pane first, price at 22vw, the four stats as a 2x2 grid.
phone: Panes stacked, price 22vw, stats as a 2x2 grid.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines. The full-width and vertical hairlines and the outline button are replaced by two filled panes and a filled button.

name: Marquee of stat chips
description: A single marquee row on the ground, 120px of space above and below, no rule and no label over it. The row is 88px tall, masked 48px in from the container ends, moving left at 40px/s on a loop and pausing on hover. Each unit is a filled chip (fill = a palette tone one step off the ground, radius 999, 14px 28px padding) holding a 28px figure in the display face and a 16px label, with a 40px gap between chips; the fills alternate between two palette tones and every fifth is accent; 8-10 real stats, duplicated for a seamless loop. Phone: same row at 30px/s, chip figure 22px.
phone: Same loop at 30px/s, 22px figures.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The label and rule above, the outline chips and the dashed dividers of the study's reading are replaced by filled chips.

name: Mixed-size bento of big numbers
description: A palette-colour ground. A bento in the 1344 container on three columns of 5, 4 and 3 grid units (about 560, 448 and 336px) with 14px gaps and the page's card radius (0-28px): six cards, alternating dark and light palette tones with accent on one card only. A 560x280 card with a 150px number; a tall 560x630 card with a looping video or a picture; a 336x336 light card with a 90px number; a 448x280 dark card with a 120px number and a 16px line; a 448x336 picture card; a 336x336 card with a short title. Numbers count up, the video plays on entry, hover lifts a card 6px. No icons or drawn illustrations. Phone: single column, numbers 72px, the tall card at 4:5, two small cards paired side by side.
phone: One column, 72px numbers, small cards paired.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The illustration and the plus mark of the study's reading are dropped; corners follow the page's card radius instead of being square.

name: Particle ring with label lists
description: A pinned canvas chapter of about 500svh on a deep palette ground. A WebGL particle ring: about 1500 small round sprites (3-6px, two or three palette tones) orbit a centre and fall inward in three ring segments of different radius and colour; scroll adds a segment's worth of progress. Four lists, each a filled card (ground-tone fill, radius 16, a 20px title and three or four 17px items) sit around the ring at its corners; hovering or tapping a list highlights its segment (the others dim to 30%) and a one-line paragraph appears under the ring's centre. Paragraphs appear in turn as the scroll advances. Phone: the ring at 80% width in the upper half, the lists stacked below as an accordion where a tap highlights the segment, 600 particles.
phone: Ring in the upper half, lists as an accordion, 600 particles.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing; the lists are filled cards in 17px sentence case, no tiny labels.

name: Rotated numeral beside image panels
description: Pinned for about 150svh. Ground = light palette ground, ink near-black. Left: a three-character figure turned -90 degrees (reading bottom to top), about 184x547, in a heavy display face (a measured number from the content, with a unit if there is one), ink or accent. Centre: a 618x600 portrait picture panel, radius 24. Right column about 330px wide split in two: a short 20px sentence at the top and under it a 324x306 close-up picture panel (radius 24) with one small cut-out object overlapping its corner. The pieces slide in from their sides on scroll (numeral rises, panels fade-rise 80ms apart) and the centre picture slowly scales from 1.05 to 1. No ruled lines, ticks or notches. Phone: the numeral horizontal at 30vw on top, then the centre picture at 4:5, the close-up, and the sentence last.
phone: Numeral horizontal on top, then pictures, sentence last.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing, but the vertical line, the ruled lines, the tick ruler and the notches of the study's reading are hairlines and drawn shapes and are left out; the numeral is a data figure, not numbering.

name: Text left, offset number tile columns
description: Light ground. Left, a narrow text block at x 72 aligned to the top of the tile field: a 16px paragraph about 280px wide, three lines at most, and one text link under it. Right, six filled tiles 288x360 in two columns of three (columns at x 640 and 944, 16px gaps, radius 20), each tile a solid tint from a two-tone set (a deeper tint and a pale accent tint, alternating) with no borders. Each tile carries a 72px serif figure in the accent colour at top-left and a 24px caption at bottom-left (what the figure measures). The second column starts 26px lower and drifts upward against the scroll (translateY about -40px across the section) so the two columns slip past each other. Hover lifts a tile 6px and flips its fill to the ink colour with ground-coloured text. Phone: text first, tiles in one column at full width, 200px tall, drift off.
phone: Single column of full-width tiles, text block above, no counter-drift.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged outlined tiles. Designed out: tiles are solid fills with no 1px borders. Figures are statistics, not 01/02/03 numbering. Hover lift has no shadow.

name: Ticker strip over three-column data
description: Dark ground. Top: a 76px-high strip in a slightly lighter dark tone (no rules above or below) where a 40px serif title in caps repeats with 80px of space between repeats (no glyph) and glides sideways (about 40s per loop, slows on hover). 120px below, three columns in a 1296px container. Left: a 20px sentence-case label in muted ink, a 72px two-line serif date or headline figure, a 20px subhead and two filled data rows (56px-high tinted bars, label left, value right). Centre: a 420x520 image, radius 20, a halftone or dithered render in one accent tone. Right: four label-over-value pairs (14px muted label, 28px value) 32px apart, then three tinted data rows. Rows are separated by space and a tint step, never by lines. Phone: the strip stays with a 28px title; columns stack, image second at 4:5.
phone: Strip kept at 56px high; the three columns stack with the image between the date and the data pairs.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines (rules around the strip and between data rows). Designed out: the strip is a tone change and rows are tinted bars separated by space. Labels are sentence case at 14px or larger, no letter-spacing.

name: Tilted tiles settling into a mosaic
description: Plain solid ground (no dashed or drawn lines). Left: a 62px bold three-line sentence-case headline, its first line indented about 120px. About 120px below, a gapless mosaic centred in the container, 922px wide: a 461x354 tile, a 461x220 tile bottom-aligned beside it, and a 922x220 tile under both, 28px radius on the outer corners only. Tiles are solid fills in two or three tints of one hue; each holds a 14px label and a 16px bold sentence-case list of three or four short items. On entry the tiles arrive rotated 4 to 8 degrees and 30px off, then settle flat in a 0.9s stagger. Phone: tiles stack full width with a 3 degree tilt that settles.
phone: Tiles stack at full width, 3 degree tilt-settle, headline 40px.
houseRuleCheck: A dashed drawing pattern on the ground is left out: solid ground only. Uppercase list labels set in sentence case. A section of tiles only: keep text and space around it so the page is not only boxes.

name: Tilting stat cards beside pinned heading
description: Cream ground, about 2.7 screens tall. Left column pinned at x 72: an 81px three-line sentence-case headline (plain, no underline or highlight on any word) and an 18px paragraph 300px wide. Right, from x 908, three 424x550 cards in a solid light fill (radius 28), each with a 144px figure in the accent colour, a small filled pill (14px, sentence case) and an 18px caption. Cards enter one at a time over about 1570px of scroll, rotated plus or minus 11 degrees, and straighten as they land, each settling 60px lower than the last so the stack fans downward. Phone: heading not pinned; cards stack at full width with 16px gaps and a 3 degree tilt that straightens on entry.
phone: Pinned heading dropped; cards stack, small tilt straightens on entry.
houseRuleCheck: Wavy underline under a headline word removed (accent word and drawn shape). Pill is a solid fill, not outlined. Figures are statistics, not counters.

name: Stepped headline over photo, with proof row
description: Nearly two screens tall over a full-bleed photo (touching both side edges, 140% tall) that drifts plus or minus 150px against the scroll. A four-line 140px condensed uppercase headline, white on the photo, each line starting at a different x offset (0, 120, 60, 200px) so the lines step; the last line slides sideways about 160px with scroll. A 360x72 pill button is centred about 820px down. Below the photo, on the page ground and never on the picture, a proof row of three filled stat cards (300px wide, a 28px figure and a 16px caption each) and a centred three-line 28px quote with a plain name. As the next section arrives the scene clips into a rounded card (radius 32). Phone: headline 56px with steps of 0/24/12/36px, stat cards stack, parallax halved.
phone: Headline 56px with smaller steps, proof cards stacked, parallax halved.
houseRuleCheck: Award badges in the proof row replaced by plain stat cards (no badge or credit wall). The photo must be art-directed, never an archive or documentary picture. Condensed caps are display size, never tiny. The critic moved the stat cards and the quote off the photograph onto the ground below it (no boxes on photographs).

name: Sticky chapter cover under inset panels
description: Per chapter, a full-screen photograph (1440x900) is held sticky for the whole chapter, about 5000-7000px of scroll. It grows from scale 0.85 to 1 on entry while the previous chapter sinks and dims (brightness 0.6). A 22px sentence-case line sits at mid-height 140px in from each side, white on a flat 25% tint. The chapter's panels (ground tint, radius 16, 24px in from each side, 96px padding) then scroll up over the cover one after another; each holds one block of the chapter, a 44px two-line title, a three-line 18px paragraph and one or two pictures (radius 12) on a 12-column grid, set straight on the panel with no box inside it; the cover is visible only above the first panel and in the gaps. It repeats for each chapter with a new photograph. Ink on panels, no accent needed.
phone: Cover at 100svh stays sticky; panels at 16px inset; the side lines move to the bottom of the cover.
houseRuleCheck: Pairs well with the see-through gap pattern. The bracketed labels are replaced by 22px sentence-case lines; panels are inset so nothing touches the edge. The photographs must be designed, not archive material.

name: Sticky name bar over tall bent photo
description: A container-wide product photograph, about 1360x1510 (ratio 0.9) with 40px margins, drawn as a segmented WebGL plane that bends with scroll speed (skews up to 6 degrees with the scroll direction, eases back; a flat image as fallback). Its top edge carries a 56px bar in ink holding the product name centred in 44px caps; the bar sticks at the viewport top while the photograph passes under it. A 308x52 filled button sits centred on the bottom edge of the photograph, half over and half under. The three product facts go as one plain centred 18px line under the photograph, not as chips on it. 240px of space after.
phone: Photo at full width inside 20px gutters (4:5), bar 48px, the button at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The four tag chips on the photograph (boxes on a photograph) are dropped. The name bar is a header strip belonging to the section, not a card laid on the picture.

name: Sticky notched media beside text steps
description: A white ground. At the right a media frame (a looping clip, a product screen or a picture) of about 695x830 (radius 12) stays sticky for four steps of 550px; its left edge carries a trapezoid notch about 60px deep (a clip-path cut) that slides down the frame as you scroll. In the left column (about 426px) text items sit 555px apart: a 34px title over a four-line 20px paragraph. Unread text is muted grey and darkens to ink as it crosses mid-screen, and the frame crossfades to each item's clip. 80px margins at both sides. Variants: the text swaps in place while the picture wipes upward to the next (clip-path 100% to 0 over 700ms) under a centred 60px title; the picture sits in a 446px square slot at the left of a dark stage with the steps at the right; or a sticky picture fills the right half (inset 24px, radius 24) while six one-line steps dim to 35% when inactive. No line, marker or progress of any kind.
phone: The frame becomes a sticky 16:10 strip at the top at 90vw; the text scrolls under it; no notch.
houseRuleCheck: No ban. The notch is a clip-path cut in the media frame, not a drawn ornament; if it reads as decoration, drop it and the pattern is a plain sticky frame.

name: Sticky notched panel stack with alternating tilt
description: Four wide panels, about 1240px wide with 100px side margins so tilt and offset stay inside the screen, each with a notched top edge (42px corner cuts and a centre notch, a clip-path) and 64px padding. Each holds a 518x575 photograph at the left (radius 16) and, at the right, a 53px two-line title, a three-line 18px paragraph and a list of three short lines with small filled bullets (no icons). The panels stack sticky, each offset 68px sideways and tilted 3 degrees alternately left and right, on alternating grounds from one palette family; the earlier panel sinks and dims as the next arrives.
phone: Panels at 16px inset without tilt, the photograph on top, the text below; they still stack.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged nothing. The small icon in the index row is dropped (no icon-topped cards). A stack of panels is a page of boxes if nothing else sits around it, so use it as one section only.

name: Sticky stage with expanding list and round video
description: A sticky 100vh stage (about 2 screens of scroll) on a dark ground with 40px padding, laid out as a space-between column. Top: a 108px two-line caps title and a pill button. Bottom left: three list items; inactive ones sit at 40% ink, the active one grows into a 32px title plus a 16px description at full ink, and the active item advances with scroll. At right a large round video (a disc about 720px) sits fully inside the stage, 40px from the right and bottom edges, with a smaller 200px round video overlapping its lower left; the video cross-fades per item. No fill-bar or rule beside the list. Phone: disc 70vw centred above the list, title 48px, items stacked.
phone: Round video centred above a stacked list, one item expanded at a time.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge-touch and a progress bar. Designed out: the disc is fully inside the margins and the 2px filling rule is dropped (active state shown only by opacity and growth). The idea (expanding list in a corner beside an oversized round video) is kept.

name: Sticky tabs over giant heading
description: Pale ground. A sticky row of four tab buttons stays at the top of the viewport: 16px sentence case, 56px-high pills in a filled segment, the active one a solid ink pill with ground-coloured text. Below it, for each tab, a centred three-line 146px condensed caps heading (line-height 0.8), then an asymmetric spread: a tall 664x890 photo in columns 1 to 6, an 18px paragraph in columns 10 to 12 and, lower in 10 to 12, a 320x400 photo that cross-fades per tab. Switching tabs swaps the heading lines with a 0.5s clip reveal and cross-fades both photos. Phone: tabs become a 2x2 pill grid pinned at the top, heading 56px, photos stack full width, paragraph beneath.
phone: Tabs as a 2x2 pill grid pinned on top; heading and photos stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines (underline on the active tab). Designed out: the active tab is a filled pill. Photos must be styled, not documentary. No numbering on tabs.

name: Tabbed expanding card row
description: White ground. A centred 46px headline over an 18px three-line paragraph (no label above). Then a control row in the 1296px container: four 56px tab buttons at the left (16px sentence case, the active one a filled ink pill) and two 56px round arrow buttons at the right. Below, a card row 640px tall with nothing cut by an edge: the active card is about 700px wide (a photo filling it under a flat 35% dark tint, a 46px title, an 18px two-line paragraph and a pill button at bottom-left); three collapsed cards about 190px wide stand beside it on a filled tint, each with a small photo and a 20px title; gaps 16px. Tabs and arrows switch the active card: widths ease over 0.6s and the paragraph fades in at the end. Phone: only the active card at full width (4:5); the collapsed cards become a tab row above it.
phone: One full-width card at a time, tab row above, arrows below.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged cards running off the right edge. Designed out: the whole row sits inside the container with three collapsed cards beside the active one. Blurred photo and label dropped; the tint is flat, not a gradient.

name: Tabbed panel beside a 3D object
description: A flat solid ground colour stage. Centred near the top, a 33px two-line headline. Right, a tilted 3D object on a canvas (about 520px, slow turn, a gentle tilt that follows the pointer). Left of centre, a solid 600x300 card in a filled tint (radius 24): a row of five 14px pill tabs (the active one filled ink), an 18px text and a 14px caption below, and a full-width 56px solid button under the card. Switching tabs fades the text in 0.3s and turns the object to a matching angle or material. No photograph or blur behind the card. Phone: headline, 280px object, then the card and button at full width, tabs wrapping to two rows.
phone: Object on top at 280px, card and button full width beneath.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged glass, nested boxes, an eyebrow tag and tiny uppercase labels. Designed out: the panel is a solid fill (no blur, no hairline), the photo and the tag are gone, tabs are plain sentence-case pills. What is kept is the idea of a tabbed info card beside a live 3D object.

name: Tabbed chip row beside text over a scene
description: Over a fixed full-screen dark scene (canvas or shader). Left, at x 96: a 50px two-line caps heading, a three-line 18px paragraph and a round 56px button. Right column from x 780: three tabs in 16px sentence case (the active one a filled pill), a 16px intro line, then a wrap of 5 to 7 filled pill chips (48px tall, a 16px name in each, 12px apart). Switching tabs swaps the chips with a staggered fade-rise (40ms per chip). The chips sit directly on the scene; add a flat 40% dark tint behind the column only if the scene is bright. Phone: heading and paragraph first, tabs as a full-width segmented control, chips wrapping in rows.
phone: Tabs as a segmented control, discs in a 3-column grid under the text.
houseRuleCheck: Outlined icon circles and small-caps underlined tabs are left out. The critic replaced the glyph discs with labels beneath (icon-topped items) by named filled chips with no glyphs; tabs are sentence case with a filled pill for the active one.

name: Empty stage, then a centred link-pill close
description: A two-screen close over a fixed canvas scene (3D or shader). The first 1240px holds no page content and the scene shows through alone. Below it a centred 688px column: a 52px heading, about 20 words of copy and a centred wrap of 8 to 12 filled pill links (52px tall, 12px apart), each holding one 16px name and opening a link. The content ends about 230px above the footer. Pill hover lifts 4px and fills with the accent colour. Phone: the empty stage is 100svh, the column keeps the heading at 36px and the pills wrap in rows of two or three.
phone: Stage shortened to one screen; tiles wrap in rows of four.
houseRuleCheck: Glyph tiles 1px apart (a ruled-grid look, icons) become named pill links 12px apart with solid fills. Keep the stage genuinely empty so the next screen is not visible with the hero.

name: Tall photo beside tile pair with void
description: Two equal halves inside 24px margins, about 1.1 screens tall. The left half is one portrait picture 696 by 880 (radius 24) with a 40px title, one 17px line and a link over its lower part in white on a flat 25% tint; no label. The right half holds two product tiles 340 by 430 (radius 16), 16px apart, in its top row only, and the lower 440 is left empty on purpose. The picture is always on the left and the void always lower right; a second instance does not mirror. Tiles rise on a 120ms stagger. Phone: picture 4:5 with its text, tiles in two columns below at 12px gap, void dropped.
phone: Picture 4:5 with its text, tiles in two columns below, void dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch: the picture is inset 24px instead of flush with the edge. To stay clear of the empty-left rule the void is never on the left and the layout is not mirrored.

name: Tall index rows without images
description: Light tinted ground. A 16px bold title at the left margin, then six wide filled cards in the 1296px container (each 300px tall, 16px gaps, radius 28, alternating two tints, no rules and no index numbers), no pictures. Each card has two lines of content. Top line: a 16px label at left, a 16px statement right of centre and a right-aligned two-line 16px list. Bottom line, about 100px above the card bottom: a 56px project name at left, a 16px second label and a right-aligned two-line list. Hover fills the card with the ink colour and flips the text to the ground colour (0.35s). Phone: cards 260px tall, the lists collapse to two lines beneath the name.
phone: Cards 260px tall, lists shortened under the name.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines and numbering. Designed out: ruled rows become filled cards separated by space and a tint step; no index numbers. The name sits at the left of each card so no row is empty on the left.

name: Centred headline over portrait row
description: A light grey sheet. A 54px four-line centred headline 860px wide, about 200px below the top. At y about 630 a row of five 240x340 portrait tiles (studio cut-outs on a mid-grey ground, radius 24), centred in the 1296px container, 24px apart, nothing cropped. A 62px solid circle cursor carrying a 14px name or role follows the pointer over the row, and a hovered tile lifts 8px. Phone: a 2x3 grid of portraits with the name under each, no cursor.
phone: 2x3 portrait grid with names beneath; no cursor.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge-touch and a drag rail. Designed out: all five tiles fit inside the margins and nothing is draggable. Portraits are staged studio cut-outs, never documentary. Circle cursor has a solid fill, no blur.

name: Photo band, centred headline, three columns
description: Cream ground. A full-bleed staged group portrait across the top 568px. Below it a centred three-line headline (about 88px, 110px line pitch), then three text columns (20px, two or three lines each, 380px wide, 48px apart). A studio cut-out figure stands behind the right end of column 3, overlapping the column by about 80px but kept at least 72px inside the right edge, with the text above it. A solid accent band 120px high closes the section. The photo scales from 1.08 to 1.0 on entry. Phone: photo 320px tall, headline 44px, columns stack, the cut-out beneath them.
phone: Photo 320px tall, columns stacked, cut-out below.
houseRuleCheck: The figure is kept 72px inside the right edge. Group photo must be staged, not documentary. Column text trimmed to a few lines.

name: Two offset flip cards in tall scene
description: A tall scene (350vh) over a canvas or a flat ground. A left column pinned at x 72, 380px wide: a 72px title and a two-line 18px paragraph. Two 320x440 cards (radius 28), one dark and one light, at x 560 and x 1000 and at different heights (one 80px lower). Each front has a 40px name in a filled pill, a studio cut-out portrait photo (never a drawn figure), an 18px line and two or three text links. As scroll runs both cards flip in 3D (rotateY 0 to 180 degrees over 0.8s) to a back with a short bio and a button. Phone: scene 220vh, the cards stack and each flips when it reaches the screen centre.
phone: Cards stacked, each flips at screen centre.
houseRuleCheck: Card faces carry a cut-out photograph, never a drawn figure. Links in text, not emoji. Cards are the only boxes; the title stays on the page ground.

name: Centred header, landscape tile pager
description: Light tinted ground. A centred header: a 33px two-line heading, a 14px two-line subline 280px wide, and two 48px round arrow buttons centred beneath. Below, a pager of landscape tiles 636x424 (radius 28), two visible at a time inside the 1296px container with a 24px gap. Each tile is a filled card: a photo in the upper 65%, and on the fill beneath it a 20px two-line quote and a name. The arrows move one tile (0.6s ease) and keyboard arrows work; no dragging and no tile cut by the edge. Phone: one tile at a time at 4:3 with the arrows under it.
phone: One tile at a time, arrows underneath.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged a drag rail and a tile cut by the edge. Designed out: arrow-only paging and two whole tiles visible. Quote sits on the card fill, not on the photograph.

name: Quote cards passing over pinned split heading
description: Dark ground, about 1.9 screens. A two-line 117px heading is pinned, line one at x 138 and line two at x 884 so it reads as a diagonal split. Four quote pairs 549px wide scroll over it at staggered x positions and heights, rising at 1.4x scroll speed and alternating left and right. Each pair is a quote card in a mid-dark fill (24px quote, three or four lines, radius 24) with a smaller, darker author card (a round 56px photo without a ring, a name and a role) overlapping its lower edge by 40px. Phone: heading 48px and stacked on two lines, pairs full width, no pin.
phone: No pin; heading above, quote pairs stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The ring around the avatar is dropped (outline). The author card overlaps the quote card (overlap, not nesting). Keep each quote to 20 words or fewer.

name: Portrait row, big quote, photo right
description: A full-bleed colour panel about 670px tall, all text in one colour (ink on the accent ground). Top row: a 150px square portrait, a two-line name and role, and a short paragraph of about 20 words in a 208px column. At left mid-panel a 57px four-line quote with an arrow link beneath it. At right, a 559x583 photo (radius 24) with its caption set under it on the panel colour. Phone: portrait and name first, then the quote at 32px, then the photo at full width.
phone: Single column: portrait, quote, photo.
houseRuleCheck: The paragraph is held to about 20 words; photo caption moved from the photo to the panel so nothing sits on the photograph. Panel is one solid colour.

name: Title over three quote cards
description: Ground in a light tint. A 120px three-word display title at the left margin (x 72), in sentence case. Below it, 64px of space, then three equal cards 424px wide with 16px gutters (radius 28, each a solid tint, the middle one a step darker), with a 20px quote of 14 to 22 words and, 32px lower inside the card, a 16px dash-led name and role. All three are visible at once; the cards fade-rise in a 0.15s stagger. Phone: title 56px, cards stacked full width.
phone: Cards stacked full width under a 56px title.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines (rules above each column). Designed out: open ruled columns become filled cards, so quotes do not float without a container. No curly-quote ornaments as drawn marks.

name: Text beside a spot visual, alternating rows
description: Rows 530-720px tall in a narrow centred container of 988px: a text block 440-480px wide (a 48px display headline of one or two words per line in the brand colour, an 18px muted paragraph of two or three lines, optionally one filled button) vertically centred on one side, and a 330px visual on a filled rounded tile (radius 32, fill one step off the ground) on the other: a render of an object, a product-UI crop or a cropped photograph. The sides alternate row to row. No dividers; 120px of space between rows. Ink on ground, the brand colour for the headlines.
phone: The visual first at 80vw, the text under it left aligned; rows 80px apart.
houseRuleCheck: The study had not flagged it, but the spot illustrations were drawn illustrations (house ban on drawn SVG illustrations and drawn shapes). They are replaced by renders, product-UI crops or photographs on a filled tile; the alternating narrow rows stay.

name: Input left, cut-out product on the right
description: White band about 0.9 screen tall. A 420px text block at x 256, vertically centred: a 33px two-line headline, a 14px three-line paragraph, a 14px grey note, and one filled 418x54 input (tint fill, radius 14, no outline) with a submit button joined at its right end. No card or panel around the form. On the right a studio cut-out product group about 420px tall starts at x 750 and ends at least 72px from the right edge. A 12px solid colour strip closes the bottom edge. The product eases in from 40px lower on entry. Phone: text first, the product 260px beneath, the input full width.
phone: Text and input first, product image below.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged the cut-out running off the screen edge: kept inside the margin. Input is a filled field, not an outlined box.

name: Text-photo pair then scroll-driven strip
description: A 48px heading with a short paragraph at the left and a 560x373 photo at the right (radius 20). Below it, a full-width strip of about 10 pictures (560x320, 30px apart, radius 20) that slides sideways with the scroll position as a band cropped by both side edges; no captions, no arrows, no dragging. Scroll maps vertical travel to a 1200px horizontal shift while the strip stays unpinned. Phone: the pair stacks; the strip becomes 280x180 pictures moving at half the shift.
phone: Pair stacked, strip with smaller pictures and shorter travel.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged a drag rail and an edge crop. Designed out: the strip is scroll-driven only and crosses both edges as a band, never a drag affordance. Photos must be styled, not documentary.

name: Stepped three-column masonry
description: A centred 64px headline over a three-column grid in the 1296px container (16px gutters and row gaps, radius 32). Each column stacks a tall card over a shorter photo or text card in a different split: 488/344, 560/272, 488/344. The inner seams step while every column ends flush at the same height (832px). Tall cards hold a photo or a solid tint with a 28px title and a 16px line; the short ones hold a photo or a stat. Cards fade-rise in a column-by-column stagger (0.12s). Phone: a single column in the desktop order, cards 3:4 or 16:9 by type.
phone: One column, cards in reading order.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Mix photo and text cards so the section is not only boxes of one kind; keep a gap of space above and below.

name: Tile pair, caption inside
description: Two equal near-square tiles side by side, about 670px wide at 1440 inside 40px page margins, with a 20px gutter and 16px corners. Each tile is a photograph or a looping clip filling the tile under one flat 30% dark tint (a single even tint, not a gradient). The caption sits 32px in from the bottom left: a 36-44px bold headline of two to four words in white and one plain text link under it (white, no box). No label, no chips, no pills. A video tile carries one 44px filled round pause button at the bottom right. Hover: the picture scales to 1.03 inside its crop over 500ms and the link underlines. 160px of space above and below the pair. Variant: one wide tile (about 1360x684, radius 12) with a 40-46px headline 32px in from the bottom left and no button, between two quiet type sections.
phone: Tiles stack at full width inside 20px gutters, each 4:5, 20px apart; caption 24px in from the bottom left; the pause button stays on video tiles.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged an eyebrow. The label is removed, the one or two pills on the photograph are dropped (no boxes on photographs) and the dark scrim is a flat tint, not a gradient. The idea (two equal tiles with the words inside) stays.

name: Tiled rotated cut-out field
description: A pinned full screen. One studio cut-out figure (transparent background) is repeated about 25 times, each copy rotated 0 to 25 degrees and overlapping its neighbours, covering a solid ground colour on all four sides. No type. During the pin (about 1.5 screens of scroll) the copies turn another 4 to 8 degrees and scale from 1.0 to 1.1 in a slight stagger, then the field releases to the next section. Optional: one centred 20px line on a solid pill. Phone: about 12 copies, rotation range halved.
phone: Fewer copies, smaller turn.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge-touch. The field covers all four edges as a pattern, which is a full bleed, not one edge; a 3D letter and a wave shape are left out. Use a single figure image, not a drawn one.

name: Tilted 3D object row with spec table
description: A pinned 1440x900 canvas: scroll steps the row and the pin releases after the last step. A WebGL row of flat discs (covers or product faces) tilted about -30 degrees on two axes and rising to the right. The active disc is about 520px and centred; neighbours sit at 0.8 scale on a 480px pitch and are fully inside the frame, none cut by the top edge. A 300px spec card is fixed at top-left: a 30px serif title in sentence case and four label/value rows as alternating tinted bars 40px high (14px muted label, 18px value) with no rules. Phone: one disc at 280px, swiped or stepped by scroll, spec card under it.
phone: One disc centred, spec bars beneath.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines, tiny uppercase labels and the top-edge crop. Designed out: tinted bars instead of ruled rows, sentence-case labels at 14px or more, whole discs in frame.

name: Tilted bending film strip
description: Inside a rounded bezel (radius 40, 20px inset) on a solid dark ground: a centred 72px title and a 22px sub-line. Below, a reel of frames about 1310px wide, tilted 8 degrees up to the right and bent into a shallow S (a 3D transform of rounded frames, no sprocket drawing). The centre frame (556x470) is bright and sharp; neighbours are smaller and darker. Square 56px arrows sit at both sides; they step the reel one frame (0.7s ease). Phone: one centred frame with two neighbours peeking symmetrically at 70% scale, arrows under it.
phone: One central frame with smaller neighbours, arrows beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Use a solid dark ground (no gradient) and plain rounded frames with no sprocket holes and no dots (arrows only).

name: Tilted card drift over pinned headline
description: Pinned for 4 to 8 beats (about 700px of scroll each) on a textured ground with a fixed halftone texture behind (generated from a photograph). A centred 72px two-line serif headline holds for the first screen. Then portrait cards (480x680, radius 24) enter one at a time from the lower right, tilted -3 to +10 degrees, cross diagonally over the headline and leave to the upper left. Only one card is in view at a time: the previous one has gone before the next enters, so no neighbour is cut by an edge. Phone: cards 70vw wide, travelling bottom to top with a smaller tilt.
phone: One card at a time rising vertically, smaller tilt.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged edge-touch (neighbour cards cropped at rest). Designed out: one card at a time and the label above the headline dropped (eyebrow). The halftone texture is a photograph or shader, not a drawn illustration.

name: Full-screen WebGL page per year
description: One full-screen WebGL page per period (a year or an issue), reached through a type wipe: a huge letterform crosses the screen as a mask and the next page ripples in as image planes that dissolve with a halftone front. Wheel and touch move the planes within a page; a fixed footer link leads to the previous period. Each page holds one 120px headline or none and four to six image planes. Phone: touch swipe changes page; the wipe letter shrinks to 60vw.
phone: Swipe between full-screen pages; wipe letter smaller.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Years appear as titles, not as 01/02/03 counters. Use styled pictures, not archive photographs.

name: Title over full-width row log
description: A 120px two-word title at x 72 and a 14px three-line paragraph in column 5 beside it, no rule between. Then a log of 8 rows (show more reveals the rest) on a 56px pitch across the 1296px container; rows are zebra-tinted bands (two close tints, radius 14 on the first and last), each holding 16px text in three columns: a date at x 72, a short entry at x 400 and a long entry at x 760 that ends with an ellipsis before the margin. Hover fills a row with the ink colour and flips the text to the ground colour. Phone: rows 72px tall with the date and the short entry only, long entry hidden.
phone: Two-column rows (date, entry), long text hidden.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines (a rule under every row): replaced by zebra tint. Row count held to 8 to stay light on text.

name: Title flies off as camera dives
description: A pinned scene of about 720px of scroll. A 3D camera moves forward and down past a peak. The hero title rotates about 12 degrees, grows and slides off to the lower right until only its first letters remain; the tagline and the prompt blur out; the scene ends top-down on a valley. Optionally one small object crosses the foreground. Phone: the title slides off to the bottom, the camera path shortens to 500px.
phone: Shorter pin, title slides off downward.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Make sure the scene is the only thing on screen at this point of the page and that space follows.

name: Object held by rising hand
description: A dark canvas. A 100px title is centred at the top and builds letter by letter (blur and 20px offset per letter). A short 18px accent line in sentence case sits under the title. The object shrinks to about 280px at centre while a hand (a rendered 3D hand or a cut-out photograph) rises from the bottom edge to hold it. A 16px sentence-case caption sits beside the hand. Phone: title 48px, object 200px, the hand rises to 60% of the screen height.
phone: Smaller title and object, shorter hand rise.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels: the caption and the accent line are set in sentence case at 16px or more. The hand needs a real render or cut-out, never a drawn illustration.

name: Twin halves, two grounds
description: Two equal halves in the 1296px container, split by a change of fill instead of a rule (one pale tint, one deeper tint, 8px gap, radius 32). Each half holds a row: a 342x303 picture (radius 20, no rim) beside a 276px text column with a 32px three-line title, a 19px two-line paragraph, two filled tag chips and a 275px pill button. Both halves rise 24px on entry; hover darkens its half a step. Phone: halves stack, each with the picture above its text.
phone: Halves stacked, picture over text.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels, mono type, hairlines. Designed out: no slash-label, no dashed rule, no 6px rim; the split is a fill change; type is sans or serif only.

name: Two-column large square cards grid
description: Dark ground. A one-line 72px headline at the left. 100px below, a two-column grid of large cards in the 1296px container (632px wide, 32px gutter and row gap, radius 32), three rows deep. Each card is a solid fill with a 632x520 photo set in its top (radius 24, with the card fill around it) and, on the fill beneath, a 100px caption row: a filled tag pill at left (14px, sentence case), a one-line 20px description, and a 48px round arrow button at right. No overlay over the photograph. Cards lift 8px on hover and the photo scales 1.04. Phone: one column, photos 4:3.
phone: One column, photos 4:3, captions kept.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged a gradient over the photo. Designed out: captions sit on the card fill beneath the photograph, so there is no scrim, no pill or box on the photograph and no gradient.

name: Two-column staggered UI windows
description: White ground, two 684px columns with a 24px gutter inside 72px margins. Top left: a 125px three-line headline in plain type (no inline icons), a paragraph of two lines and a link. Top right: a product window. Below, one window in each column at staggered heights (left starts about 550px down, right about 746px down), each showing a real interface state: a stills grid, a form, a list, two or three collaborator cursors with small name tags. Windows have a flat fill, radius 20 and no shadow at rest; they rise 30px on entry. Phone: single column, windows full width inside the margins, 16px gap.
phone: One column of windows, kept inside 16px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Inline icon tiles and decorative shapes in the headline are left out (no pictures in headlines, no drawn shapes). Windows stay inside the margins on both sides; never run one into a screen edge.

name: Two-screen canvas with one link line
description: Two screens (about 1800px) of a fixed canvas scene (3D or shader) with a single 44px one-line link headline placed 420px below the section top. The remaining 1340px is open canvas; the only other text lives in the fixed corner items of the page frame. The link underlines on hover and the scene reacts to the pointer. Phone: the scene is shortened to 150svh and the line breaks onto two lines at 32px.
phone: Shorter scene, line on two rows.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The link hover uses a colour change; no underline rule drawn as decoration at rest.

name: Two unequal tiles with empty gap
description: White ground; a 24px heading on the left and one text link on the right above the tiles. Two product tiles on pale grey, tops aligned: a 670x763 tile from the left margin (columns 1 to 6) and a 440x501 tile starting at x 960 (columns 10 to 12), with columns 7 to 9 left empty on purpose. Under each tile a 20px caption row (name, a text action with an arrow, a price). Images fade in on entry; hover scales the product 1.04 inside its tile. Nothing follows in a 3-up grid. Phone: tiles stack at full width, the large one first, the empty gap becomes 48px of space.
phone: Tiles stacked, large first, 48px between.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The left side holds the large tile so no row is empty on the left; prices are plain text, not badges.

name: Typed centred line over 3D model
description: The same canvas as the hero. The greeting fades out and one centred two-line paragraph of about 24px (about 16 words) types in over 4s near the upper third while the 3D model rests low in the frame. A solid caption pill (14px, sentence case) grows from a dot at bottom-right. One wheel notch ends the scene. Phone: line 20px, the model 60% of the screen width, the pill centred at the bottom.
phone: Smaller line and model, caption pill centred.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Typing effect is a plain reveal; the caption is a solid pill, not outlined.

name: List with cursor image trail
description: A project list of 8 to 10 rows in the 1296px container: each row 96px high, a 56px sentence-case name at the left and a 16px discipline and year at the right, separated by space and a tint step on hover, not by rules. As the pointer moves over the list, 150px images (radius 16) spawn along its path, rise slightly and fade after 600ms, at most five alive at once. On touch there is no trail: tapping a row opens it and shows a 100px thumbnail beside the name. Phone: rows 80px, thumbnails 100px on the right.
phone: No trail; 100px thumbnail beside each name, tap to open.
houseRuleCheck: Rows separated by space and tint, not hairlines; no index numbers; no mono type. Trail images must be styled pictures, not documentary. Thin evidence: the sizes are a designed spec (moved out of the description by the critic).

name: Portrait panel triptych
description: A dark box one screen tall. Three equal portrait panels at 1:2 (about 450x900 at 1440), 24px apart, centred inside 45px margins; together they fit the width. Each panel is a background photograph with a graphic layer (a cut-out or a large letterform) on top; the two layers move at different speeds with scroll (the layer 12% faster) for depth. Hovering a panel widens it 12% and narrows its neighbours. Phone: panels stack at full width with 4:5 crops, layers keep a small parallax.
phone: Panels stacked at 4:5, small parallax between layers.
houseRuleCheck: Panels wider than the screen would be cropped at the edge, so the trio fits inside the margins. The graphic layer is a cut-out or type, not a drawn illustration. Thin evidence: the sizes are a designed spec (moved out of the description by the critic).

name: Veil closing column with logos and share
description: The end state of a scroll-driven 3D story. A flat translucent dark veil (about 70% black, no blur) lies over the scene and carries one centred column with 64px side padding: a 20px accent-colour line of two sentences, a row of three partner marks with space between them, a 48px title mark 24px below, two stacked buttons 16px apart (one in the accent fill, one in a darker fill) and a share row of three round 44px buttons. Scrolling further loops the story back to an earlier stop. Phone: column full width inside 24px padding, buttons full width.
phone: Single column on the veil, buttons full width.
houseRuleCheck: Glow and separator lines are left out; the veil is a flat tint, not glass. Partner marks limited to three so it is not a credit wall.

name: Tinted-sidebar statement with type switcher
description: Textured ground. A left sidebar 340px wide in a deeper tint runs the section height in place of any rule. Right of it, a five-line 40px serif caps statement (about 886px wide) darkens word by word from dim ink as it scrolls, with a 14px caption beneath. Lower in the sidebar, a short list of unit types (16px rows; the chosen row a filled pill), a 72px numeral with its unit and a 16px price line. On the right a 568px photograph or render swaps with the chosen type (0.5s cross-fade). Phone: sidebar content moves above the statement, the picture last at full width.
phone: Selector first, statement, then the picture at full width.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged hairlines (the vertical rule, label). Designed out: a tint step, a filled-pill selection, no small label. The swapped image is a render or photo, not a drawn plan.

name: Video window between side colour columns
description: A full-screen video behind two flat colour columns, each about 250px wide, with straight inner edges and a 48px radius on their inner corners. The columns carry the navigation words (three on the left, two on the right) in 20px sentence case. The columns are clip-path shapes in one solid colour; on scroll they slide outward 80px and the video widens. Use it as an opening or closing scene, with nothing else on screen. Phone: columns shrink to 16vw side strips, words move to a menu.
phone: Thin side strips, navigation moves into a menu.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. S-curve wave edges would be drawn shapes, so the critic gave the columns straight inner edges; navigation words must not be a sentence.

name: Colour panel, giant headline, cut-out
description: A colour panel inset 24px from the sides with straight top and bottom edges and a 56px radius on all four corners. Centred: a small filled pill (16px, sentence case), a two-line 216px headline in heavy type, and under it a large centred product cut-out about 560px tall. At the far left and far right, level with the middle of the cut-out, one fact each: a 28px figure over a 16px sentence-case caption. The product rises 60px and scales from 0.9 to 1 as the panel enters. Phone: headline 72px, the cut-out 300px, facts side by side under it.
phone: Headline 72px, cut-out 300px, facts side by side beneath.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels: fact labels are 16px sentence case. Wave edges would be drawn shapes, so the critic gave the panel straight edges with a large radius. Facts are measurements, not numbered steps.

name: Wave-offset three-column square grid
description: Three columns of 413px square photos from an 80px margin, 20px apart, with 79px between rows (radius 20). The middle column is raised 124px, so each row reads as a shallow wave. Three rows (nine photos) make a section of about 1500px. Photos fade in on load (0.8s, 80ms stagger) and the columns drift 20px against each other on scroll. No captions. Phone: two columns, the right one lowered 60px, squares 170px.
phone: Two columns with a lowered right column.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Photos are bare squares, so there are no boxes on photographs; they must be styled, not documentary.

name: Rendered room, centred product
description: Each scene is a pinned full-screen rendered room: a back wall, a floor from about two thirds of the height and set dressing (a plant, a stool, a lamp) that changes per scene. The room is a pre-rendered still or a WebGL scene. One small product (about 18% of the width) floats at dead centre and bobs 8px. A centred two- or three-line 48px white uppercase title sits at about 73% of the height over a flat 25% tint, with a plain underlined 20px text action 24px under it. Rooms swap as you scroll (crossfade 600ms; the product stays, the set dressing changes). No dot rail or pagination.
phone: Room cropped to the centre, title 32px, action 18px.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged tiny uppercase labels. The title is 48px and the action 20px, nothing is tiny, and the dot rail (a rail of progress) is dropped. Rooms must be designed or rendered, not documentary photographs.

name: Wheel-panned picture row on flat ground
description: A pinned full-screen stage on a flat mid-tone ground for about three screens. One row of pictures (artworks or product shots) 300 by 400 (radius 8, no shadow) sits centred on the screen's middle line at a 450 pitch; three to five are visible, and pieces near the 80px side margins fade out by position (opacity set per item, no mask gradient) instead of being cut by the edge. Scroll pans the row sideways. At 72% height, one centred line shows the current piece's title (28px) and its year in the soft ink and crossfades as the centre piece changes. Colour roles: flat ground, the pictures carry the colour, ink for the title. Phone: pieces 220 by 300, one centred with neighbours at 60% opacity, swipe pans.
phone: Pieces 220 by 300, one centred, swipe pans.
houseRuleCheck: Tagged edge-touch, shadow, tiny caps: edge-cut pieces fade before the margin, the soft shadow is dropped (ground contrast does the work), the small caps year row becomes a 28px title under the row, the piece count (counter) is dropped.

name: Wheel-driven camera rail
description: A full-screen canvas on a page that does not scroll: the wheel (or a vertical swipe on touch) moves a camera along a baked, looping path through a 3D interior (about 15000 wheel pixels per loop, springy easing, a small pointer look-around). Hovered frames in the interior light up. All interface stays in a corner frame (title, a link, a sound toggle at a 40px inset). Phone: swipe drives the camera, look-around by tilt is off. Needs a prepared 3D scene and path.
phone: Swipe moves the camera; no look-around.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Provide a plain skip link and keyboard control so the page-never-scrolls trap can be left; a frame, not a drag rail.

name: Wheel-spun card fan on an arc
description: Full-screen WebGL, no text. Eight to ten card planes start stacked at the centre with small turns, then fly out in 1s to positions along a circle and turn tangent to it. Wheel or touch rotates the whole fan around the arc endlessly; scroll speed bends the cards and tilts them up to 30 degrees. An optional soft tick sound while moving, off by default. Phone: cards at 60% scale, swipe rotates the fan.
phone: Smaller cards, swipe to rotate.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Use styled pictures on the cards, no captions and no numbering of the cards.

name: Wheel-stepped chapter slider
description: A full-screen flat tinted ground per chapter (four chapters, tints from one palette family). In the upper left area, inside 64px margins, sit a round 220px crop of a photograph or an object (a plain disc, no stroke ring), a 20px sentence-case line, a one-line 72px condensed serif title and a 52px filled pill button. One step is a wheel tick, an arrow key or a swipe, and it advances at most about every 2.6s: the content slides 80px and fades while the page colour turns over 600ms. A chapter fills the screen on its own; nothing touches the edges.
phone: One chapter per screen, a swipe steps, the round crop 140px and the title 40px.
houseRuleCheck: The study flagged eyebrow, numbering, tiny uppercase labels and edge touch. Designed out: the caps label and numerals are removed, the outline pill becomes a filled button, the drawing ring stroke becomes a plain disc, the strip no longer runs off the screen edge, and the page colours come from one palette family so there is no sprawl.

name: Wide feature tile over tall tile pair grid
description: Coloured ground, 290px top padding. One full-container feature tile (1278x450, radius 14): a title and a short line at top-left, a looping video filling its right 60%. 45px below, a two-column grid (622px columns, 34px gap) of tall video tiles (aspect about 0.63), then shorter tiles including one plain link tile (an arrow and a short line, filled with the accent). Videos play only when in view. Phone: the feature tile stacks (video on top), grid becomes one column.
phone: Feature tile stacked, grid in one column.
houseRuleCheck: An icon tile becomes a plain link tile (no icon-topped card). Keep the margin of 81px on both sides so the wide tile does not touch an edge.

name: Photo card plus text card
description: Two tinted cards 8px apart in a 1360px container (40px margins), radius 8, 686px tall. The left card, 830px wide, holds a photo inset 24px (radius 4). The right card, 522px wide, has a 38px three-line title at its top and a 16px four-line muted paragraph at its bottom. The cards share one tint family (the right one a step deeper). The photo scales 1.06 to 1.0 on entry. Phone: the cards stack, photo card 4:5, text card auto height.
phone: Cards stacked, photo 4:5.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The photograph sits inside its card with fill around it and no box sits on the photograph.

name: Wordless camera descent to globe
description: About 1540px of scroll with no text. A fixed canvas (shader or 3D) descends through a storm that thins to a flat pale cloud layer; then a dark swirling planet blooms through the layer until the globe fills the screen. The descent speed follows the scroll with light easing. Phone: the same canvas at 130svh of scroll with the globe cropped to the centre. Needs a prepared canvas scene.
phone: Shorter scroll, globe cropped to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Colours stay within one dark family and one accent; no violet or lavender in the planet.

name: Wordless parallax photo
description: One edge-to-edge picture 1440 by 1100 (1.2 screens) with no text, in an overflow-hidden frame. The image inside is 130% of the frame height and travels from -15% to +15% against the scroll at about half scroll speed, so the frame reads as a window. No caption, chip or controls. 120px of ground above and below. Use it as a breathing break after a dense section. The picture is art-directed (a made image, a product world or a place), never documentary. Phone: frame 4:5 at full width, image 120%, parallax range halved.
phone: Frame 4:5 at full width, image 120%, parallax range halved.
houseRuleCheck: A tiny corner chip and a shaped top edge are not used.
